original: This barren rock holds no value. You cannot build anything upon it, and people cannot walk over it.

original: Water is Poseidon's domain. You might be able to find sea urchins or fish here.

original: This land has been left cracked and broken by an earthquake. You can bridge a straight crack by placing a road across it.

将城市连接起來的道路。

original: This Quarry is rich in white marble. Build a Masonry Shop to harvest the raw materials that lie here.
text: 采石场内有很多大理石。在旁边建造一個石料加工场來将這裡的原材料开采出來。

original: This open land is just waiting to be built upon.
text: 這片空地上可以建造房屋。

original: The Water Crossing allows walkers to cross bodies of water.
text: 浮桥可以讓人穿过水域。

original: Description of road connecting city to king road.
text: 关于城裡通向王国道路的說明。

original: The copper ore in this rock can be smelted into bronze at a Foundry. Bronze can be made into armor and sculpture.
text: 铜矿石可以在铸造场被炼成青铜。青铜可以用來制造盔甲和雕像。

original: The silver ore in this rock can be converted into drachmas at a Mint.
text: 银矿石可以在铸币场被炼成银币。

original: This is Special rock. (this text should not appear anywhere)
text: 這是特殊岩石。(這行文字不应该在任何地方出現)

original: Nothing can be built on the beach, but people can walk across it.
text: 海滩上不能建造建筑，但是人可以在上面自由行走。

original: The tide is in, and the beach is submerged.
text: 現在正是涨潮的時候，海滩被淹沒了。

original: People can make their way across marshes, but nothing can be built on this muddy terrain.
text: 人們可以在湿地上行走，但是不能在上面建造任何建筑。

original: This fertile land can play host to farms, olive trees, grapevines, orange trees and livestock.
text: 這片肥沃的土地上可以建造农场，种植橄榄树和葡萄藤，還可以饲养羊群。

original: The urchins here are waiting in their beds for an urchin gatherer to collect them.
text: 這裡的海胆正等着人們來采集呢。

original: Fish are plentiful here! Build a Fishery to haul them out of the water.
text: 這裡的鱼很多！快來捕捞它們吧。

original: This hot, molten lava will burn anything in its path. Watch out!
text: 這种滚烫的熔岩能把一路上的東西都烧掉。当心了！

original: This cold rock was once molten lava. Nothing can be built upon it.
text: 這是冷却後的熔岩，上面不能建造任何東西。

original: This Quarry has a bountiful supply of black marble. Build a Black Marble Workshop to harvest it.
text: 這個採石場蘊藏豐富的黑色大理石，建造黑色大理石工坊來開採。

original: This is mysterious orichalc ore. Once it is transformed into orichalc metal at a Refinery, it can be used to adorn buildings.
text: 這是神秘的山銅礦石。在精煉廠冶煉成山銅金屬後，可用來裝飾建築。

original: Parks are pleasant spots for people to unwind after a hard day's work.
text: 公园是人們忙碌了一天後休闲的好去处。

original: Healers from the Infirmary cure what ails the city's residents.
text: 诊所裡的医师能為城裡的居民治病疗伤。

original: With a full staff, this Infirmary is sending out healers as quickly as it can.
text: 這座诊所拥有充足的人手，它正以最快的速度派出医师四处巡视。

original: This Infirmary is slightly understaffed.  It is still sending out healers, but people are going a little longer between check-ups.
text: 這座诊所還缺几個人手，它仍然可以派遣医师，不过间隔稍长了一些。

original: This Infirmary only has half of the workers it needs.  People are putting up with their aches and pains until a healer finally visits them.
text: 這座诊所只有半数的人手，人們不得不忍受病痛等待医师的到访。

original: This Infirmary hardly has any workers at all. Citizens' hygiene practices could worsen!
text: 這座诊所几乎沒有医师，市民的卫生状况可能會变差！

original: With only one employee, this Infirmary can barely function.
text: 只有一個医师的诊所根本无法运作。

original: This Infirmary has no employees. Citizens are applying dangerous home remedies to cure themselves.
text: 這座诊所一個医师都沒有， 市民正在家裡使用危险的土方來给自己治病。

original: This building is on fire! The healers are a little too preoccupied to make their rounds.
text: 這座建筑着火了！医师自己都忙不过來了。

original: A god has cursed this building, and healers will not provide cures until the curse is lifted.
text: 一位神诅咒了這座诊所，在诅咒消失前這裡的医师无法提供医疗服务。

original: The College teaches philosophers to ponder the world around them.
text: 大学是培养学者的地方，在這裡他們学习思考周围世界的問題。

original: With full employment, this College is unleashing new philosophers on the city as fast as it can.
text: 這座大学拥有充足的人手，它正在以最快的速度培养学者。

original: This College is slightly understaffed.  It's still training philosophers, but at a slower pace.
text: 這座大学稍微缺几個人手，它還在培养学者，但是速度有所下降。

original: This College has around half of the workers it needs.  With so few people on staff, it's taking a lot of time to teach new philosophers.
text: 這座大学只有大约半数的人手，它培养学者的速度大打折扣。

original: This College has far too few employees.  The teaching of new philosophers has slowed to a crawl.
text: 這座大学的人手实在太少，培养学者的速度就像蜗牛爬一样。

original: This College has only one lonely employee.  He is doing his best to teach new philosophers, but it is slow going.
text: 這座大学只有一個人，尽管他全力以赴，但也无能為力。

original: This College has no employees.  The halls are silent, and no philosophers are learning anything here.
text: 這座大学一個人手都沒有，大厅裡静悄悄的，沒有人能在這裡学到東西。

original: This building is on fire, and the philosophers here have concluded that burns are no fun!
text: 這座建筑着火了，学者們一致认為這一点都不好玩！

original: This College has been cursed and cannot produce philosophers until the curse has been lifted. Dunce caps are in vogue here.
text: 這座大学被诅咒了，在诅咒消失前這裡不能培养学者。

original: At the Drama School, would-be actors learn to emote, emote, emote.
text: 有表演天赋的市民在這裡接受培训，成為真正的演员。

original: This Drama School has all the workers it needs to turn ordinary men into drama powerhouses.
text: 這所戏剧学院拥有充足的人手，它培养的演员能在任何舞台上演出。

original: If you want high-class actors in this city, this Drama School is going to need more employees.  It's still turning out actors, but at a slower rate.
text: 如果你想要這個城市拥有高水平的演员，就得再给戏剧学院一些人手。它還在培养演员，但是速度已經有所下降。

original: This Drama School has around half the employees it needs and is training new actors very slowly indeed.
text: 這所戏剧学院只有大约一半人手，它培养演员的速度真的很慢。

original: With just a handful of workers, this Drama School is taking quite a long time to train new actors.
text: 只有几個工人的戏剧学院需要很长時间才能培养出新的演员。

original: With only one employee, this Drama School cannot teach new actors very quickly at all.
text: 這所戏剧学院只有一個工人，它几乎无法运作。

original: This Drama School has no employees.  No actors are learning to traipse across the stage here.
text: 這所戏剧学院沒有工人，它无法培养演员。

original: Fire! Actors are running for their lives!
text: 着火了！演员們都逃了出去！

original: This building has been cursed! The teachers here cannot even instruct in the ancient art of mime!
text: 這座建筑被诅咒了！教师們无法正常教授学業！

original: At the Gymnasium, scrawny youths become muscle-bound giants.
text: 在体育馆裡，瘦弱的青年被训练成健壮的运动员。

original: This Gymnasium has all the workers it needs to produce athletes and world-class competitors.
text: 這座体育馆拥有充足的人手來培训运动员和高级运动员。

original: This Gymnasium is lacking a few workers.  It's taking a little longer than expected for the youths to develop strong muscles.
text: 這座体育馆還缺几個人手，运动员的培训時间比正常情况下要长一些。

original: This Gymnasium has around half the workers it needs.  Spaghetti-armed youths are the order of the day.
text: 這座体育馆只有大约一半的人手，裡面的年轻人還都很瘦弱。

original: With only a few staff members, the youths training here are still weaklings.  It's taking a very long time for any of them to attain athlete or competitor status.
text: 這裡只有几個人手，要花很长時间才能训练出一個拥有运动员资格的人。

original: The skeleton staff that works at this Gymnasium can only do so much. The Gymnasium is turning out new athletes or competitors at an excruciatingly slow rate.
text: 体育馆裡唯一的工人對現状很无奈，不知要多久才能训练出一個运动员出來。

original: With no employees, this Gymnasium is dormant, and no competitors or athletes are being trained here.
text: 這座体育馆一個工人都沒有，它无法训练运动员。

original: Fire! The athletes here have quickly dashed away!
text: 着火了！這裡的运动员都飞也似的逃跑了！

original: This Gymnasium is cursed! Well-toned muscles have been replaced by flab, and the surrounding neighborhood is not entertained by watching the athletes just sit around!
text: 這座体育馆被诅咒了！這裡的运动员都无所事事地坐在一边！

original: This Gymnasium is sanctified! It will produce twice the number of athletes until the sanctification wears off.
text: 這座体育馆被祝福了！在此期间，它能以兩倍的速度训练运动员。

original: Competitions of strength and speed take place here.  If your city is lucky, it might even be able to host Games in this Stadium one day.
text: 力量與速度的竞赛在這裡举行。如果你的城市幸运的话，也许哪天這裡還能举办运动會呢。

original: This Stadium is not operational. It has employees, but it needs competitors from a Gymnasium to host contests.
text: 這座露天运动场无法正常运作。它有足够的工人，但是它還需要來自体育馆的运动员來参加比赛。

original: This Stadium is the site of many a great battle of competitor against competitor.
text: 在這裡，很多伟大的运动员相互角逐。

original: This Stadium has no employees and cannot host any competitions.
text: 這座露天运动场沒有工人，无法举办竞赛。

original: Right now, there are no competitions here.
The Stadium is on fire! Run!
text: 运动场着火了！运动员們慌忙地逃了出去。除非把火灭了，否则他們是不會回來的。

original: This cursed Stadium cannot host competitions!
text: 露天运动场被诅咒了！运动员們无法再进行比赛來取悦市民了。

original: This blessed Stadium provides more entertainment than usual.
text: 露天运动场被祝福了！比往常多一倍的高级运动员将走上街头，向人們展示他們健美的体魄！

original: Your city is proud to be hosting the Games this year.
text: 今年你的城市将有幸举办奥林匹克竞赛。

original: Philosophers ponder, pontificate and proselytize here.
text: 這裡是学者交流思想，發表主张的地方。

original: This Podium has employees but no philosophers to spread knowledge.  Make sure there are Colleges in the city to supply philosophers.
text: 這個讲坛有足够的工人，却沒有学者來传播思想。去确认一下城裡有沒有培养学者的大学。
這個讲坛有充足的人手。

original: Without employees, this Podium is just a raised platform.
text: 沒有工人的讲坛只是一個好看的平台。

original: Right now, no philosophers are giving lectures here.
text: 現在沒有学者在此做演讲。
演讲題目：毕达哥拉斯：三角形和多边形
演讲題目：亚裡斯多德的单一情感
演讲題目：斯多葛学派的伊比鸠鲁规则

original: Lecture: Socrates has some questions for you
text: 演讲題目：苏格拉底向你提出的几個問題

original: Lecture: Utopia in a Few Easy Lessons
text: 演讲題目：乌托邦的几步曲

original: This Podium is ablaze! Its philosophers are off looking for a cooler place to preach and are not bringing knowledge to your citizens.
text: 讲坛着火了！所有的学者都逃了出去，不再向市民传播知识了。

original: This Podium is cursed! Its philosophers have become fascinated by their own navels and are not spreading their theories to the masses.
text: 這個讲坛被诅咒了！所有的学者都對理论失去了兴趣，不再向市民传播知识了。

original: This Podium is sanctified! Double the normal number of philosophers are teaching lofty ideas to the neighborhood's residents.
text: 這個讲坛被祝福了！比往常多一倍的学者正在向市民讲授高深的知识。

original: Here, great tragedies and classic comedies are performed to the delight of the crowds.
text: 偉大的悲劇和經典的喜劇在這裡輪番上演，以取悅大眾。

original: This Theater has employees but needs actors to perform the shows.
text: 這座劇場有工人，但還需要演員來表演劇目。

original: This Theater is currently entertaining the masses.
text: 這座劇場正在娛樂大眾。

original: This Theater has no employees, so the actors are refusing to work.
text: 這座劇場沒有工人，所以演員們都拒絕演出。

original: This Theater is not showing any plays right now.
text: 這座劇場現在沒有上演任何劇目。
劇目：埃斯庫羅斯的「七雄遠征底比斯」
劇目：歐里庇得斯的「希波呂忒」
劇目：阿里斯托芬的「烏雲」
劇目：索福克勒斯的「俄狄浦斯王」

original: Fire in the Theater! The actors here have decreed that the show will not go on until the fire is out! With no shows, the Theater cannot provide entertainment to the neighborhood.
text: 著火了！演員們一致決定在大火熄滅前不上演任何劇目！這樣劇場也就不能為大眾提供娛樂了。

original: This Theater is cursed! The actors cannot remember their lines and are not entertaining the public.
text: 這座劇場被詛咒了！演員們連台詞都想不起來，無法再為大眾服務了。

original: This Theater is sanctified! Twice as many actors as usual are bemusing area residents.
text: 這座劇場被祝福了！比往常多一倍的演員在為大眾服務。

original: Here, horses are raised to serve in battle and race at the Hippodrome.
text: 這裡是饲养战马的地方。

original: This Horse Ranch has no employees and is not raising any horses.
text: 這座马场沒有工人，无法饲养马匹。

original: With a full staff, the Horse Ranch is able to care for the maximum number of horses.
text: 這座马场人手充足，它能饲养最大数量的马匹。

original: This Horse Ranch lacks some workers and cannot care for a full ranch of horses.
text: 這座马场還缺几個工人，因此饲养马匹的数量也有所减少。

original: This Horse Ranch is understaffed and can only care for a few horses
text: 這座马场人手不足，只能饲养几匹马。

original: With only a few ranch hands, this Horse Ranch can barely take care of any horses.
text: 只有几個人手的马场几乎无法正常运作。

original: This Horse Ranch has more horses than ranch hands.  It will take a long time before any of the horses are ready to be sold.
text: 這座马场裡的人比马還要少。他們得花很长時间才能养大一匹马。

original: This Horse Ranch needs a supply of wheat from a Storehouse or Wheat Farm before it can raise any horses.
text: 這座马场需要货栈或是麦田為它提供小麦來饲养马匹。

original: This monument is a proud testament to your city's growth.
text: 這座纪念碑是你城市日益壮大的见证。

original: You won a grand and noble victory, and this monument is a reminder of your achievement.
text: 你赢得了一次伟大的勝利，這座纪念碑就是你成就的证明。

original: Your borders have expanded, and this monument will remind you of the colony you founded.
text: 你的疆界扩张了，這座纪念碑就是你建立殖民地的纪念。

original: The skill of your victorious athletes and competitors matches the grandeur of this monument.
text: 你的运动员們所取得的勝利就和這座纪念碑一样伟大。

original: This monument serves as a reminder of that glorious day when another city fell to your power.
text: 這座纪念碑上永远记载了我們将另一個城市征服的伟大事迹。

original: The city's golden yesteryears will never be forgotten, thanks to this monument.
text: 有了這座纪念碑，這個城市光辉的过去就将永远被人們称道。

original: This monument serves as a reminder of a great hero who attained a great feat while in the service of this city.
text: 這座纪念碑纪念了一位伟大的英雄為這個伟大的城市所参加的一次伟大的战斗。

original: Through your adept skill, a fellow leader agreed to become your ally. This monument serves as a reminder to your suave tongue.
text: 通过你的努力，一位友邦的執政官同意與我們结為同盟。這座纪念碑记载了你的成就。

original: Your philosophers or actors thrilled the audiences at the games. This monument is a symbol of their intellectual prowess.
text: 你的学者和演员在竞赛中技压群雄，赢得了勝利。這座纪念碑就是他們智慧的象征。

original: The great god Zeus presented you with this monument as a token of his appreciation for retrieving the Golden Fleece.
text: 众神之神宙斯将這座纪念碑送给了你，作為對你取回金羊毛的奖励。

original: Poseidon gladly awarded you this monument when you retrieved the Palladium.
text: 见你取回了雅典娜神像，波賽東高兴地将這座纪念碑送给了你。

original: In gratitude for retrieving the Cattle of Geryon, Demeter awarded you this monument.
text: 為了感谢你赶回革律翁的牛群，狄蜜特将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: Apollo, thankful that you rescued his friend Theseus from the Underworld, awarded you this monument.
text: 阿波罗為了感谢你從地狱中救出了他的朋友忒修斯将這座纪念碑送给了你。

original: Artemis, delighted with the Girdle of Hippolyte that you retrieved for her, gave you this monument.
text: 阿緹蜜絲看到你為她带來的希波吕忒的腰带高兴地将這座纪念碑送给了你。

original: The stalwart Ares, God of War, gave you this monument to reward you for retrieving the Mares of Diomedes.
text: 坚定的战神阿瑞斯在你取回狄俄墨得斯的母马後将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: Aphrodite was overjoyed with the Golden Apples of the Hesperides and awarded you this monument.
text: 愛芙羅黛蒂看到赫斯珀裡得斯的金苹果兴奋不已，并将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: The fleet-footed Hermes gave you this monument when you found his Winged Sandals.
text: 你帮荷米斯找到了他的飞行靴，他高兴地将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: The wise Athena presented you with this monument when you found her Mirror Shield.
text: 智慧的雅典娜在你找到她的神盾後将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: When you retrieved the Bow and Arrows of Hercules, Hephaestus gave this monument to you.
text: 在你取回赫爾克利斯的弓箭後，赫菲斯托斯将這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: After you delivered the Horn of Amalthea to Dionysus, he rewarded you with this monument.
text: 当你把阿玛尔特亚的羊角送给狄俄尼索斯後，他把這座纪念碑奖给了你。

original: Hades gave you this monument to award you for finding the Helmet of Invisibility.
text: 黑帝斯将這座纪念碑送给了你，奖励你找到了隐身帽。

original: The great god Zeus presented you with this grand monument as a token of his appreciation for retrieving the Golden Fleece.
text: 众神之神宙斯将這座纪念碑送给了你，作為對你取回金羊毛的奖励。

text: 黑帝斯将這座纪念碑送给了你，奖励你找到了隐身帽。

original: In her beneficence, Hera rewarded you with this grand monument for sending a hero on a Journey to Olympus.
text: 仁慈的赫拉賜予你這座大型紀念碑，獎勵你派遣英雄前往奧林匹斯。

original: The mighty Atlas awarded you after the great hero Widened the Strait, easing the passage between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
text: 偉大的英雄拓寬海峽，使地中海與大西洋之間的通行更加順暢，強大的阿特拉斯因此賜予你這份獎賞。

original: The goddess Hera rewarded you with this grand monument to commemorate a hero's journey to Olympus, and the hero's subsequent fall.
text: 女神赫拉賜予你這座大型紀念碑，紀念英雄前往奧林匹斯的旅程，以及英雄隨後的殞落。

original: The strong Atlas presented this grand monument to you after you sent a mighty hero to Widen the Strait between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
text: 你派遣強大的英雄拓寬地中海與大西洋之間的海峽，阿特拉斯因此贈予你這座大型紀念碑。

original: The all-powerful Zeus awarded you this monument so that people will always remember Zeus' kindness in helping to dispatch the enemy.
text: 全能的宙斯賜予你這座紀念碑，讓人們永遠記得他幫助消滅敵人的恩惠。

original: Poseidon, master of the ocean, gave this monument to you in thanks for finding the Cornerstone to his Sanctuary.
text: 海洋之主波賽東贈予你這座紀念碑，感謝你找回他聖所的基石。

original: The gentle goddess Demeter awarded you this monument in gratitude for harvesting the Argent Maize.
text: 溫柔的女神狄蜜特賜予你這座紀念碑，感謝你收割銀色玉米。

original: The sun-kissed god Apollo presented you with this monument to honor your skill in retrieving the Tablet of the Pact.
text: 光輝的阿波羅贈予你這座紀念碑，表彰你取回盟約石板的功績。

original: The huntress Artemis gave this monument to you to thank you for your help in gathering animals for the menagerie.
text: 狩獵女神阿緹蜜絲贈予你這座紀念碑，感謝你協助為獸苑捕捉動物。

original: The warlike Ares presented you with this token for your help in retrieving the missing piece of the great weapon.
text: 好戰的阿瑞斯贈予你這份紀念，感謝你找回強大武器遺失的部件。

original: Overjoyed with the Spring of Youth, Aphrodite excitedly presented you with this beautiful monument.
text: 愛芙羅黛蒂得到青春之泉後欣喜萬分，興奮地贈予你這座美麗的紀念碑。

original: The god of thieves, Hermes, presented you with this monument so that all may remember the time when a great hero stole some orichalc, weakening the defenses of your foe.
text: 盜賊之神荷米斯贈予你這座紀念碑，讓所有人記住偉大英雄偷走山銅、削弱敵方防禦的事蹟。

original: The wise goddess Athena donated this monument to the city in honor of the great hero who retrieved the Golden Bridle.
text: 智慧女神雅典娜將這座紀念碑贈予城市，表彰取回金韁繩的偉大英雄。

original: So that all may remember the glorious time when a crafty hero sabotaged a fearsome weapon, Hephaestus granted this monument to the city.
text: 赫菲斯托斯將這座紀念碑賜予城市，讓人們記住機智英雄破壞可怕武器的光榮事蹟。

original: Dionysus gleefully rewarded you with this monument, as thanks for helping to exploit the drunken chaos of your enemy and avenge the deaths of Dionysus' people, the Centaurs.
text: 狄俄尼索斯高興地賜予你這座紀念碑，感謝你趁敵人酒醉混亂時行動，為遭殺害的半人馬子民報仇。

original: To mark the occasion when a brave hero ventured to Olympus and stole some Ambrosia, Hades commissioned this fine monument.
text: 黑帝斯下令建造這座精美紀念碑，紀念勇敢的英雄冒險前往奧林匹斯偷取神食。

original: Hera gave this grand monument to your city in remembrance of the time that you sent a hero to help Hera distract Zeus.
text: 赫拉贈予城市這座大型紀念碑，紀念你派遣英雄協助她引開宙斯。

original: Atlas granted you this grand monument in remembrance of the happy time when you sent a strong hero to relieve Atlas of his burden.
text: 阿特拉斯賜予你這座大型紀念碑，紀念你派遣強大英雄減輕他重擔的美好時刻。

original: Hera gave this monument to your city in remembrance of the time that you sent a hero to help Hera distract Zeus.
text: 赫拉贈予城市這座紀念碑，紀念你派遣英雄協助她引開宙斯。

original: Atlas granted you this monument in remembrance of the happy time when you sent a strong hero to relieve Atlas of his burden.
text: 阿特拉斯賜予你這座紀念碑，紀念你派遣強大英雄減輕他重擔的美好時刻。

original: This ally leader's opinion of you is very high. As long as he has the supplies to spare, he will grant your requests for food or goods.
