original: A boat has arrived to unload goods, but there are no longshoremen there to unload the supplies. What a waste!
text: 有一艘商船到達了碼頭，可惜碼頭上沒有工人，因此無法卸貨。

original: This Pier lacks longshoremen, and it's taking them a long time to unload the supplies from the docked ship.  Wait until the union hears about this!
text: 這個碼頭缺少人手，他們得花很長時間才能把貨卸下來。

original: This Pier is missing a longshoreman or two.  The ship docked here will have to wait a little longer for all its supplies to be off-loaded.
text: 這個碼頭還缺一兩個人頭。停靠的商船得多等一會兒才能把貨都卸完。

original: The Pier has all the longshoremen it needs, and they are unloading supplies like there's no tomorrow.
text: 這個碼頭人手充足，他們正在全力以赴地幹活。

original: This Pier has no employees.  Hopefully, it will find some before a ship comes in to trade goods.
text: 這個碼頭沒有工人。希望在商船到來之前能找到哪怕幾個也好。

original: This Pier needs several more longshoremen.  If a ship comes in, it will take some time for the workers to unload it.
text: 這個碼頭需要更多工人。如果商船來了，他們需要很長時間才能把貨卸完。

original: This Pier lacks a few longshoremen. If a trade ship arrives, they'll take a little longer than usual to unload it.
text: 這個碼頭還缺幾個工人。如果商船來了，他們花的時間會比平時長一些。

original: A full staff of longshoremen is here, waiting with eager anticipation for the next trade ship to arrive.
text: 所有的工人都在急切地等待著下一艘商船的到達。

original: The Fishery sends out fishing boats to catch tasty fish.
text: 漁場派出渔船去捕捞美味的鲜鱼。

original: The fishermen are busy building a seaworthy boat.  Once they're finished with the boat, they'll sail the high seas in search of fish.
text: 渔人們正忙着打造一艘坚固的渔船。完工後他們就會乘风破浪打渔去了。

original: There is no place to dock a boat here.
text: 這裡沒有地方停泊渔船。

original: The Fishermen have set sail and are headed to the fishing grounds, waiting with baited breath to catch some fish.
text: 渔人們出海打渔去了，他們希望能够得到波賽東的保佑多捕些鱼回去。

original: The fishing boat is at the fishing grounds, and the fishermen are busy hauling in the catch.
text: 渔船到达了渔场，渔人們正忙着打捞捕获的鱼。

original: The Fishermen are making sure that they have everything they need before setting sail for the fishing grounds.
text: 渔人正在做出海前的最後检查，以保证不會出任何差错。

original: The fishing boat is laden with yummy fish and is sailing back to the Fishery.
text: 满载鲜鱼的渔船正在返航的途中。

original: The fishermen would love to go catch some fish, but there are no fishing grounds nearby.
text: 渔人們很愿意出去捕渔，但是這附近沒有渔场。

original: You ordered a halt to fishing.
text: 你下达了停止捕渔的命令。

original: Roasted fish, anyone? This Fishery is on fire and won't operate unless the fire is put out.
text: 有谁想尝烤鱼嗎？漁場着火了，在此期间无法正常运作。

original: This Fishery is cursed! Try as they might, the fishermen here cannot catch any fish, and they won't until the curse is lifted.
text: 渔类加工场被诅咒了！虽然渔人們仍在努力工作，但他們却连一条鱼都捕不到。

original: This Fishery is sanctified! Fish are willingly jumping into the boat, and the fishermen expect to haul in four baskets of fish instead of the usual one!
text: 渔类加工场被祝福了！鱼儿們心甘情愿地往船上跳。渔人們希望能捕到比平時多三倍的鱼！

original: The Palace is the heart of any city.  Without it, you cannot collect taxes nor can you muster military forces.
text: 宮殿是城市的中心。沒有宮殿，就無法徵稅或集結軍隊。

original: Fire! The Palace won't function properly until the fire is extinguished!
text: 著火了！除非火被撲滅，否則宮殿無法正常運作！

original: The Palace is cursed! Nothing good will come of it!
text: 宮殿被詛咒了！在此期間它不起作用了！

original: Superintendents from the Maintenance Office make sure surrounding buildings are in good repair.
text: 维修所派出的管理员能保证附近建筑的牢固。

original: The superintendent is just checking to make sure that he has the tools he needs before he goes patrolling.
text: 管理员正在為出巡做最後的准备。

original: This Maintenance Office has a full staff of superintendents, ready to keep the city's buildings in tip-top shape.
text: 這個维修所拥有充足的人手，他們能使城裡的建筑保持最佳状态。

original: This Maintenance Office doesn't have quite enough superintendents. They are doing the best they can, but some buildings in the area may not receive their services.
text: 這個维修所的人手并不是很充足，虽然他們仍然努力工作，但還是可能遗漏几座建筑。

original: This Maintenance Office does not have all the superintendents it needs. Buildings in the area could be more at risk.
text: 這個维修所還缺一些人手。這块区域内的建筑有倒塌的危险。

original: This Maintenance Office desperately needs more superintendents. The safety of the buildings in the neighborhood depends upon it!
text: 這個维修所需要更多的人手。附近建筑的安全都得靠他們啊！

original: Only one superintendent works here.  He's doing the best he can to care for buildings under the circumstances, but he can only do so much.
text: 只有一名管理员在這裡工作。虽然他已經尽力而為，但也只能做這麼多了。

original: This Maintenance Office has no superintendents and isn't maintaining anything!
text: 這個维修所一個工人也沒有，它无法完成日常维护工作。

original: Fire! The superintendents neglected to maintain their own building, and won't service any of the building in the neighborhood unless the fire is put out!
text: 着火了！管理员們只顾着维修自己的建筑，而无法為附近的建筑服务了！

original: The stonecutters are eager to start chiseling marble, but they either can't get to the quarry or there is no marble to be quarried.
text: 石匠迫不及待想開採大理石，但他們不是到不了採石場，就是已經沒有大理石可採。

original: The lumberjacks would gladly begin cutting down trees, but they either can't reach the forest or there are no trees.
text: 伐木工很想開始砍樹，但他們不是到不了森林，就是已經沒有樹木可砍。

original: The miners dream of mining silver, but they can't. Either something is blocking their path to the ore, or there isn't any ore.
text: 礦工想開採白銀卻無法工作，可能是通往礦藏的道路受阻，也可能根本沒有礦藏。

original: The miners here cannot make their way to the copper ore! There must be some obstacle in the way! Or maybe there is no copper ore!
text: 這裡的礦工無法抵達銅礦！一定有障礙擋路，也可能根本沒有銅礦！

original: The hunters here are resting because either there isn't any more prey to be found or they can't reach the animals.
text: 獵人正在休息，因為已經找不到獵物，或是無法到達動物所在的地方。

original: This Dairy has goatherds, but they can't find any goats.  Either no goats live in the city, or the goatherds can't reach the pasture.
text: 這座奶酪坊有牧羊人，卻找不到山羊。可能城裡沒有山羊，也可能牧羊人到不了牧場。

original: The shepherds are refusing to leave the Carding Shed.  Either no sheep live in the city, or the shepherds can't access the pasture.
text: 牧羊人不肯離開梳毛棚，可能城裡沒有綿羊，也可能他們到不了牧場。

original: The miners here are anxious to mine orichalc ore. Unfortunately, either their path to the ore is blocked, or there is no ore.
text: 這裡的礦工急著開採山銅，但通往礦藏的路被擋住，或是根本沒有礦藏。

original: The ranchers here would love to wrangle cattle. Regrettably, either no cattle live in the city or the ranchers can't reach them.
text: 這裡的牧牛人很想照料牛群，可惜城裡沒有牛，或是他們無法到達牛群所在的地方。

original: The Tax Office sends out clerks to squeeze tax money from the city's residents.
text: 稅務所派出税务官去居民家中收税。

original: The clerk is walking the city's streets, collecting money from all the houses he passes.
text: 税务官正沿着街道行走，向一路上的居民收税。

original: The clerk is getting ready to step out into the street and start collecting taxes. He's just checking his hair one last time.
text: 税务官最後梳理了一下他的头發，准备开始一天的工作了。

original: This Tax Office has all the clerks it needs to take the city's residents for all they're worth.
text: 這個稅務所拥有充足的人手，能够将全城居民的税都收上來。

original: This Tax Office is missing a few clerks. A few precious drachmas are slipping through the cracks!
text: 這個稅務所還缺一兩個人手。一些宝贵的银币流失了。

original: This Tax Office is understaffed, so some of the city's residents could be getting away with paying no taxes.
text: 這個稅務所人手不足，所以城裡有些居民可能逃脱了税收。

original: This Tax Office needs more clerks! It isn't collecting as many drachmas as it should be, and the Tax Office wrestling team is missing its heavy weight.
text: 這個稅務所需要更多的工人！否则税务官收税的速度将大打折扣。

original: This Tax Office hardly has any workers. Only a few drachmas are being collected, and the clerk is getting lonely.
text: 這個稅務所几乎沒有什麼工人。到現在為止一共也只收了几個钱，税务官自己都开始觉得寂寞了。

original: This Tax Office has no clerks to call its own and cannot collect any taxes.
text: 這個稅務所一個工人都沒有，无法履行收税的职能。

original: All the clerks are lollygagging about.  Without a Palace in the city, they cannot collect taxes.
text: 所有税务官都无所事事。沒有了宫殿，他們无法向居民收税。

original: This Tax Office isn't working because the Palace needs employees. With no supervisors around, the clerks aren't bothering to work.
text: 由于宫殿沒有工人，這個稅務所也不能正常运作。失去了监督者，税务官都不想干活了。

original: Fire! The clerks here have abandoned their posts and won't collect any taxes unless the fire is extinguished!
text: 着火了！所有税务官都逃了出去。除非你把火灭了，否则他們不愿再去收税了。

original: This building is sanctified! The surrounding neighborhood will pay double their normal taxes!
text: 這座建筑被祝福了！附近的居民心甘情愿地奉上双倍的税金！

original: People love oranges - it's like eating sunshine! Orange tenders from an Orange Tenders' Lodge pick the fruit when it's ripe.
text: 人們喜歡橘子，吃起來就像品嚐陽光！橘農從橘農小屋出發，在果實成熟時採收。

original: You have called a halt to orange tending.
text: 你已下令停止照料橘子樹。

original: The next orange harvest is in
text: 距離下次橘子收成還有

original: The Fountain's clean water is a favorite of residents of common housing.
text: 居民最喜歡喝噴泉裡干凈的泉水。

original: This Fountain has no water bearers at all! Without workers, the local residents will have nary a drop of water to drink.
text: 這座噴泉一個工人也沒有！附近的居民一滴水也喝不上。

original: Only a few water bearers are working at this Fountain. If the glamorous life of carrying a jug of water doesn't draw more workers soon, people could soon go without water.
text: 這座噴泉只有幾個工人。如果將清澈的泉水送到居民家中的工作不能吸引更多工人的話，附近的居民很快就要沒水喝了。

original: This Fountain is lacking several water bearers. Some residents could run out of water.
text: 這座噴泉還缺一些工人。有些居民家中可能會斷水。

original: This Fountain is missing a water bearer or two. The remaining water bearers are doing what they can to make sure that residents are getting the water they need.
text: 這座噴泉還缺一兩個工人。不過其餘的人仍然努力工作，以保證居民隨時都能喝上干凈的飲水。

original: With a full staff of water bearers, this Fountain's water is reaching as many people as it can.
text: 這座噴泉有充足的人手，他們正盡力為附近的居民服務。

original: Workers from the Refinery mine mysterious orichalc ore and transform it into magical metal.
text: 冶煉廠工人開採神秘的山銅礦石，將它煉成具有神奇力量的金屬。

original: You have instructed orichalc metallurgists to stop mining.
text: 你已下令讓山銅冶煉工停止採礦。

original: The Refinery is quiet. With no workers, it cannot produce orichalc.
text: 冶煉廠一片寂靜。沒有工人，就無法生產山銅。

original: The full staff of metallurgists here is producing orichalc as quickly as possible.
text: 這裡的冶煉工人數充足，正在以最快的速度生產山銅。

original: This Refinery could use a few more metallurgists. Orichalc production has slowed a little.
text: 這座冶煉廠還缺幾名冶煉工，山銅生產稍微放慢了。

original: This Refinery needs several more metallurgists. It is taking the staff a while to produce orichalc.
text: 這座冶煉廠需要更多冶煉工，生產山銅要花較長的時間。

original: Only a few metallurgists work here. It is taking a long time to convert orichalc ore into metal.
text: 這裡只有幾名冶煉工，把山銅礦石煉成金屬需要很長時間。

original: This Refinery is barely operational. It needs many more workers to produce orichalc efficiently.
text: 這座冶煉廠勉強維持運作，需要增加許多工人才能有效生產山銅。
神諭所？聖堂也在這兒嗎？

original: Fire! If a superintendent extinguishes the flames before the building collapses, the building will be saved.
text: 著火了！如果管理員不能及時將火撲滅的話，這座建築就要倒塌了。

original: Tender sprouts become full-grown stalks of wheat here.
text: 經过工人的劳动，种子在這裡生根發芽长成成熟的小麦。

original: You have shut the wheat industry off.
With no employees, the field is choked by weeds, and no wheat can grow.
text: 沒有工人的麦田上长满了野草，无法种植小麦。

original: This Wheat Farm has all the employees it needs to make sure that the wheat is healthy.
text: 這片麦田拥有充足的人手，保证能种出最多最好的小麦。

original: This Wheat Farm is short a few field hands. As a result, the harvest won't be quite as large as it could be.
text: 這片麦田還缺几個人手，所以收获的小麦也會稍微少一点。

original: This Wheat Farm is understaffed.  A few areas of the field have not been sown at all, and the harvest will be considerably smaller than it could be.
text: 這片麦田只有大约一半的人手，部分农田根本沒有被播种，所以收获的小麦也會比应该的要少很多。

original: This Wheat Farm has only a few farmhands.  They have only sown a small portion of the field, and the harvest will be paltry.
text: 這片麦田只有几個工人。他們只种了一小片田地，所以收获的小麦也只有很少了。

original: This Wheat Farm has so few employees that it can barely operate.  After the grim reaping, the farm will be lucky to produce even a sheaf of wheat.
text: 這片麦田几乎沒有什麼工人，如果它能收获一捆小麦的话就算是很幸运了。

original: This farmland has been damaged and nothing can grow on it. Perhaps its fertility will return with time.
text: 這片麦田已經种不出粮食了。也许过一段時间田地又會慢慢肥沃起來吧。

original: The next wheat harvest is in
The Onion Farm produces the yummy vegetable that makes people weep for joy.
text: 洋葱田能生產出讓人們高兴得流泪的美味蔬菜。

original: You have ordered onion production to stop.  Now there's a reason to cry!
text: 你下令禁止了洋葱的生產。現在後悔了吧！

original: Not a single onion will be grown on this farm if it doesn't find any workers.
text: 如果一個工人也沒有，洋葱是种不出來的。

original: This Onion Farm has all the employees it needs to produce potent, pungent onions.
text: 這片洋葱田拥有充足的人手，保证能种出最多最辛辣的洋葱來。

original: This Onion Farm is missing a few employees. The remaining workers are growing as many onions as they can, but the harvest will be a little smaller than average.
text: 這片洋葱田還缺几個人手，虽然所有的人都尽力工作但收成還是會少一点。

original: This Onion Farm needs more workers! Without enough employees, this Onion Farm cannot grow all the onions it could.
text: 這片洋葱田需要更多的人手！沒有足够工人的洋葱田无法生產出很多洋葱來。

original: Only a few workers are tending the onions on this farm. With so few employees, the farm will harvest only a scanty amount of onions.
text: 只有几個工人在這片洋葱田裡干活。他們的收成将只有很少。

original: Barely anyone works on this Onion Farm.  Only a handful of onions will be harvested from this farm.
text: 几乎沒有几個工人在這片洋葱田裡干活，他們只能收获几個洋葱。

original: This Onion Farm has been damaged, and no onions can grow here. Perhaps the land will one day become fertile again.
text: 這片洋葱田种不出洋葱了。也许过一段時间田地又會慢慢肥沃起來吧。

original: The next onion harvest is in
Crunchy carrots are born here on the Carrot Farm.
text: 這裡种植营养丰富的胡萝卜。

original: You have turned carrot production off.
text: 你禁止了胡萝卜的生成。

original: This Carrot Farm has no employees. No little carrot tops will poke their heads from under the ground.
text: 這個胡萝卜田一個工人也沒有，胡萝卜是不會自己從地裡冒出來的。

original: With a full staff, this Carrot Farm is as efficient as it can be.
text: 這片胡萝卜田拥有充足的人手，他們正以最快的速度种植胡萝卜。

original: This Carrot Farm is short a couple of employees. The farm's harvest won't be quite as large as it could be.
text: 這片胡萝卜田還缺几個人手，到收获的時候胡萝卜的產量肯定會减少。

original: Without enough workers, this Carrot Farm is not planting its entire field. The harvest from this farm will be small.
text: 這片胡萝卜田沒有足够的人手，部分田地還沒有用上。這裡的收成不會很好。

original: This Carrot Farm only has a few employees. They won't be able to bring in a very large harvest at all.
text: 這片胡萝卜田只有几個工人，他們不可能有很好的收成。

original: This Carrot Farm has far too few employees. It's all they can do to keep the rabbits away. The harvest will be quite tiny indeed.
text: 這片胡萝卜田的人手实在太少了，他們能做的只是不讓兔子來偷吃仅有的那一点收成。

original: This Carrot Farm's land has been damaged somehow, and nothing can grow on it. The field may regain its fertility with time.
text: 這片胡萝卜田种不出胡萝卜了。也许过一段時间田地又會慢慢肥沃起來吧。

original: The next carrot harvest is in
All of the world loves olives!  Growers from the Growers' Lodge pick olives off the trees at harvest time.
text: 所有的希腊人都喜欢橄榄！园丁小屋内的工人负责在橄榄成熟時把它們摘下來。
人手充足，生產效率达到最高
人手稍缺，生產效率有所下降
人手不足，生產效率下降
人手严重不足，生產效率严重下降
人手极度不足，生產效率极度下降

original: Farm damaged - needs time to recover.
text: 田地贫瘠，需要時间恢复

original: The next olive harvest is in
Growers from the Growers' Lodge pick grapes from the vine. I bet you wondered how I knew that.
text: 园丁小屋内的工人负责照看和采摘葡萄。
人手充足，生產效率达到最高
人手稍缺，生產效率有所下降
人手不足，生產效率下降
人手严重不足，生產效率严重下降
人手极度不足，生產效率极度下降

original: Land damaged - needs time to recover.
text: 田地贫瘠，需要時间恢复

original: The next grape harvest is in
The Foundry sends out miners to collect copper ore and then smelts the ore into bronze.
text: 铸造场派出矿工去开采铜矿石再把它們炼成青铜。

original: You felt that smelting should halt.
This Foundry has no employees and is producing no bronze.
text: 這個铸造场沒有工人，无法冶炼青铜。

original: With a full staff, this Foundry is smelting away, producing bronze as quickly as it can.
text: 這個铸造场拥有充足的人手，它正以最快的速度冶炼青铜。

original: This Foundry is missing a few employees, and bronze production has slowed a little.
text: 這個铸造场還缺几個工人，青铜的冶炼速度有所下降。

original: This Foundry needs several more employees and cannot produce bronze very quickly at all.
text: 這個铸造场需要更多的人手，否则无法加快青铜冶炼的速度。

original: This Foundry desperately needs more workers. Its productivity has plummeted.
text: 這個铸造场急需更多的工人，它的生產效率正直线下降。

original: This Foundry hardly has any workers at all. Bronze production has slowed to a crawl
text: 這個铸造场几乎沒有什麼人手，青铜的冶炼速度像蜗牛爬一样。

original: The Shop sends out stonecutters to quarry a huge slab of marble which is then fashioned into usable slabs.
text: 加工场派出采石工人到采石场开采出巨大的石料，再加工成可以使用的石块。

original: You have shut off marble quarrying.
text: 你关闭了加工场的生產。

original: All is quiet at the Shop. With no employees, marble cannot be quarried.
text: 一切都静悄悄的。沒有工人的加工场无法采集石料。

original: This Shop has all the workers it needs. It is producing marble as efficiently as it can.
text: 這個加工场拥有充足的人手，他們正以最快的速度生產大理石。

original: This Shop is short a few workers. It is still chiseling out marble, but not quite as quickly as it could.
text: 這個加工场還缺几個人手，虽然工人們仍在干活，但总的效率有所下降。

original: This Shop needs several more workers. Marble production has slowed considerably.
text: 這個加工场需要更多的人手，生產大理石的效率已經下降很多了。

original: The few stonecutters working here are about to lose their marbles. They work hard all day but still manage to produce very little marble.
text: 這裡区区几個工人快跟不上了。虽然他們仍然努力工作，但只能生產很少的大理石。

original: This Shop hardly works at all! It needs many more employees if it is to produce marble efficiently and quickly.
text: 這個加工场几乎已經不能正常运作了！它需要更多的工人才能生產大理石。

original: The Shop is waiting for a fresh block of marble from the quarry.
text: 加工场正在等待采石场的石料。

original: The Mint sends miners to collect silver ore and converts it into cold, hard drachmas.
text: 铸币场派出矿工去开采银矿石再把它們加工成银币。

original: You have turned off the Mint industry. Do you really mean to say no to free money?
text: 你关闭了铸币场。你真的不想要這些钱了嗎？

original: All is quiet at the Mint. With no employees, silver cannot be turned into money.
text: 一切都静悄悄的。沒有工人的铸币场无法进行生產。

original: With a full staff, coins are being minted from silver at peak efficiency.
text: 這個铸币场拥有充足的人手，他們正以最快的速度将银子铸成银币。

original: This Mint could use a few more employees. Coin production has slowed a bit.
text: 這個铸币场還需要几個工人。钱币的生產速度有所下降。

original: This Mint doesn't have enough employees. It is still operating, but it is making drachmas at a reduced rate.
text: 這個铸币场沒有足够的工人。它仍在运作，但是钱币的生產速度已經下降。

original: With so few workers, it is taking a very long time to turn silver into drachmas.
text: 只有這麼点工人的铸币场需要很长時间才能把银子铸成银币。

original: This Mint is horribly understaffed. It will still produce drachmas, but it will take a very, very long time.
text: 這個铸币场严重人手不足，它需要很长時间才能铸出几块银币出來。

original: Workers at the Mint are waiting for miners to return with silver ore.
text: 铸币场的工人正在等矿工把银矿石带回來。
将银子铸成银币的工作

original: The Timber Mill sends lumberjacks out to cut down trees and then processes the logs into planks.
text: 伐木场派出伐木工将大树砍倒，然後再加工成木材。

original: With no lumberjacks, this Timber Mill does not work.
text: 沒有工人的伐木场不能正常运作。

original: All the lumberjacks are okay here and busily cutting down trees and hewing out planks.
text: 所有的伐木工都在忙着砍树伐木。

original: This Timber Mill is short a lumberjack or two. The lumberjacks this mill does have are working their hardest, but timber production has slowed a little.
text: 這個伐木场還缺一兩個人手，虽然其余的人都努力工作但生產效率還是有所下降。

original: This Timber Mill is understaffed. The lumberjacks are cutting down trees very slooowly.
text: 這個伐木场人手不足，伐木的速度明显下降。

original: Not nearly enough lumberjacks work at this Timber Mill. Productivity is way down.
text: 這個伐木场人手严重不足，生產效率严重下降。

original: This Timber Mill needs many more lumberjacks to operate efficiently. It will still produce timber, but at a snail's pace.
text: 這個伐木场人手极度不足，伐木的速度慢得就像蜗牛爬一样。

original: At the Dairy, goatherds turn milk into glorious cheese.
text: 在奶品场裡，牧羊人将羊奶做成奶酪。

original: You have turned the cheese-making industry off.
text: 你已經将奶品场关闭了。

original: This Dairy has no goatherds. Any goats in the city are running free with udders full of milk.
text: 這個奶品场沒有牧羊人，所有的山羊都在到处乱跑。

original: This Dairy has all the goatherds it needs. Curds are separated from whey and made into cheese at maximum efficiency.
text: 這個奶品场拥有充足的工人，他們正以最快的速度生產奶酪。

original: This Dairy doesn't quite have a full staff of goatherds. Some goats are missing their daily milking, and it is taking longer to make a full wheel of cheese.
text: 這個奶品场的人手并不是很充足，有些山羊沒有人去挤奶，而奶酪的生產速度也有所下降。

original: This Dairy needs more goatherds. Cheese making is taking longer than it should.
text: 這個奶品场還需要一些人手。生成奶酪的速度比原本要慢。

original: This Dairy needs many more goatherds. Many of the goats in the field are swollen with milk, but the small staff here can only milk so many of them.
text: 這個奶品场需要更多的人手，很多山羊都沒有人去挤奶，但是這裡仅有的几個牧羊人只能做這麼多了。

original: This Dairy is severely understaffed. Cheese production has slowed to a crawl.
text: 這個奶品场严重人手不足。奶酪的生成速度慢得就像蜗牛爬一样。

original: Vintners crush grapes into wine, the favored beverage of the elite class.
text: 工人們在這裡将葡萄酿成美酒，供给上层阶级饮用。

original: This Winery has no employees. No wine can be made here.
text: 這個酒坊沒有工人，无法酿酒。

original: This Winery has a full staff and is busy fermenting wine and pouring it into amphorae.
text: 這個酒坊拥有充足的人手，他們正忙着把酿好的酒倒入罐子中。

original: This Winery could use a few more workers. Wine is still being produced, but at a slightly reduced rate.
text: 這個酒坊還可以再多一兩個人手，否则酿酒的速度會受到影响。

original: Productivity at this Winery is down. It needs more workers to crush grapes at maximum efficiency.
text: 這個酒坊的生產效率不高。它需要更多的工人才能以最快的速度酿酒。

original: This Winery needs more vintners. Wine production has slowed, and the workers here may soon foment a revolt if they don't get more help.
text: 這個酒坊的需要更多的人手，這裡的生產效率很低，而工人也已經开始抱怨了。

original: The few workers here are beginning to whine. Without more help, it will take a long time before the wine is ready to be sold.
text: 這裡仅有的几個工人已經快撑不住了。他們要花很长時间才能酿出一罐酒來。

original: This Winery needs grapes in order to produce wine.
text: 這個酒坊需要葡萄才能开始酿酒。

original: Shepherds from the Carding Shed cut fleece from sheep and prepare it for use.
text: 羊毛场的牧羊人将绵羊身上的毛剪下來以供後用。

original: You have ordered a halt to fleece production.
text: 你已經将羊毛场关闭了。

original: With no employees, the Carding Shed cannot operate, and any sheep in the area are roaming the countryside with long, flowing wool.
text: 沒有工人的羊毛场无法正常运作，所有的绵羊都留着长长的羊毛在四处乱跑。

original: A full staff of shepherds means sheep are shorn of their wool at breakneck speeds.
text: 這個羊毛场拥有充足的人手，他們正在飞快地替绵羊剪羊毛。

original: This Carding Shed could use another shepherd or two.  The Shed is still producing fleece, but not quite as quickly as it could be.
text: 這個羊毛场還需要一兩個人手。它仍然在生產羊毛，不过速度有所下降。

original: This Carding Shed needs more workers. Sheep are frolicking in the fields with no fear of losing their wool in the near future.
text: 這個羊毛场需要更多的工人，很多绵羊都沒有人去剪羊毛。

original: This Carding Shed needs many more workers, and fleece production has slowed considerably.
text: 這個羊毛场严重人手不足，羊毛的生產速度严重下降。

original: This Carding Shed has very few shepherds in its employ. The sheep can count on keeping their fleece for a while.
text: 這個羊毛场的工人实在太少了，羊毛都沒有人剪了。

original: Here, bronze is cast into strong implements of war.
text: 青铜在這裡被打造成战斗用的防具。

original: You have decreed that armor production cease.
text: 你下令停止了防具铺的生產。

original: Without any employees, no armor can be produced at this Armory.
text: 沒有工人的防具铺无法生產出盔甲來。

original: This Armory has all the workers it needs and is rapidly producing armor.
text: 這個防具铺人手充足，正以最快的速度生產盔甲。

original: This Armory could use another worker or two.  Armor production has slowed slightly.
text: 這個防具铺還需要一兩個人手，盔甲的生產速度有所下降。

original: This Armory is understaffed. It is still producing armor, but at a much reduced rate.
text: 這個防具铺需要更多的人手，他們的生產速度已經下降了。

original: This Armory doesn't have nearly enough workers.  The workers that are here are working as hard as they can, but armor production has slowed considerably.
text: 這個防具铺沒有足够的工人，虽然其余的人都努力工作，但是盔甲的生產還是受到了很大的影响。

original: This Armory has very few employees. Armor is being produced here at an excruciatingly slow pace.
text: 這個防具铺的工人实在太少了，盔甲的生產速度变得极慢。

original: This Armory doesn't have enough bronze to produce armor.
text: 這個防具铺沒有足够的青铜來制造盔甲。

original: Here, olives are crushed into olive oil, a favorite good of all citizens.
text: 橄榄在這裡被榨成最受市民喜欢的商品橄榄油。

original: You have shut down the olive oil industry.
text: 你已經停止了油坊的生產。

original: Without employees, this Olive Press can make no olive oil.
text: 沒有工人的油坊无法生產橄榄油。

original: This Olive Press is fully staffed and making olive oil as quickly as it can.
text: 這個油坊拥有充足的人手，他們正在全力以赴地生產橄榄油。

original: This Olive Press needs a couple more workers. It is still making olive oil, but not quite as quickly as it could.
text: 這個油坊還需要几個人手，他們仍然在生產橄榄油，不过不像原本那麼快。

original: This Olive Press doesn't have all the workers it needs. Olive oil production has slowed.
text: 這個油坊人手不足，橄榄油的生產效率已經下降了。

original: With only a few workers, this Olive Press isn't producing very much olive oil at all.
text: 只有几個工人的油坊无法生產出很多橄榄油來。

original: This Olive Press barely has workers at all. It is taking quite some time for it to produce olive oil.
text: 這個油坊几乎沒有什麼工人，它需要很长時间才能生產出一罐橄榄油出來。

original: This Olive Press needs olives before it can make olive oil.
text: 這個油坊需要橄榄才能制造橄榄油。

original: Here, bronze is melted and poured into molds to make gorgeous sculptures.
text: 在這裡，熔化了的青铜被灌入模子，制成雕像。

original: You have shut this industry down.
text: 你已經停止了铸像场的生產。

original: This Sculpture Studio is casting about for employees.  With no employees, it can't make any sculptures.
text: 這座铸像场正在寻找工人。沒有工人的铸像场无法生產雕像。

original: This Sculpture Studio has all the artists it needs to make sculpture quickly and skillfully.
text: 這座铸像场拥有充足的人手，正在以最快的速度生產雕像。

original: This Sculpture Studio needs a few more artists. It is taking a little longer than it should to craft fine sculptures.
text: 這座铸像场還需要几個人手，它制作雕像的速度稍有下降。

original: This Sculpture Studio is understaffed. The artists are complaining about the conditions, and sculpture production has slowed.
text: 這座铸像场只有大约一半的人手。工人們正在抱怨忙不过來，雕像的制作速度有所下降。

original: This Sculpture Studio needs several more workers. It is taking some time for the artists here to produce high-quality art.
text: 這座铸像场還需要一些工人，這裡的工匠得花一些時间才能制作出高质量的產品來。

original: This Sculpture Studio needs many more artists. It is barely turning out any sculptures at all.
text: 這座铸像场需要更多的人手。它几乎已經停止生產了。

original: This Sculpture Studio doesn't have enough bronze to produce sculpture.
text: 這座铸像场沒有足够的青铜來制作雕像。

original: A clerk has not visited to collect the tax.
Residents here are happy with the city.
text: 這裏的居民對城市很滿意。

original: A few residents are dissatisfied with the city.
text: 有些居民對城市稍有不滿。

original: Residents grumble a little about the city.
Many of the residents are unhappy with the city.
Residents here are perturbed by city conditions.
text: 居民對城市狀況大爲不滿。

original: Residents here are angry over city conditions.
text: 居民對城市狀況非常不滿。

original: Residents here are fuming over city conditions.
text: 居民對城市狀況極爲不滿。

original: The residents of this home forage the land for food.
text: 這裏的居民正四處尋找食物。

original: This house is devolving due to low appeal.
text: 由於環境問題，這幢房屋將要退化。

original: This house will devolve soon. It has lost access to clean water from a Fountain.
text: 這幢房屋很快就要退化，它失去了乾淨的水源。

original: This house will devolve soon. There aren't enough cultural pursuits in the area
text: 這幢房屋很快就要退化，它的周圍沒有足夠的文化設施。

original: Unless more food is delivered soon, this house will soon devolve.
text: 如果食物不能儘快送到的話，這幢房屋很快就要退化了。

original: This house has lost access to a Stadium and will soon devolve.
text: 這幢房屋失去了與露天運動場的通路，很快就要退化了。

original: There is no more wine in this house to drink. Unless some is delivered soon, the house will devolve.
text: 如果葡萄酒不能儘快送到的話，這幢房屋就要退化了。

original: This house is devolving. It needs some fleece.
text: 這幢房屋正在退化，它需要一些羊毛。

original: This house will soon devolve if it does not receive more olive oil.
text: 如果橄欖油不能儘快送到的話，這幢房屋很快就要退化了。

original: My household for a horse, the residents cry.  This house will devolve soon if no horses are delivered.
text: 如果馬匹不能儘快送到的話，這幢房屋很快就要退化了。

original: If this house does not receive more armor, it will devolve.
text: 如果盔甲不能儘快送到的話，這幢房屋很快就要退化了。

original: The residents of this house have everything they need.
text: 這幢房屋內的居民應有盡有。

original: This house cannot evolve. Some of the buildings in the area have reduced the neighborhood's appeal.
text: 這幢房屋無法升級。周圍有一些建築破壞了這裏的環境。

original: This house cannot evolve until the appeal of the neighborhood increases.
text: 這幢房屋無法升級，除非周圍環境得到改善。

original: The parched residents of this house need water if this house is to evolve.
text: 這幢房屋需要水源才能升級。

original: This house needs access to more culture venues in order to evolve.
text: 這幢房屋周圍需要有更多的文化設施才能升級。

original: The residents of this house need food from an Agora before the house can improve.
text: 這幢房屋的居民需要得到市場送來的食物才能升級。

original: The residents of this house need access to a Stadium before the house can evolve.
text: 這幢房屋的居民需要有連接露天運動場的道路才能升級。

original: The residents of this house want wine to drink.
text: 這幢房屋的居民需要葡萄酒。

original: This house cannot evolve unless a peddler delivers some fleece.
text: 這幢房屋無法升級，除非商販送一些羊毛過來。

original: This house cannot evolve until its residents receive some olive oil from a peddler.
text: 這幢房屋無法升級，除非能從商販那兒得到一些橄欖油。

original: This house needs horses to evolve.
text: 這幢房屋需要馬匹才能升級。

original: The residents of this house can't make improvements until they receive some armor.
text: 這幢房屋必須得到一些盔甲才能升級。

original: The residents of this house are making improvements right now.
This house is waiting for residents to move in.
text: 這幢房屋正在等待住戶的入住。

original: This house will devolve soon. There isn't enough scientific activity in the area.
text: 附近科學活動不足，這幢房屋即將退化。

original: No curator has passed this house recently, and it will soon deteriorate.
text: 最近沒有博物館員到訪，這幢房屋即將退化。

original: Residents here need to be taught by more scientists before they'll improve their home.
text: 居民需要更多科學家的教導，才會改善住宅。

original: A curator needs to teach the residents of this house before it can evolve.
text: 博物館員必須教導這裡的居民，住宅才能升級。

original: If the residents here don't receive more chariots, their home will deteriorate.
text: 若未獲得更多戰車，這幢房屋即將退化。

original: Residents here won't improve their home unless they receive chariots from a peddler.
text: 居民必須從商販取得戰車，才會改善住宅。

original: This plot is eagerly awaiting a resident to move in.
text: 這個地方正等着有人遷入。

original: This plot is too far away from the road.

text: 已經拋錨，正在等待港口空出船位
已經停靠，正在買賣商品
正向某個城市的港口航去

original: Heading to a city Trading Post
text: 正前往某個城市的貿易站

original: Nothing to trade here, just passing through
text: 這裡沒有東西好交易，只是經過而已
送貨工正在將貨物運送過來。

original: Deliverymen are getting and distributing goods.
text: 送貨工正在將貨物運送出去。
送貨工正在等待你的指示。
送貨工正在將食物運送過來。
送貨工正在將食物運送出去。
送貨工正在等待你的指示。

original: Deliverymen are getting goods to export.
text: 送貨工正在將貨物送去出口。
送貨工正在運送進口貨物。
送貨工正在等待你的指示。

original: This granary cannot accept any more food.
text: 這座糧倉已經裝不下更多糧食了。

original: Trade by sea is shut down for now
Trade by land is shut down for now
With no workers, this Sanctuary cannot function at all.
text: 這座聖所沒有工人，無法正常運作。

original: This Sanctuary lacks a few priests. No sacrifices can be conducted.
text: 這座聖所還缺幾個祭司，他們不能像平時那麼勤快地外出尋找祭品。

original: This Sanctuary is understaffed. There aren't enough priests to conduct sacrifices.
text: 這座聖所人手不足，祭司們不常出去尋找祭品。

original: This Sanctuary has only a few priests. They have no time to conduct sacrifices.
text: 這座聖所只有幾個祭司，他們很少有時間出去尋找祭品。

original: This Sanctuary hardly has any workers. Its few priests do not have time to conduct sacrifices.
text: 這座聖所幾乎沒有祭司，他們都忙著維護聖所，沒有時間出去尋找祭品。

original: This Sanctuary is inactive. Sacrifices must be performed here for the Sanctuary to function.
text: 這座聖所沒有在起作用。必須要有舉行獻祭才能讓它正常運作。

original: Our priests are out looking for suitable sacrifices.
text: 我們的祭司正在尋找合適的祭品。

original: We are conducting sacrifices right now.
This Sanctuary is active for another
Our priests are not looking for sacrifices right now.
text: 我們的祭司現在沒有在尋找祭品。
向偉大的阿緹蜜絲祈禱

original: Zeus has heard your prayers! Zeus will personally trounce an invading army on your behalf!
text: 宙斯聽見了你的祈禱！他將親自替你消滅一支入侵的部隊。

original: Poseidon, in his vast kindness, has responded to your prayer! Your city will be blessed with an abundance of seafood!
text: 仁慈的波賽東回應了你的祈禱！你的城市將被賜予極其豐富的海產品！

original: Demeter has responded to your pitiful cry! She will provide you with a Granary's worth of food!
text: 狄蜜特聽見了你可憐的呼喊！她將賜予你滿滿一糧倉的食物！

original: The shining Apollo has granted your request! He will cure all illnesses in the city!
text: 金光閃閃的阿波羅準許了你的請求！他將把城裡所有人的病痛都治癒！

original: The chaste huntress Artemis has heard your prayer! Soon, she will deliver a plentiful supply of meat to your Granaries!
text: 狩獵女神阿緹蜜絲聽見了你的祈禱！很快她就會送給你大量的肉食！

original: The martial Ares has responded to your plea! He will go to war with your soldiers!
text: 戰神阿瑞斯回應了你的祈求！他將與你的士兵並肩作戰！

original: Your prayers have stirred Aphrodite's heart. If there is room, more people will soon call your city home!
text: 你的祈禱打動了愛芙羅黛蒂的心。如果還有地方住的話，不久就會有很多人搬到你城裡來了！

original: The swift Hermes has heard your prayers! He will fulfill an outstanding request on your city!
text: 行動迅速的荷米斯聽見了你的祈禱！他會替你完成一個別的城市發來的請求！

original: The wise Athena has answered yes to your plea. A bounty of olives and olive oil will soon be yours!
text: 智慧女神雅典娜答應了你的請求。一大批橄欖和橄欖油馬上就會是你的了！

original: Hephaestus has heard your prayers! His fearsome Talos will soon protect your city!
text: 赫菲斯托斯聽見了你的祈禱！他可怕的手下塔洛斯很快就會來保衛你的城市了！

original: The festive Dionysus has granted your request! Wine will flow in your city!
text: 酒神狄俄尼索斯答應了你的請求！很快你的城裡就會有喝不完的美酒了！

original: Hades has heard your plea! Your coffers will soon grow!
text: 黑帝斯聽見了你的請求！你金庫裡的錢馬上就會多出來了！

original: Hera has heard your prayer! Soon, the city's Agoras will not want for supplies!
text: 赫拉聽見了你的祈禱！城裡的市場很快就不再缺少物資！

original: Atlas has responded to your cry! Artisans at a construction project will find that they have the supplies they need!
text: 阿特拉斯回應了你的呼喊！工地上的工匠將得到所需的材料！

original: Zeus has heard your prayer to strike down an enemy, but can't fulfill it yet. He will when the opportunity presents itself.
text: 宙斯聽見了你請求他消滅敵人的祈禱，但是暫時無法滿足你。等到時機成熟的時候再說吧。

original: Poseidon has heard your prayer, but you don't have the room for more food. He might fulfill your prayer later.
text: 波賽東聽見了你的祈禱，但是你已經沒有地方能夠容納更多食物了。也許下次他會滿足你吧。

original: Demeter has heard your prayer, but you don't have the room for more food. She might fulfill your prayer later.
text: 狄蜜特聽見了你的祈禱，但是已經沒有地方能夠容納更多食物了。也許下次她會滿足你吧。

original: Apollo has heard your prayer to heal your sick, but can't fulfill it yet. He will when he gets an opportunity.
text: 阿波羅聽見了你請求他治理疾病的祈禱，但是暫時無法滿足你。等下一次有機會再說吧。

original: Artemis has heard your prayer, but she can't fulfill it. She'll fulfill your prayer later if she can.
text: 阿緹蜜絲聽見了你的祈禱，但是她現在無法滿足你，也許過一段時間吧。

original: Ares has heard your prayer and is eager to go to war with your soldiers. He will go at the next available opportunity.
text: 阿瑞斯聽見了你的祈禱，渴望與你的士兵並肩作戰。下次有機會他就會出征。

original: Aphrodite has heard your prayer for more people, but can't fulfill it at this time. She might fulfill it later.
text: 愛芙羅黛蒂聽見了你的祈禱，但是她現在無法滿足你。也許下一次就可以了吧。

original: Hermes has heard your prayer, but there are no outstanding requests on your city. He might fulfill your prayer later.
text: 荷米斯聽見了你的祈禱，但是城裡沒有接到什麼重要的請求。也許過一段時間他能滿足你吧。

original: Athena has heard your prayer, but you don't have the room for olive oil and olives. She might fulfill your prayer later.
text: 雅典娜聽見了你的祈禱，但是你的城裡放不下更多橄欖和橄欖油了。也許下次她會滿足你吧。

original: Hephaestus has heard your prayer for Talos' aid, but can't fulfill it yet. He will at the next opportunity.
text: 赫菲斯托斯聽見了你請求塔洛斯援助的祈禱，但是他現在不能幫你。下一次有機會的話他就會幫你了。

original: Dionysus has heard your prayer, but you don't have the room for wine. He might fulfill your prayer later.
text: 狄俄尼索斯聽見了你的祈禱，但是你已經沒有地方存放酒了。也許下一次他會滿足你的吧。

original: Hades has heard your prayer for more money, but can't fulfill it yet. He will at the next opportunity.
text: 黑帝斯聽見了你請求他給你金錢的祈禱，但是他現在不能滿足你。也許下次有機會他會滿足你的吧。

original: Hera has heard your prayer for more supplies, but she can't fulfill it now. She will at the next opportunity
text: 赫拉聽見了你請求更多物資的祈禱，但現在無法滿足。下次有機會她就會幫忙。

original: Atlas has heard your prayer, but he can't help you now. He will as soon as he gets the chance.
text: 阿特拉斯聽見了你的祈禱，但現在無法幫忙。他一有機會就會協助你。

original: Zeus is in no mood to hear another one of your prayers. Maybe he'll be more agreeable later.
text: 宙斯現在沒有心情再來聽你的祈禱，也許過一段時間吧。

original: Poseidon distinctly remembers answering one of your prayers not too long ago. He won't grant you another blessing yet.
text: 波賽東清楚地記得他前不久才回應過你的祈禱。他現在還不想再次滿足你。

original: Demeter has denied your request. Don't pester her too often.
text: 狄蜜特拒絕了你的請求，不要沒事又去打擾她。

original: Apollo has ignored your plea. He cured your citizens not too long ago, and you can't always expect him to solve your health crises.
text: 阿波羅將你的請求拋到腦後。他前不久才為你的市民治過病，你不能總希望他來解決你的健康問題。

original: Artemis has refused you. She procured some meat not too long ago and doesn't want to overhunt the stock.
text: 阿緹蜜絲拒絕了你。她不久前才為你送來了肉食，她不想過分獵殺動物。

original: Ares has denied your prayer. He's still repairing the weapons he damaged from the last time he went to war for you.
text: 阿瑞斯拒絕了你的祈禱。他還在修理上次為你作戰時損壞的武器。

original: Aphrodite loves you, but not enough to constantly answer your prayers. Do not ask her for too much.
text: 愛芙羅黛蒂很喜歡你，不過還沒有到會不停滿足你的請求的地步。不要要求太高了。

original: Hermes has rejected your latest plea. He helped you not too long ago and can't always be there for you when you need him.
text: 荷米斯拒絕了你最後這次請求。他不久前才幫過你，你不能指望每次你求他的時候他都在那裡。

original: Athena won't grant you any olives or olive oil for the time being. Perhaps you should try again later.
text: 雅典娜現在不願意給你橄欖或橄欖油。得過段時間再試試吧。

original: Hephaestus is too busy in his forge to grant your request. Plus, he loaned you Talos not that long ago.
text: 赫菲斯托斯現在很忙，沒有時間回應你的祈禱。另外，他不久以前才派塔洛斯來援助過你。

original: Dionysus is off partying somewhere and won't fulfill your prayer. You might have better luck later.
text: 狄俄尼索斯到什麼地方參加酒會去了，無法滿足你的祈禱。過一段時間再試試吧。

original: Hades has grumbled a surly 'No' to your prayer. He filled your coffers not too long ago.
text: 黑帝斯皺著眉頭說了聲“不”。他前不久才剛剛給過你錢。

original: Hera has screamed 'No' to your prayer. She restocked your Agoras not too long ago.
text: 赫拉大聲拒絕了你的祈禱，她不久前才為你的市場補充過物資。

original: Atlas grumbled 'No' to your latest plea. He just helped your artisans a short time ago!
text: 阿特拉斯不耐煩地拒絕了你的請求，他不久前才幫過你的工匠！

original: Zeus will protect your city from invaders in time of need.
text: 宙斯會在需要的時候保護你的城市不被入侵。

original: Poseidon will haul in a catch of fresh seafood, if there is any in the city, when your citizens are hungry.
text: 如果你的城市正遭受饑餓，而城裡的食物又不多了，波賽東會為你帶來足夠的海產品。

original: Demeter will harvest food for you when your citizens have none.
text: 如果你的市民沒有了食物，狄蜜特會為你送來。

original: Apollo will cure what ails your city's residents.
text: 阿波羅會治癒城市居民的病痛。

original: If any prey animals live in your city, Artemis will hunt them on your behalf when your city needs food.
text: 如果你城市附近有野豬的話，阿緹蜜絲會獵殺它們為你的城市提供食物。

original: Ares will march to war with your soldiers.
text: 阿瑞斯會同你的士兵一起去作戰。

original: Aphrodite will fill the city's houses with people when the city's housing is vacant.
text: 如果城裡有空房子的話，愛芙羅黛蒂會為你召來足夠的居民。

original: Hermes will fulfill a request for supplies on your behalf.
text: 荷米斯會替你完成一個別的城市的請求。

original: Athena will make a gift of olives and olive oil when your city is lacking.
text: 雅典娜會送一批橄欖和橄欖油給你的城市。

original: Hephaestus will instruct Talos to defend your city from harm.
text: 赫菲斯托斯會派塔洛斯來幫助你的城市不受敵人侵犯。

original: Dionysus will provide wine from his very own casks when your city needs it.
text: 狄俄尼索斯會在你需要的時候給你送上美酒。

original: Hades will deposit drachmas in your treasury when you need funds.
text: 黑帝斯會在你需要的時候給你一筆錢。

original: Hera will restock your Agoras when they are running low on supplies.
text: 市場物資不足時，赫拉會為它們補充貨物。

original: Atlas will help with a construction project.
text: 阿特拉斯會協助建築工程。

original: Zeus' Stronghold will endow your city with an Oracle. Zeus himself will protect you from all other Olympians, and you will earn respect throughout the world for worshiping the Master of Olympus.
text: 宙斯的聖所將賜予你城市一個神諭所。宙斯將親自保護你不受別的奧林匹斯神的威脅，而你也將因為供奉奧林匹斯之主而受到全希臘人民的尊敬。

original: When you honor Poseidon with a Sanctuary, the Kraken will patrol your waters and defeat any adversaries he meets. Your fishermen and urchin gatherers will find their work easier and produce more food for the city.
text: 有了波賽東的聖所在你城中，海妖將在你的海面上巡邏，擊退任何來犯的敵人。另外你的漁人們能夠輕易地打到更多的海產品。

original: The Garden of Demeter is surrounded by fertile fields, which can be planted with crops and support livestock.
text: 狄蜜特的聖所周圍是肥沃的田地，能夠種植糧食，飼養牲畜。

original: By building Oracle of Apollo, you will be able to see the future by consulting the Oracle. Your city's contestants stand a greater chance of winning the pan-Hellenic Games, and Apollo will defend your borders against monsters.
text: 建造阿波羅神諭所後，你可以通過神諭預知未來。你城市的競技者在泛希臘運動會中獲勝的機會更大，阿波羅還會保護邊境免受怪獸侵擾。

original: Two companies of fierce Amazons reside within Artemis' Menagerie, and they will help you in any of your military pursuits. Artemis herself will hunt down predatory animals in your city.
text: 兩隊驍勇的亞馬遜人住在阿緹蜜絲的聖所中，他們會在你所有的軍事行動中幫助你。而阿緹蜜絲自己會為你獵殺城市附近的食肉動物。

original: With Ares' Fortress in the city, two savage companies of warriors will serve you as loyally as they serve Ares. Sometimes Ares' Dragon will even engage an enemy he spots during his forays around your city.
text: 城中有阿瑞斯聖所，就會有兩隊勇猛的戰士效忠於你，如同效忠阿瑞斯一般。阿瑞斯的龍在城中巡遊時，有時也會攻擊發現的敵人。

original: No one wants to leave a city that hosts Aphrodite. Emigration ceases when Aphrodite's Haven is in the city, and the city itself becomes more attractive. Aphrodite will also dissuade Hephaestus, Ares, Hermes and Dionysus from doing harm to your city should they invade.
text: 有愛芙羅黛蒂的聖所在城裡，就沒有人想要遷移出去了，而整個城市都會變得更吸引人。如果赫菲斯托斯，阿瑞斯，荷米斯或狄俄尼索斯來進攻城市的話，愛芙羅黛蒂也會奉勸他們離去。

original: When Hermes' Refuge is in the city, the city's deliverymen, inspired by his speed, move quicker. Traders, too, are speedier, and more of them come to your city.
text: 有荷米斯的聖所在城裡，你所有送貨工的行走速度都會大大提高。另外，同樣提高了行走速度的商人會更加頻繁地到你城裡來。

original: The Arbor of Athena has a grove of olive trees from which you can make olive oil. Athena will also endow your soldiers with more strength, and she will defend your city from attack.
text: 雅典娜的聖所有一片橄欖林，你可以採摘橄欖，製造橄欖油。她還會讓你的士兵更有力量，並且在需要的時候保護你的城市。

original: Hephaestus will grant you copper from his forge when there is a Sanctuary to him in the city. He will also protect your city's buildings from fire.
text: 有了赫菲斯托斯的聖所，你就能得到他送給你的銅。另外他還使你的城市不會發生火災。

original: The Grove of Dionysus has a vineyard whose grapes can be harvested and made into wine. Dionysus will also lull any would-be outlaws into peacefulness.
text: 狄俄尼索斯的聖所裡有一片葡萄園，能釀出最美味的酒來。另外，狄俄尼索斯還能平息城裡所有的不安因素。

original: Hades' three-headed hound, Cerberus, will patrol your city's streets, striking down enemies, when you build the Gates of Hades. Hades will also offer you the riches of the earth, silver ore, that can be converted into drachmas at a Mint.
text: 有黑帝斯的聖所在城裡，他的三頭犬就會出現在你的街頭，為你抵御敵人。另外，黑帝斯還會送你大量的銀礦石，使你成為最富有的人。

original: The Orchard of Hera features stands of Orange Trees that can be harvested for food. She also blesses your people, making them more fertile. She keeps an eagle-eye out for her husband, Zeus, and protects your city from the king of all gods.
text: 赫拉果園裡種有橘子樹，可採收果實作為食物。她也會祝福人民，使人口更加興旺。她時刻留意丈夫宙斯，保護你的城市免受眾神之王侵擾。

original: With the Pillar of Atlas in the city, black and white marble is more easily quarried. And, Artisans' Guilds send out more workers to any construction site.
text: 城裡有阿特拉斯之柱時，黑白大理石都更容易開採，工匠行也會向各處工地派出更多工匠。

original: If Zeus hears your prayer, he will reward you by striking down the next enemy army that invades your city.
text: 如果宙斯聽見了你的祈禱，他將親自為你挫敗下一次進攻你城市的敵人。

original: Pray to Poseidon if you need more seafood for your city's residents.
text: 如果你的城市需要更多海產品就向波賽東祈禱吧。

original: If Demeter responds to your prayer, she will bring you a bounty of food.
text: 如果狄蜜特回應了你的祈禱，她會送給你很多的食物。

original: If Apollo answers your prayers, he will remove all illness from the city.
text: 如果阿波羅回應了你的祈禱，他會消除城裡所有的疾病。

original: If Artemis fulfills your prayer, she will provide you with meat.
text: 如果阿緹蜜絲滿足了你的祈禱，她會把大量的肉食送給你。

original: Pray to Ares if you would like him to accompany your soldiers in far-off battle.
text: 若希望阿瑞斯陪同你的士兵遠征作戰，就向他祈禱。

original: If Aphrodite answers your prayer, she will fill your city's homes with people.
text: 如果愛芙羅黛蒂回應了你的祈禱，她會讓你的城市住滿居民。

original: If Hermes hears your prayer, he will fulfill an outstanding request upon your city.
text: 如果荷米斯聽見了你的祈禱，他會替你完成一個別的城市發來的請求。

original: A successful prayer to Athena yields olives and olive oil from her sacred grove.
text: 如果雅典娜聽見了你的祈禱，你就能得到足夠的橄欖和橄欖油。

original: When Hephaestus answers your prayers, he enlists Talos to defend your city, just as he defended Crete.
text: 如果赫菲斯托斯回應了你的祈禱，他將派塔洛斯來保衛你的城市，就像他保衛克利特島一樣。

original: Dionysus rewards successful prayers with wine!
text: 如果狄俄尼索斯聽見了你的祈禱，他就會把最美味的酒送給你！

original: Pray to Hades if you want to witness an increase to your treasury!
text: 如果黑帝斯聽見了你的祈禱，他就會送你一大筆錢！

original: Pray to Hera to see your Agoras restocked!
text: 向赫拉祈禱，讓市場重新補足物資！

original: If Atlas answers your prayer, he'll help you with a construction project!
text: 如果阿特拉斯回應你的祈禱，他就會協助建築工程！

original: No suitable sacrifices are available. The priests will try again later.
text: 沒有合適的祭品，祭司稍後會再試。
這座聖所需要更多祭司。

original: This Modest Pyramid is admired for its beautiful lines and simple form.
text: 這座小金字塔以優美的線條和簡潔的外形受到讚賞。

original: This Pyramid brings a smile to the face of anyone who gazes upon it.
text: 這座金字塔讓每個望見它的人露出笑容。

original: This towering Great Pyramid is a source of civic pride for all who live in the city.
text: 這座高聳的大金字塔是全體市民的驕傲。

original: This awe-inspiring Majestic Pyramid stretches toward the sky in a dazzling display of craftsmanship.
text: 這座令人敬畏的雄偉金字塔直指天空，展現令人目眩的精湛工藝。

original: This Small Monument to the Sky is pleasing to the eye.
text: 這座小型天空紀念碑令人賞心悅目。

original: This Monument to the Sky reminds all who live in the city of the guiding stars that shine at night.
text: 這座天空紀念碑讓居民想起夜間閃耀、指引方向的星辰。

original: This Grand Monument to the Sky is the talk of the city. People hold their heads a little higher knowing that such an impressive edifice graces their city.
text: 這座大型天空紀念碑成為全城話題。知道城裡有如此壯觀的建築，居民都更自豪了。

original: This Minor Shrine to [god] is a source of pleasure to both [god] and your people.
text: 這座獻給[god]的小神殿，讓[god]和人民都感到喜悅。

original: This gorgeous Shrine to [god] has granted both [god] and your people bragging rights over the world.
text: 這座獻給[god]的華麗神殿，讓[god]和人民都能向世界誇耀。

original: This stately Major Shrine to [god] has become a favorite topic of conversation for both [god] and the residents of this city. They enjoy talking about its perfect form.
text: 這座獻給[god]的莊嚴大神殿，成了[god]和市民最愛談論的話題，大家都喜歡讚美它完美的外形。

original: The Pyramid of the Pantheon is a glorious achievement. The gods, impressed with your loyalty to the entire pantheon, have vowed never to act in anger towards you. The beauty of the Pyramid is an inspiration to all.
text: 眾神金字塔是光榮的成就。眾神受到你對所有神明的忠誠感動，誓言不再對你發怒。金字塔的美麗鼓舞著每個人。

original: Stretching towards the gods' home, the Altar of Olympus is a sacred and holy place. Sacrifices conducted here are offered up to all the gods worshiped in the city.
text: 奧林匹斯祭壇伸向眾神的居所，是神聖的地方。在此舉行的獻祭將獻給城裡供奉的所有神明。

original: The stunning Temple of Olympus serves as a reminder of the power and majesty of the gods.
text: 壯麗的奧林匹斯神廟，讓人們牢記眾神的力量與威嚴。

original: Approaching the stars themselves, the Observatory Kosmika is a place of wonder and of science. Everyone in the city benefits from the observations that the astronomers make here.
text: 宇宙天文臺高聳入星空，是充滿奇蹟與科學的場所。天文學家在此的觀測讓全城市民受益。

original: The Museum Atlantika is a magnificent testament to the importance of learning. All who live in the city learn from the fantastic exhibits displayed here.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯博物館以宏偉建築展現學習的重要。所有市民都能從館內奇妙的展品中獲得知識。

original: Construction has been halted. Artisans are finishing their current tasks, but will do no more work until construction is resumed.
text: 工程已暫停。工匠會完成手頭的工作，但在恢復施工前不會繼續建造。

original: Construction has been halted. Artisans will not return to the site until construction is resumed.
text: 工程已暫停。在恢復施工前，工匠不會返回工地。

original: By building Oracle of Apollo, you will be able to see the future by consulting the Oracle, and Apollo will defend your borders against monsters.
text: 建造阿波羅神諭所後，你可以通過神諭預知未來，阿波羅還會保護邊境免受怪獸侵擾。

original: Columns add a touch of class and increase the appeal of any neighborhood.
text: 圓柱能美化環境，還能讓人們心情愉快。

original: The beautiful Avenue is a pleasure to walk and to gaze upon.
text: 漂亮的大道不管是看上去還是走上去都讓人覺得很舒服。

original: The Boulevard brings grace to a neighborhood.
text: 林蔭道使周圍環境看上去更典雅。

original: This nice bench provides a comfortable place for residents to rest their weary bones.
text: 這张漂亮的长凳為行人提供了一個舒适的坐处。

original: Residents take time out to stop and smell the roses here.
text: 居民們都喜欢到這儿來走走，闻一闻花的味道。

original: Residents like to picnic at the beautiful Gazebo.
text: 居民們喜欢到這個漂亮的露台中來野餐。

original: People like to get lost in the twisting, turning Hedge Maze.
text: 人們喜歡迷失在曲曲折折的小徑中的感覺。

original: Both fish and people leap for joy when there is a Fish Pond in the city!
text: 看到這個漂亮的鱼塘，人們也像池裡的鱼一样高兴地跳了起來！

original: This graceful obelisk brings smiles to the faces of people everywhere.
text: 這座優雅的方尖碑讓人們露出笑容。

original: People who live near Sun Dials are never late for anything, making them quite popular with their friends.
text: 住在日晷附近的人做什麼都不會遲到，因此很受朋友們歡迎。

original: Who knew that a simple shrub could one day be a fantastic animal? Residents marvel at the amazing shapes that the gardeners create.
text: 誰想到一株普通灌木能變成奇妙的動物？居民驚嘆於園丁塑造的各種形狀。

original: Perhaps Pegasus himself made this spring by striking the ground with his hooves! The splashing water makes people smile.
text: 也許這眼泉水是飛馬珀伽索斯用蹄子踏出來的！飛濺的水花讓人們露出笑容。

original: No one is sure what the significance of the stone circle is, but people like it just the same.
text: 沒有人確定石環的意義，但人們仍然喜歡它。

original: This impressive obelisk honors the natural beauty of rock.
text: 這座壯觀的方尖碑展現了岩石的自然之美。

original: Water Parks of all shapes and sizes delight everyone!  It is the perfect place for the city's residents to splash and play.
text: 各式各樣的水上公園讓大家開心！這裡是居民戲水遊玩的好地方。

original: This sculpture of the gleeful dolphin reminds the citizens of the wonders of the sea.
text: 這座歡快的海豚雕像，讓市民想起海洋的奇妙。

original: Round and round the planets go on the Orrery. It reminds your citizens of their proper place in the world!
text: 行星在天體儀上不停旋轉，提醒市民自己在世界中的位置！

original: Massive shells have been collected from Poseidon's ocean and fashioned into a nice garden.
text: 人們從波賽東的海洋採集巨大貝殼，布置成美麗的花園。

original: A favorite Saturday night hang-out, residents love to splish splash in a neighborhood bath.
text: 這是星期六晚上的熱門聚會地點，居民喜歡在社區浴池裡戲水。

original: People love to watch birds play in a Bird Bath, and the birds welcome the opportunity to keep squeaky clean!
text: 人們喜歡看鳥兒在鳥浴池裡玩耍，鳥兒也樂得把自己洗乾淨！

original: Military set to auto-defend the city. See Military tab or options menu.
text: 军事设置為自动為城市防御。参看军事标签或选项菜单。

original: This building, once a fine and beautiful structure, has been reduced to dust.
text: 這幢本來好好的房子現在变成了一堆碎石破瓦。

original: New calves are born, and old cows are turned into tasty meat here at the Corral.
text: 牛欄裡有新生小牛，也有被製成美味肉食的老牛。

original: This Corral has all the workers it needs, and it is operating at peak efficiency.
text: 采石场富含大理石。建造一座石料加工场來开采這裡的大理石。

original: This Corral is a few workers short. Meat is still being produced, but at a slightly slower rate.
text: 這座牛欄還缺幾名工人。仍能生產牛肉，但速度稍慢。

original: This Corral needs more workers. Meat production has slowed.
text: 這座牛欄需要更多工人，牛肉生產已經放慢。

original: Only a few people work at this Corral. Cattle are kept in the field far past their prime.
text: 這座牛欄只有幾名工人，牛群在牧場待到早已超過最佳宰殺時機。

original: This Corral hardly has any workers. Only a very small amount of meat is produced here.
text: 這座牛欄幾乎沒有工人，只能生產極少量牛肉。

original: With no employees, this Corral will never produce meat.
text: 沒有雇工，這座牛欄就無法生產牛肉。

original: Fire! If a superintendent doesn't put out the flames in time, this Corral will be lost!
text: 失火了！如果管理員不能及時滅火，這座牛欄就會被燒毀！

original: This Corral is cursed! The meat stored here has turned rancid, and no more will be produced until the curse is lifted.
text: 這座牛欄受到了詛咒！存放的牛肉已經腐壞，在詛咒解除前無法繼續生產。

original: This Corral is sanctified! The cattle have grown larger, and more meat than usual is being produced!
text: 這座牛欄受到了祝福！牛隻更加肥大，產出的牛肉比平常更多！

original: You have sent the ranchers home.
To trade these newly available goods, tell your Commerce Aide to set the goods' status to Import or Export.
text: 在进行贸易之前，你必须先讓你的商業顾問将商品状态设置為“购入”或“售出”。

original: REMEMBER! Your city needs a Pier before any trade ships can come into the city.
text: 记住！你的城市需要一個贸易港才能有贸易船只到你這儿來进行交易。

original: Click on a city to govern
text: 点击一個城市來管理它

original: The close of the Archaic Period
text: The close of the Archaic Period

original: The Birth of the Old Kingdom
text: The Birth of the Old Kingdom

original: Selima Oasis: Secure the caravan trails
text: Selima Oasis: Secure the caravan trails

original: Meidum: A tomb of your own
text: Meidum: A tomb of your own

original: South Dahshur: A new kind of pyramid
text: South Dahshur: A new kind of pyramid

original: The Height of the Old Kingdom
text: The Height of the Old Kingdom

original: Bahariya Oasis: The soldiers of Ra
text: Bahariya Oasis: The soldiers of Ra

original: The Decline of the Old Kingdom
text: The Decline of the Old Kingdom

original: Dunqul Oasis: Drive out the jackals
text: Dunqul Oasis: Drive out the jackals

original: The Birth of the Middle Kingdom
text: The Birth of the Middle Kingdom

original: This episode has no winning or losing conditions.  It is about city building, pure and simple.
text: 這一关沒有勝利或失败条件。它只是一個简单的城市建设的训练。

original: Please confirm that your new resolution has been set correctly (if you can see this, it has!) This message will time out in 10 seconds.
text: 请正确设定你的新分辨率(如果你能看到這段文字，那麼就已經设好了！)。這条信息将在十秒钟後消失。

original: I am using the default location.
text: 我正在使用默认的位置。

original: Take me to the Kingdom screen!
You won - you can replay map to try to beat your score.
text: 你勝利了--你可以再完一次來试着超过自己的分数。

original: You did better the last time you played this episode.
You completed this episode successfully, but [player_name] still reigns supreme in this city.
text: 你成功完成了本关，不过[player_name]仍然在這個城中占统治地位。

original: You now hold the high score for this episode!  You have bested [player_name]'s achievement.
text: 現在你创造了這一关的新的记录！你超过了[player_name]的分数。

original: Here, hunters gather and prepare to kill their prey.
text: 猎人們在這裡集合，准备出發去猎杀野猪。

original: You have ordered that no more animals be hunted
text: 你已經禁止了對野猪的猎杀。

original: With no employees, this Hunting Lodge cannot operate, and animals need not fear for their lives.
text: 沒有猎人的小屋无法正常运作，野猪也不必害怕有生命危险了。

original: This Hunting Lodge has all the hunters it needs. Hunting parties are killing their quarry at an efficient pace.
text: 這個猎人小屋拥有充足的人手，猎人們正以最快的速度宰杀猎物。

original: This Hunting Lodge is short a hunter or two. A few animals are escaping the hunters' arrows, and meat production has slowed.
text: 這個猎人小屋還缺几個人手，有几头野猪逃脱了猎人的追捕，肉食的生產速度有所下降。

original: This Hunting Lodge is understaffed. Without enough hunters, it is producing much less meat than it could.
text: 這個猎人小屋人手不足，它生產的肉食要比原本少很多。

original: This Hunting Lodge needs many more hunters. Animals laugh at the paltry hunting parties, and hardly any meat is produced.
text: 這個猎人小屋需要更多的人手，仅有的几個猎人根本不是野猪的對手，肉食的生產速度严重下降。

original: This Hunting Lodge hardly has any hunters and is not producing much meat at all.
text: 這個猎人小屋几乎沒有几個猎人，生產不了多少肉食。

original: The hunting party is in the field, stalking their quarry.
text: 猎人們正在四处搜寻野猪。

original: This Hunting Lodge is too far away from the breeding grounds.  The hunters are refusing to walk that far.
text: 猎人小屋距离猎场太远，猎人們不愿意走那麼多路。

original: The smell of barbecued meat is in the air, and the hunters have fled.
text: 猎人小屋烧了起來，猎人們都逃走了。

original: This Lodge is cursed! All the hunters here have perished, and any meat stored here has spoiled!
text: 這個小屋被诅咒了！這裡所有的猎人都病倒了，而所有储存的獸肉也都变质了！

original: This Lodge is sanctified! The hunters can't miss, and the Lodge is producing four times as much meat as usual!
text: 這個小屋被祝福了！猎人們箭无虚發，獸肉的生產速度是平時的四倍！

original: Walkers that roam the city turn around when they meet a Roadblock. Walkers with a specific destination in mind can pass right through.
text: 在城裡漫步的行人遇到路障就會调头，而有目的地的行人则不會受影响。

original: Goddess of Warriors, Crafts and Wisdom
The urchin gatherers can not find a good place to dive for urchins.
text: 工人們找不到有海胆的地方。

original: The workers are preparing to hunt for sea urchins.
text: 工人們正准备去收集海胆。

original: The urchin gatherers are wading through the water, headed for a spot known for its plentiful urchins.
text: 工人們正涉水到海胆丰富的水域去收集海胆。

original: The workers are busy collecting urchins.
text: 工人們正忙着收集海胆。

original: You ordered a halt to urchin collecting.
text: 你下令停止了海胆的收集。

original: Fire! All the urchin gatherers have left the building and won't resume the hunt for urchins until the fire is extinguished.
text: 着火了！所有的工人都离开了加工场，在大火被扑灭前他們是不會回來的。

original: This building is cursed! A strong undertow has pulled the urchin gatherers under, and the Urchin Quay won't provide urchins to the city until the curse is lifted!
text: 這座建筑被诅咒了！一個大浪将所有的工人都压在了下面，在诅咒解除前這裡无法提供海胆了！

original: This building is sanctified! Urchins are suddenly very plentiful, and the gatherers are hauling in four times the usual amount!
text: 這座建筑被祝福了！海胆一下子变得极其丰富，現在的產量是平時的四倍！

original: The watchman is out making his rounds.
The watchman is making his last preparations before stepping out onto the city's streets.
text: 督察官在做出巡前的最後准备。

original: This Watchpost has all the workers it needs. A full patrol of watchmen is walking the beat.
text: 這個了望台有足够的人手，他們正在四处巡逻。

original: This Watchpost needs a few more workers. The Watchpost is still sending out patrols, but not as quickly as it could.
text: 這個了望台還需要一兩個人手，它正在派人出去巡逻，不过速度不是最快。

original: This Watchpost needs several more workers. It is sending out watchmen at a slowed pace.
text: 這個了望台還需要几個人手。它正在派人出去巡逻，不过速度较慢。

original: This Watchpost needs many more workers if its watchmen are to help combat unrest.
text: 這個了望台需要更多人手才能维护好治安。

original: This Watchpost barely has employees at all. It can send a watchman out very infrequently.
text: 這個了望台几乎沒有雇工，它派出督察官的速度很慢。

original: This Watchpost has no employees and is not sending out any watchmen at all.
text: 這個了望台沒有雇工，它无法正常运作。

original: Fire! The workers here are too busy watching their building burn to patrol the streets.
text: 着火了！這裡的工人都手忙脚乱，沒空出去巡逻了。

original: Something there is that doesn't love a Wall - enemy soldiers, for example. Walls help to keep invaders at bay.
text: 有些人就是不喜欢城墙--比如說敌人的士兵。城墙能把入侵者挡在外面。

original: And they're off!  The Hippodrome is complete, and the horses have begun to run.
text: 開跑了！賽馬場已完工，馬匹開始奔馳。

original: The track is incomplete.  No horses will race here until you complete the circuit.
text: 跑道尚未完工，完成環道前不會有賽馬。

original: Few people attend the short races held at this tiny Hippodrome. The races are over almost as soon as they begin!
text: 這座小賽馬場的賽程太短，前來觀賽的人很少。比賽幾乎才開始就結束了！

original: Citizens can be heard yelping excitedly, talking of the latest races at the track. They are quite pleased that the city has such an exciting form of entertainment and are spending money freely on refreshments.
text: 市民興奮地歡呼，談論著最新的賽事。他們很高興城裡有這麼刺激的娛樂，也樂於花錢購買茶點。

original: Citizens can be heard yelping excitedly, talking of the latest races at the track. They are quite pleased that the city has such an exciting form of entertainment and are spending money freely on refreshments.
text: 市民興奮地歡呼，談論著最新的賽事。他們很高興城裡有這麼刺激的娛樂，也樂於花錢購買茶點。

original: News of the thrilling races in your city has spread. Your allies have begun to attend the races, and are pleased to find your citizens hospitable. Foreigners and locals alike are buying refreshments and souvenirs, and your allies and your own citizens think more highly of you.
text: 你城裡精彩賽事的消息已經傳開，盟友也開始前來觀賽，並對市民的熱情好客感到滿意。外地人和本地人都購買茶點與紀念品，盟友和市民對你的評價也提高了。

original: News of the thrilling races in your city has spread. Your allies have begun to attend the races, and are pleased to find your citizens hospitable. Foreigners and locals alike are buying refreshments and souvenirs, and your allies and your own citizens think more highly of you.
text: 你城裡精彩賽事的消息已經傳開，盟友也開始前來觀賽，並對市民的熱情好客感到滿意。外地人和本地人都購買茶點與紀念品，盟友和市民對你的評價也提高了。

original: This impressive Hippodrome is earning the admiration of even your rivals! People from around the world are parting with their hard-earned cash here, and your popularity in your own city and around the world is on the rise.
text: 這座壯觀的賽馬場連敵人也讚嘆不已！世界各地的人們都在這裡花費辛苦賺來的錢，你在城內和世界各地的聲望持續上升。

original: It is considered a great honor to attend a race at this venerable Hippodrome. The Hippodrome has made your city the talk of the world, and your citizens are beaming with pride.
text: 能在這座享有盛名的賽馬場觀看比賽，被視為莫大的榮譽。你的城市因此舉世聞名，市民也滿懷驕傲。

original: What is it with you and Hippodromes? While people from around the world are flocking to see the races at this gargantuan Hippodrome, your own citizens are choking on the dust raised by the pounding of horse hooves. Others in the world are impressed with your achievement, but your own citizens are not pleased.
text: 你怎麼如此迷戀賽馬場？世界各地的人爭相前來觀賞這座巨大賽馬場的比賽，市民卻被馬蹄揚起的塵土嗆得喘不過氣。外人佩服你的成就，你的市民可不高興。

original: This Hippodrome is cut off from the rest of the world, and no one can reach it!
text: 這座賽馬場與外界隔絕，沒有人能到達這裡！

original: You can only have one Hippodrome in the city! Either delete the other Hippodrome in the city, or connect it to this one.
text: 城裡只能有一座賽馬場！請拆除另一座，或將它與這座連接起來。

original: The Hippodrome must be connected to a road to function properly.
text: 賽馬場必須連接道路才能正常運作。

original: horses from a Horse Ranch before races can begin. If the Hippodrome is connected to more than one road, the handler will choose which of the roads he wants to use to get horses.  Make sure that the road he chooses is connected to a Horse Ranch.
text: 匹馬，比賽才能開始。如果賽馬場連接多條道路，馴馬員會自行選擇取馬的路線。請確保他選擇的道路通往馬場。

original: The Gatehouse keeps good things in and bad things out.
text: 门楼能把好的東西放进來，把坏的東西挡在外面。

original: Stonecutters from the Workshop chisel out huge blocks of black marble at a Black Marble Quarry and break it down into usable slabs.
text: 工坊的石匠在黑色大理石採石場鑿出巨大的石塊，再將它們切割成可用的石板。

original: You have decided to shut down black marble quarrying.
text: 你已決定停止開採黑色大理石。

original: No one is employed at this Workshop. It is not producing any black marble.
text: 此工坊尚未僱工，沒有生產黑色大理石。

original: This Workshop has a full staff. The stonecutters here are quarrying black marble at a highly efficient rate.
text: 此工坊人手充足，石匠正高效開採黑色大理石。

original: This Workshop is producing black marble, but not as quickly as it could be. The Workshop needs a few more workers.
text: 此工坊正在生產黑色大理石，但速度不夠快，需要更多工人。

original: Chiseling has slowed. This Workshop needs several more workers to operate at peak efficiency.
text: 鑿石速度已經減慢。這座工坊還需要增聘幾名工人，才能發揮最高效率。

original: Only a few lonely stonecutters work here. They cannot produce much black marble without more help.
text: 只有少數石匠在這裡工作，人手不足，產量有限。

original: Black marble production is nearly at a standstill. This Workshop needs many more employees.
text: 黑色大理石生產幾乎停滯，此工坊需要大量增聘人手。

original: The stonecutters here are eagerly waiting for a huge block of black marble from the Quarry.
text: 石匠們正等待採石場運來巨大的黑色大理石塊。

original: Without enough employees, this Tower will be helpless in the face of an attack.
text: 沒有足够的人手，這個塔楼在敌人面前将束手无策。

original: Sentries stand ready to fire upon anyone encroaching on the city.
text: 弓箭手引弓搭箭，随時准备向來犯的敌人射击。

original: From the heights of the Tower, sentries can spot approaching attacks and help to defend the city.
text: 從塔楼上，哨兵可以侦察到來犯的敌军，并协助防守城市。

original: Fire! The sentries have abandoned their post, and no one will guard the city from this Tower unless the fire is put out.
text: 着火了！哨兵都逃了出來，除非火被扑灭，否则這個塔楼就沒用了。

original: This Tower is cursed! The sentries here have become cowards, and they won't rediscover their bravery until the curse is lifted. Until then, the Tower won't defend the city.
text: 這個塔楼被诅咒了！所有的哨兵都惊恐万分。除非诅咒解除，否则他們无法恢复斗志，而塔楼也无法正常运作。

original: You need a Palace to man towers.
text: 你需要建造一座宫殿才能给塔楼配备人员。

original: You need a road connection to the Palace to man Towers.
text: 你需要一条通到宫殿的道路才能给塔楼配备人员。

original: Your city's Towers have orders to remain unmanned.  Use the Military Tab to man all Towers.
text: 你城裡的塔楼還沒有配备人员。使用军事标签给塔楼配备人员。

original: To make this Tower even more deadly, import some Orichalc so that it can launch deadly Atlantean Fire upon invaders.
text: 進口一些山銅，這座塔樓便能向入侵者發射致命的亞特蘭蒂斯之火，使防禦更加強大。

original: To enable this Tower to launch Atlantean Fire, mine and refine orichalc.
text: 開採並冶煉山銅，這座塔樓便能發射亞特蘭蒂斯之火。

original: You are stockpiling orichalc, so none may be delivered to this Tower. Until orichalc is delivered, this Tower will not be able to launch Atlantean Fire.
text: 你正在囤積山銅，因此無法將它運送到這座塔樓。收到山銅之前，塔樓無法發射亞特蘭蒂斯之火。

original: The Tower is waiting for an Orichalc delivery, so that it may launch deadly Atlantean Fire against foes.
text: 塔樓正在等待山銅送達，以便向敵人發射致命的亞特蘭蒂斯之火。

original: This Tower is equipped with a deadly Atlantean Fire launcher, which somehow employs mysterious orichalc.
text: 這座塔樓配備了致命的亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器，以某種方式運用神秘的山銅。

original: Without employees, this Artisans' Guild cannot provide any artisans to help with building projects.
text: 沒有工人的工匠行无法為建筑项目提供工匠。

original: With a full staff of workers, the artisans here are ready to help with any big building project in the city.
text: 有足够工人的工匠行随時准备為城裡的大型项目提供工匠。

original: This Artisans' Guild is a missing a few employees. The artisans are still available for building projects, but the projects may be slowed a little.
text: 這個工匠行還缺几個工人，建筑项目的进度可能會有所下降。

original: This Artisans' Guild needs more employees. This could hold up the city's building projects.
text: 這個工匠行需要更多工人，那样才能维持城裡的建筑项目。

original: This Artisans' Guild has very few employees. It can only produce a few artisans for any building projects in the city.
text: 這個工匠行只有几個工人，它只能為城裡的建筑项目提供几個工匠。

original: This Artisans' Guild hardly has employees at all. It won't be able to provide many artisans to any building projects in the city.
text: 這個工匠行几乎沒有什麼工人，它无法為城裡的建筑项目提供工匠。

original: Fire! The artisans are trying to salvage their tools and won't work on any building projects unless the fire is extinguished!
text: 着火了！工匠們正忙着抢救他們的工具，无法正常工作。還是先把火灭了吧！

original: This Guild is cursed! The artisans are cowering inside, afraid of what might happen if they venture out!
text: 這座工匠行受到了詛咒！工匠躲在裡面，不敢冒險外出！

original: This Guild is sanctified! The Guild will send out twice as many artisans as usual!
text: 這座工匠行受到了祝福！派出的工匠將是平常的兩倍！
全员--生產效率达到最高。

人员不足--生產效率低下
人员严重不足--生產效率严重低下
人员极度不足--生產效率极度低下

人员稍有不足--生產效率稍有下降
人员不足--生產效率低下

人员极度不足生產效率极度低下

original: The trireme, the pride of the navy, moors at the Trireme Wharf between battles.
text: 三層船历來是海军的骄傲，在和平時期它就停泊在三層船码头上。

original: You have sent the trireme's crew home.
text: 你已把船员都遣送回家。

original: This Wharf has a full crew.
This Trireme Wharf is missing some workers.
text: 這個三層船码头缺少一些工人。

original: This Trireme Wharf needs more workers.
text: 這個三層船码头需要更多的工人。

original: This Trireme Wharf needs many more workers. The trireme cannot move without them.
text: 這個三層船码头急需人手，否则三層船无法航行。

original: This Trireme Wharf hardly has any workers at all. It cannot carry out any orders.
text: 這個三層船码头几乎找不到人手。它无法执行任何命令。

original: This Trireme Wharf is missing supplies. Make sure it has wood to build the ship and armor to outfit the marines.
text: 這個三層船码头缺少材料。它需要木材來建造船只，需要盔甲來武装船员。

original: The trireme is here at the wharf, waiting for orders.
text: 三層船停泊在码头上等待命令。

original: The trireme is sailing the waters.
text: 三層船正在水面上航行。

original: The trireme's crew is busy repairing the ship.
This Wharf needs a trireme! Make sure it has wood, armor, and enough workers to build it.
text: 這個码头需要一艘三層船！提供木材、盔甲和足够的工人來建造。

original: You need a Palace to commission triremes.
text: 你需要建造一座宫殿來将它编入現役部队。

original: When it's not out on the high seas, the frigate docks at the Frigate Wharf.
text: 護衛艦沒有出海時，便停靠在護衛艦船塢。

original: You have sent the frigate's crew home.
text: 你已讓護衛艦船員回家。

original: This Wharf has a full crew.
This Frigate Wharf is missing some workers.
text: 這座護衛艦船塢還缺幾名工人。

original: This Frigate Wharf needs more workers.
text: 這座護衛艦船塢需要更多工人。

original: This Frigate Wharf needs many more workers. The frigate cannot move without them.
text: 這座護衛艦船塢需要增加許多工人，否則護衛艦無法出航。

original: This Frigate Wharf hardly has any workers at all. It cannot carry out any orders.
text: 這座護衛艦船塢幾乎沒有工人，無法執行任何命令。

original: This Frigate Wharf is missing supplies. Make sure it has wood to build the ship and armor to outfit the marines.
text: 這座護衛艦船塢缺少物資。請確保有木材造船，也有盔甲裝備海軍士兵。

original: The frigate is here at the wharf, awaiting your command.
text: 護衛艦正停泊在船塢，等待你的命令。

original: The frigate is sailing the waters.
The frigate's crew is busily repairing the ship.
text: 護衛艦船員正忙著修理船隻。

original: This Wharf needs a frigate! Make sure it has wood, armor, and enough workers to build it.
text: 這座船塢需要一艘護衛艦！請確保有木材、盔甲和足夠的工人造船。

original: You need a Palace to commission frigates.
text: 你需要建造宮殿才能組建護衛艦隊。
為這座護衛艦船塢召集工人。

original: Import Orichalc so that this frigate can build a deadly Atlantean Fire launcher.
text: 進口山銅，便能為這艘護衛艦裝設致命的亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器。

original: This frigate can build an Atlantean Fire launcher if you produce some orichalc at a Refinery.
text: 如果冶煉廠生產一些山銅，這艘護衛艦便能裝設亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器。

original: You are stockpiling orichalc. This frigate will not be able to shower Atlantean Fire on enemies until it receives some orichalc.
text: 你正在囤積山銅。收到山銅之前，這艘護衛艦無法向敵人發射亞特蘭蒂斯之火。

original: As soon as some orichalc is delivered to this Wharf, its frigate will be able to rain hot Atlantean Fire on its foes.
text: 只要山銅送達船塢，護衛艦就能向敵人傾瀉熾熱的亞特蘭蒂斯之火。

original: This Wharf's frigate has an Atlantean Fire launcher, made by our scientists with mysterious orichalc.
text: 這座船塢的護衛艦配備了亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器，由科學家使用神秘的山銅製成。
人员严重不足--生產效率极度低下
人员不足--生產效率下降

全员--生產效率达到最高

original: The next floods will come in

text: 肥沃的土地--洪水已退去。

original: Without Artisans, this project will never get off the ground.  Build some Artisans' Guilds.
text: 沒有工匠這個项目无法完成。建造几個工匠行。

original: Artisans haven't shown up for work on this project. Perhaps the artisans can't reach this site via a road, or maybe there's trouble at the Artisans' Guild.
text: 工匠還沒有來，也许到工匠行去看一下能找到問題所在。

original: Artisans need a supply of wood for this project, but none is currently available.
text: 工匠還需要一些木材，但現在却沒有。

original: Artisans need a supply of sculpture for this project, but none is currently available.
text: 工匠還需要一些雕像，但現在却沒有。

original: Artisans need a supply of marble for this project, but none is currently available.
text: 工匠還需要一些大理石，但現在却沒有。

original: Artisans need a supply of black marble for this project, but none is currently available.
text: 工匠正在為圣所的庭院铺设大理石。

original: Artisans need a supply of orichalc for this project, but none is currently available.
text: 工匠正在建造圣所的神庙。

original: You are stockpiling the wood that the artisans need to continue building this project!
text: 你正在囤積工匠繼續建造這個項目所需的木材！

original: You are stockpiling the sculpture that the artisans need to continue building this project!
text: 工匠正在放置祭坛和雕像。

original: You are stockpiling the marble that the artisans need to continue building this project!
text: 你正在囤積工匠繼續建造這個項目所需的大理石！

original: You are stockpiling the black marble that the artisans need to continue building this project!
text: 项目的剩余部分還需要：

original: You are stockpiling the orichalc that the artisans need to continue building this project!
text: 你正在囤積工匠繼續建造這個項目所需的山銅！

original: Artisans are waiting for a supply of wood, but none can be delivered. Perhaps this construction site isn't connected by a road to the needed supply, or maybe there isn't enough wood stored in a single Storehouse.
text: 工匠正在等待木材，卻沒有材料送來。工地可能沒有道路通往貨源，或單一貨棧裡的木材不足。

original: Artisans need a supply of sculpture, but none can be delivered. Perhaps this construction site isn't connected by a road to the needed supply, or maybe there isn't enough wood stored in a single Storehouse.
text: 工匠需要雕像，卻沒有雕像送來。工地可能沒有道路通往貨源，或單一貨棧裡的木材不足。

original: Artisans need a supply of marble, but none can be delivered. Perhaps this construction site isn't connected by a road to the needed supply, or maybe there isn't enough marble stored in a single Storehouse.
text: 工匠需要大理石，卻沒有材料送來。工地可能沒有道路通往貨源，或單一貨棧裡的大理石不足。

original: Artisans need a supply of black marble, but none can be delivered. Perhaps this construction site isn't connected by a road to the needed supply, or maybe there isn't enough black marble stored in a single Storehouse.
text: 工匠需要黑色大理石，卻沒有材料送來。工地可能沒有道路通往貨源，或單一貨棧裡的黑色大理石不足。

original: Artisans need a supply of orichalc, but none can be delivered. Perhaps this construction site isn't connected by a road to the needed supply, or maybe there isn't enough orichalc stored in a single Storehouse.
text: 工匠需要山銅，卻沒有材料送來。工地可能沒有道路通往貨源，或單一貨棧裡的山銅不足。

original: Artisans are placing marble tiles for the Sanctuary courtyard.
text: 所有项目所需的材料都已經到齐了

original: Artisans are constructing the Sanctuary's Temple.
text: 工匠正在建造聖所的神廟。

original: Artisans are carving the Statue of [god].
Artisans are placing the Altar and sculptures.
text: 工匠正在放置祭壇和雕像。

original: Artisans are carving the magnificent statue of Poseidon in all his glory.
text: 工匠正在雕刻光輝莊嚴的波賽東巨像。

original: The remainder of the project will require an additional:
text: 項目的剩餘部分還需要：

original: All materials needed for this project have arrived
text: 所有項目所需的材料都已經到齊了

original: Artisans are placing the marble that forms the core of the Pyramid.
text: 工匠正在鋪設構成金字塔核心的大理石。

original: Artisans are placing the black marble that forms the core of the Pyramid.
text: 工匠正在鋪設構成金字塔核心的黑色大理石。

original: Artisans are putting the finishing touches on the completed course, polishing the marble to a fine sheen and adding orichalc decorations.
text: 工匠正在完成這一層的最後工作，將大理石磨亮，並加上山銅裝飾。

original: Artisans are putting the finishing touches on the completed course, polishing the black marble to a fine sheen and adding orichalc decorations.
text: 工匠正在完成這一層的最後工作，將黑色大理石磨亮，並加上山銅裝飾。

original: Crafty artisans are building an ingenious wooden Lift to haul supplies up the side of the Pyramid.
text: 技藝高超的工匠正在建造巧妙的木製升降機，將物資沿金字塔側面運往高處。

original: Artisans are toiling away, making sure that the top of the Pyramid is as beautiful as the rest of the structure.
text: 工匠正努力工作，確保金字塔頂端和整座建築一樣美麗。

original: Growers from the Growers' Lodge harvest fruit from the orchards.
text: 园丁小屋中的园丁负责在果园中照看果树，采摘果实。

original: You have ordered that no fruit be picked at all.
text: 你已下令停止采摘任何果实。

original: This Growers' Lodge has no employees. Any olive trees and vines in the city are growing wild.
text: 這個园丁小屋沒有工人。橄榄树和葡萄藤都在胡乱生长。

original: This Growers' Lodge has all the workers it needs. Orchards are well-pruned, and fruit is harvested at peak efficiency.
text: 這個园丁小屋拥有足够的工人，果园被打理得很漂亮，果实也在最好的時候被采下來。

original: This Growers' Lodge needs more workers. Fruit is not harvested as quickly as it could be.
text: 這個园丁小屋需要更多工人，果子采摘的速度可以更快。

original: This Growers' Lodge is understaffed. Some of the plants in the orchard are not being cared for properly, and fruit picking has slowed.
text: 這個园丁小屋人员不足，果园裡部分果树沒有得到很好的照看，果实采摘速度也有所下降。

original: Only a few growers work here. The orchards are unkempt, and it's taking quite some time for the workers to complete the harvest.
text: 這裡只有几個工人。果园裡杂草丛生，他們得花一段時间才能完成采摘任务。

original: This Growers' Lodge hardly has any workers. The small staff picks fruit as quickly as it can, but it's taking a very long time for fruit to be harvested.
text: 這個园丁小屋几乎沒有人手。虽然他們也努力干活，但却需要很长的時间才能把果子摘完。

original: The growers are out looking for ripe fruit to harvest.
text: 园丁都出去采摘成熟的果子去了。

original: This Growers' Lodge has employees, but there are no vines or olive trees for them to tend.
text: 這個园丁小屋有工人，但却沒有可照看的橄榄数或葡萄藤。

original: Fire! All the growers have gone home, and no more fruit will be harvested unless the fire is extinguished.
text: 着火了！所有的园丁都逃回家去了，要是不把火扑灭果园就沒人管理了。

original: The growers can't reach the orchard. Something is blocking their path!
Orange tenders from the Orange Tenders' Lodge pick the sweetest, most succulent oranges for people to eat.
text: 橘農從橘農小屋出發，為人們採摘最甜美多汁的橘子。

original: You've told all the orange tenders to go home.
No one works at this Lodge. Any Orange Trees in the city are laden with unpicked oranges.
text: 這間小屋沒有工人，城裡的橘子樹掛滿無人採摘的果實。

original: This Lodge is fully staffed. Orange Trees are healthy, and oranges are picked when they are fully ripe.
text: 這間小屋人手充足，橘子樹生長健康，果實成熟時便能及時採收。

original: This Lodge needs a few more growers to complete its ranks. Oranges are still picked, but not as many as usual.
text: 這間小屋還缺幾名橘農，仍能採摘橘子，但數量比平常少。

original: More workers are needed here. Some oranges are going to waste, and a few trees aren't being tended.
text: 這裡需要更多工人。有些橘子被白白浪費，也有些樹木無人照料。

original: This Lodge needs many more workers. Many of the oranges are becoming overripe before they can be picked.
text: 這間小屋需要增加許多工人，許多橘子還沒採摘就已過熟。

original: This Lodge hardly has any workers. Only a few oranges are picked at their peak.
text: 這間小屋幾乎沒有工人，只有少數橘子能在最佳時機採收。

original: Orange tenders are out taking care of trees and picking ripe oranges.
text: 橘農正在外面照料樹木，採摘成熟的橘子。

original: This Lodge has workers, but there are no Orange Trees for them to maintain.
text: 這間小屋有工人，卻沒有橘子樹可供照料。

original: Fire! The orange tenders have deserted their posts and won't pick more oranges until the fire is out.
text: 失火了！橘農已經逃離崗位，火災撲滅前不會繼續採收。

original: This Lodge has been cursed! Until the curse is lifted, the tenders will pick no oranges.
text: 這間小屋受到了詛咒！在詛咒解除前，橘農不會採摘橘子。

original: This Lodge has been sanctified! Oranges have suddenly become more plentiful!
text: 這間小屋受到了祝福！橘子的產量突然增加了！

original: The workers here can't reach the Orange Trees. Something must be blocking their path!
text: 這裡的工人到不了橘子樹，一定有障礙擋住了道路！
向敵人發射亞特蘭蒂斯之火
