original: A new city, a new home, and maybe a new job! Fortune is smiling upon me!
text: 一個新的城市，一個新的家，也许還能找到一份新的工作！幸运女神正微笑着向我招手呢！

original: Word is that there are plenty of jobs here for anyone who wants one.
text: 希腊的人們都說這裡有很多工作机會，只要你想找就一定能找得到。

original: I've heard that there's a cornucopia of food here! Yummy!
text: 我听說這裡有充足的食物！太棒了！

original: Looks like I'm leaving just in time!
There aren't enough jobs here.  It's not that I mind not working, but a guy's gotta eat.
text: 這儿沒有足够的工作。倒不是說我會介意沒事做，但人总得吃饭吧。

original: As Zeus is my witness, I'll never be hungry again!  Some other city has got to have enough food to feed everyone.
text: 我以宙斯的名义發誓，我再也不愿意忍饥挨饿了！肯定能找到一個有饭吃的城市的。

original: Taxes are too high here.  The price of citizenship just isn't worth it.
text: 這儿的税率太高了。不值得再待下去了。

original: Wage?  You call that a wage?  I've had enough of you and your city, you cheapskate!
text: 工资？你把那個也叫做工资？我已經受够你和你的城市了，骗子！

original: People are crammed into this city!  Would it kill you to build some more housing, or are you trying to get people to leave?
text: 人們蜂擁而至！你爲什麼不再多造點房子？還是你想把人們都逼走？

original: You've mustered me from the comfort of my own bed one too many times! I'm going to find another place to live!
text: 你沒事就把我們召集起來！我受不了了，我决定另外找個地方住！

original: I think its reasonable to expect to be paid for one's services, but you seem to like to spend your money on other things!  Goodbye!
text: 我觉得做多少拿多少是理所应当的，但是你，却喜欢把钱花在别的東西上！再见！

original: I don't have anywhere to hide! Help!
Thrown out of my home!! What did I do to deserve this?
text: 我被赶了出來！我到底做错了什麼？

original: I've searched high and low, and there's not so much as a hut for me to call home. Not even Diogenes' barrel!
text: 我到处都找过了，连一间茅屋都沒有。

original: Havoc is going to be wreaked all over this city!
text: 城裡马上就要發生大的动乱了！

original: First, you make me live in a dumpy house and now I can't find a job! If I have to live like this, then these rich snobs should have to, too!
text: 先是讓我住在那种破房子裡，現在又害我找不到工作！如果我必须承受這样的生活，那麼那些阔佬們也得一样！

original: No food and a cruddy house!  If I have to suffer, I'm going to make sure I don't suffer alone!
text: 住在破房子裡，還沒有東西吃！如果我必须过這种生活，那麼别人也得陪我一起过！

original: You take too much money from me and make me live in squalor.  I'm going to take a little back!
text: 你把我大部分的钱都拿走了，讓我不得不在贫困线上挣扎！我要拿一点回來！

original: I'm sufferin' along, earning next to nothing, livin' in a slum, while the rich get to play all day. I'll show them how the other half lives!
text: 我不停地工作，挣得钱却少得可怜，還住在一幢破房子裡！可那些富人却整天吃吃玩玩。我要讓他們看看另一半人都是怎麼生活的！

original: You call me from my run-down home to stand in a muddy field, armed with only a rock, to await an attack.  And you wonder why I'm angry!
text: 你把我從破房子裡叫出來，站在烂泥地裡，拿着石块当武器對付敌人的进攻。你還敢問我為什麼要生气！

original: It's bad enough that I live in a ramshackle house, now you're not paying me!  Someone's going to pay, and it might as well be the rich!
text: 讓我住一幢破房子就已經够糟糕的了，現在你连工钱都不付了！好吧，會有人付的，我會讓哪個有钱人付的！

original: Maybe if I lived in a better house and had a job, I wouldn't steal!
text: 如果我能住上更好的房子，再有一份工作的话，我就不會去偷了！

original: I need food.  If the Agora won't deliver any to me, I'll just take from those that have plenty.  Oh, and I could use a better house, too!
text: 我需要食物。如果再弄不到吃的，我就到那些有余粮的人家裡去拿。哦，也许我還可以弄一套更好的房子！

original: You take most of my money, and all I get is a meager house in return.  I'm going to take a little back!
text: 你把我的辛辛苦苦挣來的钱都拿走了，却只给我一间简陋的屋子。我要讨回公道！

original: Procrustes, Sciron, Autolycus. I'll add my name to this list of famous thieves if I can't earn better wages and find a good place to live!
text: 如果我拿不到更多的工钱，或者還是住在那种地方我就要去当盗贼，一個最好的盗贼！

original: Lots of things make me nervous. Mustered soldiers. A shoddy house. Know what happens when I get nervous? I steal!
text: 很多事情都讓我莫名紧张。走來走去的士兵，破破烂烂的房子。知道我紧张的時候會去干什麼嗎？我偷東西！

original: My house is a mess, and you haven't paid me for weeks!  I'll take what I can't afford to buy!
text: 我的房子一塌糊涂，而你已經几星期沒付我工钱了！我要拿回我应得的！

original: I don't mean to be bad.  I'm just miffed because I don't have a job or a nice house to go home to!
text: 我本來不想做坏事的，但是我沒有工作，也沒有好的地方可住，我实在气不过！

original: I'm hungry, and I live in a shabby home. Mugging is the only thing that brings a smile to my face!
text: 我住在一间破房子裡，而且還饿着肚子。抢劫是唯一能讓我稍微高兴一下的事了！

original: I'm tired of paying you a high tax on my cheap house, and I'm going to deal with my anger the only way I know how!
text: 住那麼破的房子還要付那麼高的税，我再也受不了了。我决定要用我自己的方式來發泄！

original: Let's see how you react to earning next to nothing and living in a squalor. I bet you'd start mugging, too!
text: 如果你挣的钱少得可怜，還住在像猪圈一样的房子裡，你會怎麼做？我打赌你也會去抢劫的！

original: While you're busy constantly mustering soldiers, I'm going to leave my horrible home and mug someone!
text: 在你忙着招兵卖马的時候，我打算找個人抢他一票。

original: If you're going to make me live like a rat and not pay me, I'll find some nice, rich-looking person to mug!
text: 如果你想不付我钱，讓我活得像只耗子那样，我就找個有钱人抢他一票！

original: Better houses and more jobs!  That's what we need!
text: 更好的房子和更多的工作，這就是我們所需要的！

original: Hey!  I'm hungry and my house is a mess!  What are you going to do about it?
text: 嘿！我饿着肚子，我的屋子一团糟！你打算怎麼做？

original: The high taxes and cheap housing in this city are making me mad!  Maenad mad!
text: 這個城市高额的税率和简陋的住房都快讓我發疯了！

original: Give me a raise!  I can't live on this pittance you call a wage, and I certainly can't afford to live in a better house!
text: 给我加点工钱吧！就你给的這点工资实在不够用啊，我连好一点的房子都住不起！

original: You're always mustering soldiers, and I could be next.  I suffer enough because of my run-down home, I don't want to go to war, too!
text: 你一直都在招兵，也许我就是下一個。住那麼破的房子我已經受够了，我可不想再去打仗！

original: Do you really think you can force people to live in rickety houses and not pay them for their services? I've never seen such hubris!
text: 你真以為你可以光讓人們住在破烂的房子裡，還不付他們工钱嗎？真沒见过你這麼不要脸的！

original: Hygiene conditions in this city are atrocious!  Even people in the rich, upscale part of town I live in are afraid of falling ill!
text: 這個城市的卫生状况太吓人了！连住在富人区的人都有生病的危险！

original: I don't know what the lower classes are complaining about. I've got plenty of food!
text: 我不知道下层阶级那些人都在埋怨什麼，反正我有足够的東西吃！

original: Commoners are littering the streets like old, discarded amphorae shards.  You really should see to it that they find some employment.
text: 无所事事的人满大街乱走，你应该给他們找点活儿干。

original: How can it be that I, a member of the elite, live in a city that is subject to another? Say the word, and I'll attack our rival!
text: 怎麼會有這种事情？像我這麼一個人物居然住在一個附属城裡。只要你一句话，我就去把敌人杀個落花流水！

original: Send me to our rebelling subject! I'll make them see the error of their ways!
text: 把我派到反叛的城市那儿去，我要讓他們知道自己选错了路！

original: I do my part to bring the quality of this city up, but I can only do so much.  There are things here that could be improved.
text: 我尽力把這個城市维护得更好，不过我只能做這麼多了。這裡還有很多問題有待解决。

original: You have done a wonderful job building this city! I'm sure the Elysian Fields pale in comparison.
text: 你把這個城市建设得太好了！我想天神住的地方也不过如此吧！

original: Gadzeus! I'm getting out of here!
Take that, you rapscallion! Theseus couldn't brook outlaws, and neither can I!
text: 尝尝我的厉害，你這個恶棍！忒修斯受不了作恶的人，我也一样！

original: People here aren't very healthy at all.  Maybe they need more pork!
text: 這裏的人不是很健康。也許他們需要多喫一點肉！

original: I'm as hungry as the Horses of Diomedes! I need food!
text: 我饿得就像狄俄墨得斯的马一样！快给我点吃的！

original: A lot of poor saps are out of work, but not me!  I am far too good a boar hunter to ever be unemployed!
text: 很多可怜虫都失業了，可我不會！我是一個优秀的猎人，不可能沒有工作！

original: When I think of how we're subjugated, it just makes me want to kill more boar!
text: 一想到我們被征服了，我就想多杀几头野猪來解气！

original: A rebellion!  Who would dare rebel against a city that boasts such talented boar hunters!?!
text: 有人反叛！有我這麼勇敢的猎手在谁敢反叛？！

original: This city isn't the best, but it's all right overall.
text: 這個城市不是最好，但总的來說還不错。

original: This is the best city ever! The boar here are the best this side of Calydon!
text: 這是我见过的最好的城市！這裡的野猪也是這一带最壮的！

original: There's boar around here somewhere. I can smell them!
text: 這附近有野猪，我能闻出它們的味道！

original: This poor boar never stood a chance!  My aim is as good as Atalanta's!
text: 這头可怜的野猪一点机會都沒有！我实在太强壮了！

original: Hygiene conditions are terrible, and people could get sick.  I just hope that it doesn't spread to my sheep!
text: 這儿的卫生状况一塌糊涂，人們都快要生病了。我只希望不要传染给我的羊群！

original: I'm so hungry! I wonder what meadow tastes like. The sheep sure seem to like it!
text: 我快饿死了！我真想尝尝青草是什麼滋味，我的绵羊好像都很喜欢的样子！

original: Perhaps you should herd up the unemployed and drive them out of town!
text: 也许你应该把失業的人直接赶出城镇！

original: I hate living in a vassal city.  My sheep deserve to be in a mighty city that pays tribute to no one!
text: 我不喜欢住在一個附庸城内。我的羊群应该住在一個强大的，无人敢欺负的城裡！

original: One of our colonies is trying to leave the fold!  I'm glad that all my little sheep are loyal!
text: 我們有一個殖民地想要脱离我們！還好我的小羊群對我還很忠心！

original: The sheep aren't thrilled to live here, but they don't have much choice.
text: 我的小羊群不是很喜欢住在這儿，不过它們和我一样也沒多少选择。

original: I'd follow you anywhere! It's sheer pleasure living in a city like this!
text: 我愿意跟随你到任何地方！能够住在這样一個城市裡真是我的荣幸！

original: No wolf will catch my sheep.  Not while I'm here, anyway!
text: 只要有我在，狼群别想叼走我的羊！

original: Soon, my fuzzy little sheep will be completely bald!
text: 我只要一會儿時间就能把羊毛都给替下來！

original: Stand still, Bessy.  I don't want to cut you!
text: 站着别动，宝贝，我可不想剪到你！

original: I love the smell of freshly cut fleece in the morning!
text: 我喜欢早上新剪下來的羊毛味道！

original: This city could use a visit from Asclepius! People aren't feeling well, and a plague could break out!
text: 這個城市需要更多医师！人們都感觉不舒服，很有可能要爆發瘟疫！

original: Being surrounded by cheese all day only makes me hungrier!  Now I know how Tantalus feels!
text: 整天和奶酪打交道只會讓我觉得更饿！唉，我現在可知道坦塔罗斯的痛苦了！

original: Satyrs alive! I've never seen so many people out of work before!
text: 天啊！我從來沒见过這麼多人沒有工作！

original: When are we going to shake off the shackles of vassalhood?
text: 我們什麼時候才能摆脱附庸的镣铐？

original: I can't believe one of our subjects dares to rebel against us!  Where's the gratitude?
text: 真不敢相信我們的殖民地會反叛！他們真是沒有良心！

original: This city is so so.  Good enough for a goat, I suppose.
text: 這個城市很一般，對山羊來說倒是够好了，我觉得。
這座城市真是无可挑剔！

original: Every man and goat for himself! Run!
I'm as vigilant as Argos guarding Io! No wolf is going to get my goat!
text: 我像阿尔戈号船上的艾奥一样警惕，不讓狼群叼走我的羊！

original: These goats won't milk themselves!  If they did, I'd be out of a job!
text: 這些山羊自己可不會挤奶！要是它們會的话，我就失業了！

original: Milking goats isn't glamorous, but people need their cheese.
text: 挤奶的工作不是很有趣但却很有意义，因為人們都爱吃奶酪。

original: Drat! I spilt some milk. No use crying over it, I suppose.
text: 该死！我打翻了一桶羊奶。唉，不过再後悔也沒有用了。

original: People here are looking a little down around the gills.  If hygiene conditions don't improve, a plague could break out!
text: 這裏的人氣色看上去都不太好。如果衛生狀況還得不到改善的話，很可能會爆發瘟疫的！

original: I'm hungrier than Erysichthon! I wonder if anyone would notice if I made off with some fish!
text: 我都快饿疯了！我在想要是我偷拿几条鱼的话會不會有人知道！

original: There are more unemployed people here than there are fish in the sea!
text: 這裡的失業人数比海裡的鱼還要多！

original: Are we men, or are we guppies?  Let's rise up against our rival!
text: 我們是男人還是供人观赏的热带鱼？我們不要再這样屈辱地活下去了！

original: So, one of our subjects thinks they're big enough not to need our protection.  We'll see about that!
text: 這麼說，我們的一個殖民地认為它翅膀硬了，可以飞了，不再需要我們保护了？那就讓我們看看吧！

original: You could improve things, but it's not too terrible living here.
text: 关于城市建设你還有很多事可做，不过住在這儿也沒什麼不好。

original: This city is a great catch!

text: 所有的人都躲到甲板下面去！快点！

original: Salty air, fish, and my cronies: that's all I need! Maybe if I'm lucky, I'll meet some Nereids!
text: 一边捕鱼，一边和我的哥們儿聊天，呼吸在带着咸味的空气中：夫复何求！运气好的话，也许還能碰上一個海中仙女呢！

original: All hail my hearty crew!  Poseidon will soon wonder where all his fish went!
text: 加油干啊，我的伙计們！过會儿波賽東都會奇怪他的鱼都到哪儿去了！

original: Catch the fish . . . You missed.  Catch the fish . . . You missed again!
text: 抓住那条鱼...你沒抓到。抓住它...你又沒抓到！

original: Cast the net wide, mateys!  But, keep an eye out for Triton!  We don't want to catch him!
text: 把渔网撒开点，伙计們！不过，别把海神的儿子特赖登也一块捞上來了！

original: City hygiene is atrocious!  At least I've got sea breezes to keep me fit!
text: 城裏的衛生狀況太糟糕了！還好我有清新的海風能讓我保持健康！

original: I wish I was like Proteus and could shape-shift into something that needed less food!  I'm starved!
text: 我真希望自己有变化的本领，能变成一個不需要吃太多食物的人！我都快饿死了！

original: People used to do everything they could to find work. Now they just sit around waiting for someone to hand them a job on a silver platter!
text: 以前人們爲了找工作會四處奔波，可是現在他們就坐在那兒等着別人把好工作送上門！

original: Being a vassal makes me so angry!  I'd like to stab our rival with an urchin spine!
text: 成為别人的附庸真讓我生气！我恨不得用鱼骨把敌人都刺死！

original: Who would dare to rebel against our city?  No more urchins for them!
text: 谁胆敢反叛我們的城市？再也不给他們海胆了！

original: What do I think of this city?  It's okay, but I could probably teach you a thing or to about running a city!
text: 我觉得這裡怎麼样？马马虎虎，不过我也可以教你一兩招治理城市的方法！

original: I can't think of a single thing to complain about! This city is all right!
text: 我想不出有什麼好抱怨的！這裡什麼都不缺！

original: It's time to make myself scarce!
Collecting urchins is hard work, but someone has to do it!
text: 收集海胆是件很辛苦的工作，不过总得有人去做吧！

original: I hope the people understand just how lucky they are to have such fine urchins!
text: 我希望人們明白能有這麼好的海胆吃是很幸运的！

original: People are whining that they don't feel well.  If city hygiene doesn't improve soon, a plague could break out!
text: 人們正在抱怨，他們覺得身體不適。如果城市的衛生狀況再得不到改善的話，這裏很可能會爆發瘟疫！

original: Maybe being hungry is simply what the Fates have in store for me, but I do wish I had more food!
text: 也许我命裡注定會受饥挨饿，不过我還是希望能有多点東西吃！

original: Jobs are scarce.  A lot of people are out of work.
text: 工作严重不足，很多人都失業了。

original: Our city is better than our rival's!  Why is it that we pay tribute to them?
text: 我們的城市比敌人的要好得多！為什麼我們還要向他們进贡？

original: One of our colonies has picked a fight with us.  How rude!
text: 我們的一個殖民地向我們發出了挑战。真是愚不可教！

original: This city isn't the pits, but it could be better.
text: 這個城市還不错，不过它可以更好！

original: Herodotus is sure to record this city as the best, and you as its greatest ruler!
text: 希罗多德會把這裡作為希腊最好的城市载入史册，而你则是希腊最伟大的领袖！

original: Run! It may be too late for me, but save yourself!
text: 快跑！我可能已經來不及了，但是你要活下去！

original: Maybe one day, branches from this olive tree will be made into a wreath to crown a great champion!
text: 也许哪天，這棵橄榄树上的树枝會被做成花冠，献给最伟大的运动员！

original: Give the tree a gentle little shake, and ripe olives go plop plop onto the ground!
text: 轻轻摇一下树干，成熟的橄榄就都掉到地上來了！

original: I can only imagine Oeneus' joy when Dionysus gave him the first vine. Vines are so fun to work with!
text: 我完全可以想象当狄俄尼索斯将第一根藤蔓交给奥尼尔斯時他的喜悦之情。這些藤蔓真是可爱之极！

original: These succulent grapes are sure to make some fantastic wine!
text: 這些饱满的葡萄一定能酿出最美味的酒來！

original: Judging by people's ashen expressions, hygiene in the city is very bad.
text: 看一眼人們苍白的面孔你就能知道這個城市的卫生状况有多糟了。

original: These hunger pangs are sawing me in half!  I need some food!
text: 我都快饿死了！给我点吃的吧！

original: A lot of people are out of work, but I'm a lumberjack so I'm okay.
text: 很多人都失業了，還好我以伐木為生，還有事可做。

original: Being a vassal stinks!  We should be subject to no one!
text: 作人家的附庸真讓我难受！我們不应该受任何人统治！

original: One of our subjects is trying to gain its independence.  Hah!
text: 我們的一個殖民地想要争取独立，哈！

original: This city's problems aren't as difficult to solve as the riddle of the sphinx, but things aren't perfect here.
text: 這個城市的問題并不像斯芬克司出的谜语那麼难解，可惜它還不是很完美。

original: This city has entered its halcyon days!  It's a joy to live here!
text: 這個城市已經日趋成熟！住在這儿真讓人高兴！

original: I should make like a tree and leave! It's not safe here!
text: 我想赶快走人！這裡不安全！

original: I just hope that the tree I cut down is just a tree and not a tree nymph, Daphne, or an oak capable of prophecy! My job isn't easy!
text: 我只希望我砍下的是普普通通的树木，而不是树精、树仙之类！唉，干我們這行也不容易啊！

original: Boy, this wood is heavy, eh?  What I need is a team of oxen!
text: 伙计，這木头够重吧，嗯？我需要的是一整队牛车！

original: I've never seen so many sick people before! I hope a plague doesn't break out!
text: 我還從來沒见过這麼多病人呢！我可不希望有瘟疫爆發！

original: Maybe if I swallowed a rock like Cronus did, I wouldn't be so hungry!
text: 要是我能像克诺斯那样吞一块石头下去，也许就不會觉得饿了！

original: This city's unemployment issue is not Gordian Knot, but it's still a problem to be solved!
text: 這個城市的失業問題并不是无可救药，但是它現在的确是個麻烦！

original: I'm tired of some other city meddling in our affairs!
text: 我讨厌别的城市插手我們的事！

original: One of our subjects thinks it has the mettle to break free from us!
text: 我們的一個属城觉得自己有能力摆脱我們了！

original: This city lacks a little luster, but it's all right.
text: 這個城市缺了点光辉的事迹，但是总的來說還算不错。

original: I've really taken a shine to this city!
text: 沒有我的话這個城市會逊色很多！

original: I'll mine copper later! It's time to bolt!
text: 以後再采矿！現在得逃命了！

original: Pick ax?  Check.  Bag?  Check.  I'm ready to mine!
text: 斧子拿了嗎？搞定。包呢？也拿好了。我這就去采矿去了！

original: This is the finest copper ore I've ever seen!  Hephaestus would be pleased to work with it!
text: 這是我见过最好的铜矿石！赫菲斯托斯见了一定會很高兴的！

original: This is the finest copper ore I've ever seen!  Hephaestus would be pleased to work with it!
text: 這是我见过最好的铜矿石！赫菲斯托斯见了一定會很高兴的！

original: I'd better take one of the coins from the Mint.  Everyone is sick, and if plague breaks out, I might need it to pay Charon!
text: 我真想從铸币场偷些银币出來。很多人都生病了，如果瘟疫爆發我可能需要钱付药费！

original: Hades' hounds! My stomach is growling louder than Stentor's voice! I need food soon!
text: 该死！我的肚子叫得比钟声還要响！我需要東西吃！

original: Maybe you should ostracize some of the unemployed! At least then they wouldn't be hanging around doing nothing!
text: 也许你愿意把一些沒有工作的人赶出城去！那样至少他們就不會再逛來逛去无所事事了！

original: Our city is like the finest silver, valuable and pure.  Why are we a vassal?
text: 我們的城市就像最好的银币一样纯净，价值不菲。為什麼我們還要附属于别人？

original: A subject is rebelling?  I say let the ingrates go!
text: 一個殖民地想要背叛我們？我說就讓那些忘恩负义的家伙去吧！

original: This city is fair to middling.
This city is as sweet as the Sirens' song, and you deserve to be an immortal, oh great leader!
text: 這個城市就像塞壬的歌声一样美妙，而你则是最伟大的執政官！

original: Smelt! I'd better head for the hills!
There's silver in them there hills, and I'm going to get me some!
text: 那些山裡有银子，我要去弄一些來！

original: Soon, this ore will become cold, hard coin!
text: 过不了多久這块矿石就會变成一個個坚硬的银币了！

original: Soon, this ore will become cold, hard coin!
text: 过不了多久這块矿石就會变成一個個坚硬的银币了！

original: If city hygiene doesn't improve soon, Hades could soon have a lot more company!
text: 如果城裡的卫生状况不能很快改善的话，黑帝斯就要多很多同伴了！

original: I feel like someone has quarried everything out of my stomach, leaving a big empty pit behind.
text: 我感觉好像有人把我的胃都掏空了，只留下一個大洞在那裡。

original: There are a lot of sedimentary folks in this city who could use a job.
text: 這個城裡有很多无所事事的人找不到工作。

original: Being a vassal is terrible!  Where is our pride?
text: 做别人的附庸城感觉真是太差了！我們的脸面往哪儿搁？

original: I think our rebelling subject will find that it's not so easy to cleave yourself away from something as mighty as our city.
text: 那個想要反叛的殖民地很快就會發現想脱离我們這個强大的城市并不是那麼容易的。

original: This city has its troubles, but not as many as were in Pandora's Box!
text: 這個城市存在一些問題，不过還沒有潘多拉魔盒裡的多！

original: This city is superb!  I hope I live as long as Nestor to enjoy it, and I hope you live as long as Nestor to rule it!
text: 這個城市真是太棒了！我希望我能有涅斯托耳那麼长的寿命來享用，而你能有涅斯托耳那麼长的寿命來统治！

original: Ignacious!  If I'm spotted, I could be killed!
text: 要是被發現的话，我會被杀的！

original: I can't wait to get to the quarry and hew out a perfect piece of marble!
text: 我只想赶快到采石场去挖一块最棒的大理石出來！

original: I need the strength of Hercules to haul this load back to the lodge!
text: 我需要有赫爾克利斯的气力才能把這块石头搬回去！

original: I'm so sick, and I fear the worst.  Persephone, I'll be paying you a visit soon!
text: 我病得不行，又怕得要命。珀尔塞福涅，我很快就要來看你了！

original: I'd settle for the sword of Damocles hanging over my head, just as long as I can be at a banquet table with lots of food. I'm famished!
text: 只要讓我美美地吃上一顿，就算达摩克裡斯把剑架在我的脖子上我也不怕。我都已經饿疯了！

original: The unemployed are lollygagging about on the streets, getting in the way.  I hate clutter.
text: 那些沒有工作的人在街上逛來逛去，把路都堵住了。我不喜欢這种混乱的场面。

original: A city as refined as ours should not have to pay tribute to some other city!
text: 像我們這麼發达的城市不应该向任何别的城市进贡！

original: That rebelling city is disrupting things.  Sometimes, the best thing to do with a project gone awry is to simply cut it off.
text: 那個反叛的城市把一切都搞糟了。有時候對付坏了的東西最好的办法就是把它连根拔掉。

original: This city is okay, but it's lacking a certain panache, a certain je ne sais quoi.
text: 這個城市還可以，不过就是缺了点装饰品，和那什麼，我也叫不上名的東西。

original: In both form and function, this city cannot be matched by any other! And you, as its artificer, should be praised!
text: 不管是外在的形式還是内在的功能，這個城市都不是别的城市所能项背的！而你，作為它的创始者，应该得到表彰！

original: So magnificent! So sublime! So...dangerous! Aaaaaargh!
text: 多麼华丽！多麼壮观！多麼...危险！啊...！

original: Off I go to the sanctuary to display my refined craft!
text: 我要去圣所展示我的手藝去了！

original: Soon, everyone in the city will admire my work!  They'll say that I'm better than Daedalus!
text: 过不了多久，城裡所有的人都會欣赏到我的作品了！他們會說我比代达罗斯還要棒！

original: This project is sure to be my finest achievement! Future generations will be in awe of my skill!
text: 這個項目一定會成為我的最高傑作！後人都會讚嘆我的技藝！

original: Only an artisan with my refined skills could build such a beautiful building!
text: 只有像我這般技藝精湛的工匠，才能建出如此美麗的建築！

original: I can't wait to pick out the finest food for my customers! I wouldn't want them to go hungry!
text: 我要去為我的顾客挑选最好的食物去了！我可不想讓他們饿着！

original: I don't know what my assistants are complaining about!  These parcels are feather-light!
text: 真不知道我的伙计都在抱怨些什麼！這些包裹轻得就像羽毛一样！

original: Baa baa. Nothing would hurt a little sheep, right? Baa baa.
text: 不會伤害小羊羔的，對嗎？

original: We need fleece!  Time to buy some more!
text: 我們需要羊毛！该去买些羊毛來了！

original: Careful! This fleece is for the Agora.  If you rippa dese, you menda dese!
text: 当心！這些羊毛是给市场的。要是弄坏了，你得赔！

original: I'm just going to slip away now!
More olive oil coming right up!
text: 更多的橄榄油马上就來了！

original: All of my customers will love this olive oil!
text: 我所有的顾客都會喜欢這些橄榄油的！

original: Look who's here to share a cup...oh, wait. Aaaaaaaargh!
text: 看這是谁來了...哦，等一等，啊！

original: I'm going out to buy more wine!  My customers really drank up quickly!
text: 我要去再卖些酒回來！我的顾客喝得太快了！

original: If the city would just stop spinning for a minute, I'm sure I could make it back to the Agora with this wine!
text: 如果城市可以停止转动一會儿，我肯定能把這些酒送到市场去的！

original: I'm going out to find the finest Corinthian helmets, not to mention hoplons, greaves and cuirasses!
Hephaestus couldn't make better armor than this!  I hope it sees some action soon.
text: 赫菲斯托斯也做不出比這更好的盔甲！我希望它很快能派上用场。

original: Why couldn't one of these horses be Pegasus?  I'd love to be able to fly out of here!
text: 為什麼這裡沒有一匹是神马？否则的话我就可以骑上它离开這儿了！

original: What am I going to buy?  A horse! It's a horse, of course, of course!
text: 我要买什麼？当然是马，当然了！

original: Move along, little doggies! These well-bred horses are sure to be exactly what my demanding customers want!
text: 走快点！這些膘肥体壮的马肯定能讓我那些挑剔的顾客满意了！

original: This city is, like, going to get totally shredded, dude.
So, the vendor was like, 'Hurry up with those goods,' and I was like, 'Whatever!'  The vendor is such a doric!
text: 摊贩老是說，“给我走快点”，而我就說，“什麼呀！”他們就是這麼不尽人情！

original: Dude! Look at the size of this basket!
text: 嘿，看看這篮子裡装了多少東西！

original: Did you see that wrestling match last night? Milo, like, totally smacked down his opponent! Nike must have been on his side!
text: 你有沒有看昨天晚上的摔跤比赛？那個叫米勒的把他的對手打得一败涂地！勝利女神一定站在他那边！

original: Getting hurt is not what I bargained for! I'm skedaddling!
text: 我可不想把自己弄伤！這就撤了！

original: I need more supplies from the Agora!  My customers are so demanding!
text: 我需要從市场进更多的貨物！顾客的需求太大了！

original: My cart is too light!  It's time to load it up again with more goods!
text: 我的手推车太轻了，该回去再装点货了！

original: Just once, I'd like the Agora to bring goods to me!
text: 稍等一下，我要到市场上去取点货！

original: Get your genuine, first quality, Agora-approved goods here!  No imitations!
text: 快來买啊，价廉物美，童叟无欺！品质保证，绝對正宗！

original: What was it you wanted, Mrs. Pericles?  Ah yes, here you go!
text: 你想要的是什麼來着，大嫂？啊，對了，给你！

original: The quicker I can distribute these supplies, the quicker I can take a load off!
text: 赶快把這些東西卖了，我就可以轻松一点了！

original: Yikes! Let's see how fast this cart will go!
text: 嘿，讓我們看看這辆小车能跑多快！

original: I'm not moving until you hire someone to help me unload these goods!
text: 我不走，除非你雇個人帮我把東西卸了！

original: The only room for these goods in the city is right here in my cart.
text: 城裡面能放下這些東西的只有我的手推车！

original: Who am I, Odysseus?  How much longer do I have to travel before I reach my destination?  And where's Calypso?
text: 你当我是谁，奧德修斯？我還得走多远才能到达目的地？卡吕普索又在哪呢？

original: No workshops can accept these goods, and now my own Storehouse can't take them back. There's nothing to do but wait.
text: 沒有工场能接受這些貨物，而我自己的货栈又不能把它們收回。只好就這麼等着了。

original: I'm not the only visitor here!  Oh, no!
text: 我不是這儿唯一的客人！哦，不！

original: Are you talking to me? You and your city are scum, and everyone hates you!
text: 你在跟我說话嗎？你和你的城是一堆垃圾，希腊所有的人都讨厌你！

original: Maybe, if I come here often enough, you'll offer me citizenship in your fine city!
text: 我說，要是我再多來几次的话，也许你能够同意讓我成為你伟大城市中的一员！

original: I'm getting out of here post haste.  I don't want to be here when the monster arrives!
text: 我得赶快离开這儿。我可不想和什麼怪兽碰面。

original: You should be careful!  An opposing god is on the way!
text: 你最好当心一点！一個不怎麼友善的神正在來這儿的路上！

original: Word is that your city is about to be attacked!
text: 希腊很多地方的人都在說你的城市马上要遭到攻击了！

original: Greetings! You'll be thrilled when you see what I have to trade with you!
text: 你好！知道我给你带來了什麼？你會乐坏的！

original: It was a pleasure doing business with you!  I hope Aeolus guides us home!
text: 和你做买卖真开心！希望埃俄罗斯能保佑我們平安回家！

original: Right-click me?  I'll right-click you! You and your city stink, and I only trade with you because my leader demands me to!
text: 你敢点我？我還点你呢！你和你的城市臭名昭著，我來這儿做生意只不过是受命罢了！

original: Coming here is like coming home!  You and this city are so well-loved!
text: 一到這儿就有一种回家的感觉！你和你的城市深受所有希腊人民的爱戴！

original: I heard some rumblings just outside your city.  Either I ate some bad moussaka, or there's a none-too-happy god!
text: 我在你的城外听到阵阵轰鸣声。也许是我吃坏了，要不然就是哪個不怎麼高兴的神來了！

original: Just between you and me, I think there's a monster headed your way.
text: 我只告诉你一個人，我觉得有怪兽正在來這儿的路上。

original: You'd better get ready for company!  An enemy army is on its way here!
text: 你最好赶快备战！一支敌军的部队正在來這儿的路上！

original: Our journey was long and arduous.  What do you have for me?
text: 我們的旅途遥远而又艰辛。你有什麼能给我嗎？

original: Back and forth, back and forth.  I'm beginning to feel like Sisyphus!
text: 來來回回，來來回回，我觉得我像是科林斯王了！

original: Sweet Melpomene!  City hygiene is terrible, and a plague could soon erupt like the applause that erupts for me when I perform!
text: 亲爱的墨尔波墨涅，城裡的卫生糟透了。要不了多久這裡很快爆發一场猛烈的瘟疫：就像我演出時观众给我的掌声那样猛烈！

original: I'm so hungry! I'm just a shadow of my former self!
text: 我快饿死了！現在的我只是以前的一個影子而已！

original: If nothing is done soon, I'll have my pick of extras.  There are so many people out of work!
text: 要是再不做点什麼，就讓我來招几個临時演员吧。很多人都失業了！

original: How could the best actor in all of Greece live in a city that is subservient to another?
text: 希腊最好的演员怎麼能住在一個附庸城裡呢？

original: Can it be true?  A subject rebelling against our city, the home of the greatest actor in Greece?
text: 那是真的嗎？有一個殖民地居然要反叛我們，他們忘了希腊最伟大的演员住在這裡嗎？

original: This city falls just below my very exacting standards!
text: 這個城市已經不再符合我的标准了！

original: The finest actor in all of Greece lives in its finest city led by its finest ruler!  This is the stuff of Homerian epics!
text: 全希腊最好的演员住在最好的執政官领导的最好的城市裡！這才是真正的荷马史诗。

original: We could really use a deus ex machina right about now! I'll run in the meantime!
text: 快去搬救兵吧！我要先走一步了！

original: Off I go to thrill all of Greece with my emoting!
text: 我要用我的表演去感动全希腊的人民！

original: I won the games!  I'd like to thank my teachers at the Drama School, the Muses and all the little people that made this possible.
text: 我赢得了竞赛的勝利！我想要感谢我在戏剧学院裡的老师，感谢缪斯，同時還要感谢所有关心支持我的人。

original: How could this be?  Second at the games!  The contest must have been rigged!
text: 這怎麼可能？我只拿了第二名！肯定有人买通了评委！

original: It's a sad day in Greece when fine acting such as mine is ridiculed!  Have we become barbarians?
text: 戏剧這种高雅的藝术在人們看來真的那麼滑稽嗎？這真是全希腊的悲哀！难道我們都变成野蛮人了嗎？

original: If I weren't so strong, I'd be worried about catching something.  Hygiene conditions in this city are poor.
text: 要不是我有這麼强壮的话，恐怕我也會得病的。這個城市的卫生状况真是糟透了。

original: I'm beginning to lose my manly muscles!  I need food if I'm going to maintain my Adonis-like body!
text: 我的肌肉已經不像以前那麼强壮了！我需要食物來维持我像阿多尼斯般的体格！

original: Look at all those flabby idlers without jobs!  They should get in shape and find jobs!
text: 看看那些弱不禁风又沒有工作的家伙！他們应该好好锻炼身体然後去找工作！

original: I'd like to smash the city we're paying tribute to!  Smash it to smithereens!
text: 我想把那個敢問我們要进贡的城市砸烂！砸個稀巴烂！

original: I don't think it will be long before we have that city rebelling against us pinned and crying mentor.
text: 我想只要一會儿工夫那個想反叛我們的城市就會被摆平，然後哭着向我們求饶。

original: This city could be in much better shape!
text: 這個城市应该再好好整治一下！

original: This city is like Ajax, head and shoulders above the rest!
text: 這個城市就好像埃阿克斯，比别人要高出一大截！

original: I'm going to the games empty handed, but I'll come back with prestige and a wreath!
text: 我就這麼空手去参加竞赛，但要拿着荣誉和花冠回來！

original: I won the games! I'm so great that I bet the gods will turn me into a constellation!
text: 我赢了！多麼伟大啊，我敢打赌诸神一定會把我变成一個星座好讓人們永远记住我！

original: I would have won the games, but I had a cold that day.  Still, second place isn't bad, right?
text: 我本來能赢的，但那天我正好着凉了。不过，第二名也還不错，不是嗎？

original: How did I do at the games?  I don't want to talk about it.
text: 比赛的時候我都做了些什麼？哦，我都不想再說了。

original: A lot of people in the city are sick.  I could break them like a twig!
text: 城裡很多人都病倒了。他們現在就像树枝一样脆弱！

original: Why are people complaining about no food?  I ate just last week!
text: 為什麼人們都在抱怨沒有饭吃？我上個星期才刚吃过東西！

original: All these extra workers aren't doing the city any good.
text: 這麼多富余劳动力對我們一点好处都沒有。

original: Vassal, shmassal.  We're stronger, we're faster and we shouldn't be paying tribute to anyone!
text: 附庸，真丢人！我們力气又大，我們跑得又快，我們不应该向任何人进贡東西！

original: They should let me at that rebelling city!  I'll show them a thing or two!
text: 他們应该讓我到那個反叛的城裡去！我會给他們点颜色看看的！

original: I'm sure there are worse places in Greece.
text: 我想這肯定不是希腊最差的地方。

original: I bet Atlas is pleased to hold the sky up for this city! It's superb!
text: 我敢打赌如果阿特拉斯知道他能為這麼棒的城市顶着天空，他也會高兴的！

original: I'm going to the games!  I can't wait to vanquish my opponents!
text: 我這就去参加竞赛！我等不及要把對手都打败！

original: Everyone bow down before me!  I won the games!  I am the strongest man in all Greece, probably even stronger than Hercules!
text: 所有的人都向我致意！我得了冠军！我是全希腊最强壮的人，說不定比赫爾克利斯還要强壮呢！

original: I'm not quite sure how it happened, but I came in second place in the games!  Someone must have cheated!
text: 我不知道那是怎麼回事，但我只得了第二名！肯定有人作弊！

original: The sun was in my eyes!  How can I perform well with the sun in my eyes?
text: 太阳照进了我的眼睛！我眼睛都睁不开怎麼比得好呢？

original: It's academic: plague will certainly strike if hygiene conditions don't improve!
text: 這是一条真理：如果卫生状况再不改善，瘟疫就會爆發！

original: It's certainly hard to practice epicureanism in this city! What I wouldn't give for a plate of food!
text: 想在這個城市宣扬伊壁鸠鲁真是太难了！给我一碗饭，我什麼都愿干！

original: Some of the peripatetic people should find themselves some employment!
text: 那些逍遥派的人应该去找些事來做！

original: We must be stoic in times like these. It's difficult to be a vassal, but perhaps one day we'll overthrow our rival!
text: 在現在這种時候我們必须忍耐。作為附庸城是很难过，不过也许哪天我們就能超过我們的敌人！

original: We must be getting sophist...I mean soft!  One of our subjects is rebelling against us!
text: 我們必须机灵点...我是說温柔点！有一個殖民地想要反叛我們！

original: This city's problems aren't just rhetorical, but it could be worse.
text: 這個城市的問題還不是最严重，不过有可能會恶化。

original: This city truly is a utopia! And I can't think of a wiser leader!
text: 這個城市是個真正的乌托邦！而我想不出比你更贤明的執政官了！

original: Thus, it becomes clear that the meaning of life is...aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaargh!
text: 所以，生命的意义也就很清楚了，那就是...啊！

original: I'm off to the games!  Soon, everyone will know just how smart I am!
text: 我要参加竞赛去了！等我回來的時候大家就會知道我有多聪明了！

original: I am so smart!  So very, very smart! I won the games!
text: 我真是太聪明了！实在，太聪明了！我赢得了竞赛的勝利！

original: I took second place at the games.  But what does it mean to win, anyway?  Aren't we all winners in our way?
text: 我在竞赛中得了第二名。不过赢了又有什麼意义呢？就自己而言，难道我們不都是胜者嗎？

original: I lost the games!  I guess it's true what they say: true genius is misunderstood in its own time!
text: 我在竞赛中输了！我想他們說的是對的：真正的天才在他有生之年裡都是不被人理解的！

original: I might be sacrificed myself if I don't get out of here!
text: 如果再不离开的话，我恐怕就得把自己献祭出去了！

original: I'm looking for a goat that's shaggy - but not too shaggy - and plump - but not too plump! Preferably one that's not a god in disguise!
text: 我在找一头山羊，毛發要蓬松--但也不能太蓬松，身体要丰满--但也不能太丰满！最好不要是哪個神明伪装的！

original: Don't be frightened, little sheep.  I won't hurt you...much.
text: 不要害怕，小羊羔，我不會怎麼伤害你的。

original: Stop your bleating!  You're making me feel guilty!
text: 别叫了！你讓我都下不了手了！

original: Great things are in store for you, little sheep.  Trust me!
text: 這是一件很伟大的事情，小羊羔。相信我！

original: Sometimes, the gods want nothing but cattle as sacrifice.  I hope I find a cooperative animal!
text: 有時眾神只接受牛作為祭品，希望我能找到一頭肯配合的！

original: Don't get any ideas about stampeding over me.  You are off to bigger and better things!
text: 別想踩過我逃走，你將要去完成更偉大的使命！

original: You'll just be ignored like Cas- sandra. That may be, but I must try to warn my leader. I foresee plague if hygiene conditions don't improve!
text: 你會像卡珊德拉一样被人們遗忘掉。不过，我還是想要警告你一下，如果卫生状况再得不到改善的话，瘟疫就要爆發了！

original: Pick up your side, I'm doing all the work! I'm doing my best. I'm so hungry! Well so am I, but I'm not complaining!
text: 嘿，都到我這边來了，别讓我一個人挑啊！我想好好干來着，可是我饿得要命！谁不是呢，但我可沒像你這麼抱怨！

original: Workers, workers everywhere and not a job to take. If water-carrying weren't a two-person job, I'd be out of work, too!
text: 到处，到处都是失業的人！如果挑水不是兩個人的活儿，我也要沒事做了！

original: Being a vassal is all wet! We deserve so much better!
text: 当别人的附庸真是太差了！我們应该过更好的日子！

original: I hope we give that rebelling city the what for! Yeah! They should know better than to rebel against us!
text: 我希望能给反叛的城市一点厉害看看！那样他們以後就不敢再起反心了！

original: I guess I don't mind living here. It's better than a finger in the eye!
text: 住在這儿也沒什麼不好，总比四处漂泊要强一点吧！

original: This city is more refreshing than any other city! And its leader is the most sparkling!
text: 這裡是全希腊最好的城市！而這裡的執政官也是最优秀的！

original: Hippocrates' oath!  Hygiene is very poor here.  Even I'm feeling under the weather!
text: 该死！這裡的卫生状况太糟了，连我都觉得有些不舒服了！

original: More food is the only panacea to this city's hunger problems!
text: 解决這裡饥荒的唯一方法就是生產更多的食物。

original: I hope the unemployed find jobs soon.  It's not good for the psyche or the body.
text: 我希望那些失業的人都能尽快找到工作。否则的话對身体和心理都不好。

original: When I think about being a vassal, I can feel my bile rising.
text: 一想到我們還附庸于人，我的血压就上升。

original: I think we should amputate the rebellious city!
text: 我觉得我們应该把那個反叛城铲除！

original: When I tell you the news, just don't treat me like Achilles treated Copreus and kill the messenger.  This city has problems.
text: 我有话要對你說，不过千万别像阿基裡斯對待考普拉斯那样對我。這個城市有問題。

original: This city is in the best shape, and you look marvelous, too!
text: 這個城市充满了活力，而你的气色看上去也很好！

original: Judging by what I see, I could be really busy, really soon.
text: 我猜要不了多久我就會很忙，相当忙！

original: Even Hygieia would have trouble curing this city! Hygiene conditions are very poor, and a plague could break out!
text: 就算是神医也救不了這個城市了！卫生状况实在太糟了，马上就要爆發瘟疫了！

original: People here are in much worse condition than the buildings.  I hope a plague doesn't break out!
text: 人們的身體越來越差了。我可不希望有瘟疫爆發。

original: I'm so hungry!  Forget the buildings - I'm about to collapse!
text: 我快饿死了！就别提那些房屋了，连我都快塌了！

original: A lot of people are down on their luck and out of work.
text: 這裡有很多人运气欠佳，都失業了！

original: I just burn inside when I think about being a vassal!
text: 一想到我們還附庸于人，我就心急如焚！

original: So, one or our subjects is rebelling!  I say we should tear it down!
text: 這麼說，我們有一個殖民地反叛了！要我說就把它灭了吧！

original: This city needs a little work around the edges!
text: 這個城市的周边地区還需要好好建设一番！

original: Eureka! I've found the best city and the most capable ruler!
text: 找到了！我终于找到了最好的城市和最有能力的執政官！

original: If you're going to talk to me while I'm putting out a fire, you might as well make yourself useful.  Why don't you go find me some water?
text: 如果你想在我救火的時候和我說话，倒不如來帮我做点事吧。给我找点水來怎麼样？

original: This is hot work!  I feel like I'm in Hephaestus' forge!
text: 干這份工作可够热的！我觉得自己像是在赫菲斯托斯的圣所裡！

original: I'm not so sure that Prometheus did us a favor when he gave us fire!
text: 我現在都不敢肯定普罗米修斯把火种带给我們是不是帮了我們的忙！

original: Some of these buildings are in terrible shape!  I'd better get cracking!
text: 這裡有好些建筑都快撑不住了！我得干活去了！

original: Have you ever seen more solid buildings? Archimedes would be proud!
text: 你见过更牢固的房屋嗎？阿基米德也會為我骄傲的！

original: It's not time to talk, it's time to run!
text: 現在不是說话的時候，現在是快逃的時候！

original: Unrest in the city? Shut your mouth! Things are peaceful here!
text: 城裡有不安因素？胡說！這裡一切都很平静。

original: Just the facts: rumor has it that there's a little unrest here, but it's nothing that I can't handle.
text: 告诉你句实话：城裡好像有些不安因素，不过沒有什麼是我不能解决的。

original: There's a lot of unrest in the city, so let's be careful out there!
text: 城裡有很多不安因素，所以出门的時候要小心了！

original: This outlaw will regret that he ever got out of bed this morning.  Book 'em, Plato!
text: 這個罪犯會後悔今天早上起床的。控告他們吧，柏拉图！
你觉得自己幸运嗎，年轻人？

original: People can't pay their taxes when they're dead, and many people might soon be if hygiene conditions aren't improved!
text: 要是人們都病死了就沒有人繳稅了。如果衛生狀況再不改善，我們就真的收不到稅了！

original: I'm so hungry.  It takes all the joy out of collecting taxes!
text: 我都快饿死了，收税也变得毫无乐趣了！

original: The unemployed get so upset when I ask them to pay their taxes.  I wish they'd find jobs!
text: 讓那些沒有工作的人缴税，连我都觉得有些與心不忍。我希望他們能尽快找到工作！

original: Being a vassal is taxing my patience!
text: 一想到我們是人家的附庸我连工作的耐心都沒有了！

original: Our subject should heed Ixion's cry! They should show gratitude to us, their benefactor, and cease this rebellion!
text: 我們的殖民地真是忘恩负义！他們应该想想我們给他們的好处，然後停止反叛！

original: I'll be laconic here: this city is mediocre at best.
text: 說简单点，這個城市最多也就是马马虎虎。

original: I bet Mt. Olympus isn't as nice as this city!
text: 我猜奥林匹斯山也沒有這裡漂亮！

original: I spy a problem...a BIG problem!
text: 我侦察到一個問題...一個大問題！

original: There are no enemies here now, but I'm ready just the same!
text: 現在這裡沒有敌人，但我還是一样的严加戒备！

original: My quiver is full of arrows, and I'm ready for a fight!
text: 我的箭袋裡装满了利箭，我已經做好了大战的准备！

original: Either the enemy is weak, or these arrows belong to Procris! I can't miss!
text: 也许是敌人太弱了，要不就是這些箭是普罗克裡斯的！我居然箭无虚發！

original: We may need a little luck to win this fight! May Tyche see us through!
text: 我們需要一点运气才能赢得战斗的勝利！愿神明與我們同在！

original: I know trouble when I see it, and I see some right there!
My horse is getting restless!  I hope an enemy comes soon!
text: 我的马有些不安！我希望敌人快点來吧！

original: My nerves are steeled, ready for the impending attack.
text: 我已經做好了充分的准备，随時可以迎接敌人的进攻！

original: That enemy doesn't stand a chance against me! I'm as mighty a horseman as Bellerophon!
text: 敌人根本就沒有机會赢我！我是和拜勒罗芬一样伟大的骑兵！

original: Hippolyte's girdle!  The enemy looks mighty strong!
text: 该死的！敌人看上去好像很强！

original: Trouble like that is just part of life in Greece!
text: 像那样的麻烦在希腊不过是家常便饭而已！

original: I hope we see some action soon.  This armor is starting to get itchy.
text: 我希望我們尽快采取些行动，我浑身都开始痒痒了。

original: My armor is as good as Achilles'. I'll be ready when the invasion starts!
text: 我的盔甲像阿基裡斯的一样好。我早就准备好了！

original: These foes aren't putting up much of a fight!  We'll soon be victorious!
text: 這些敌人根本挑不起什麼战斗！我們很快就能把他們收拾了！

original: This enemy is tough! If we manage to win, it might be a Pyrrhic victory at best!
text: 敌人相当顽强！如果我們碰巧赢了，那完全是神明保佑！

original: I knew I'd see some incredible sights when I left home, but that's more than I bargained for!
text: 在我出门的時候我就知道，我能看到一些奇特的景象，但我還是沒有想到會是這样！

original: I'm bored.  How much longer do I have to stand here?
text: 我已經烦了。到底我還要在這儿站多久？

original: When our enemy gets here, I'll bring new meaning to Clashing Rocks!
text: 等敌人來了，我要把他們打個稀巴烂！

original: You call that an invasion?  My grandmother could defeat that army!
text: 你把那個也称為入侵？我的祖母都能打败他們！

original: The enemy is too fierce!  Why couldn't I stay at home and be a deliveryman like mother wanted!
text: 敌人太厉害了！為什麼我不能待在家裡像妈妈說的做個普通的送货工？

original: That's a titanic problem if I've ever seen one!
text: 那是我所见过的最大的麻烦了！

original: There aren't any enemies on our waters right now, but we're ready for them when they do come!
text: 我們的领海上現在沒有敌人，不过就算他們真的來了我們也奉陪到底！

original: Trim that sail! Look lively! Enemies are coming, and we must be ready!
text: 把那张帆整理一下！對，就是那样！敌人马上就要來了，我們得赶快准备好！

original: My crew is as skilled as Argonauts! It won't be long before this enemy is dead in the water!
text: 我的水手個個身手不凡！只要几下子就能讓敌人都葬身海底！

original: It'll take all of my crew's skill to defeat this formidable opponent!
text: 敌人实在太强了，我們也只有奋力一拼了！

Chariots, formidable in any battle, are made here and paired with lightning-fast horses.
text: 這裡製造威力強大的戰車，並配上疾馳的戰馬。

original: You have told all the chariot makers to go home.
text: 你已下令停止戰車工廠的生產。

original: This Chariot Factory will never produce chariots until it finds some employees!
text: 這座戰車工廠沒有工人，無法生產戰車。

original: With a full staff of chariot makers, this Factory is making chariots quickly.
text: 工人充足，這座工廠正以最快的速度製造戰車。

original: This Factory is missing a worker or two. Chariots aren't being made as efficiently as they could be.
text: 這座工廠缺少一兩名工人，戰車生產效率略有下降。

original: This Factory doesn't have all the workers it needs. Chariots are still being made, but at a slower pace.
text: 這座工廠人手不足，仍在製造戰車，但速度較慢。

original: Only a few people work at this Factory. It's taking the workers a very long time to finish a chariot.
text: 這座工廠只有少數工人，完成一輛戰車需要很長時間。

original: Barely anyone works at this Factory. The production of a finished chariot is an infrequent event.
text: 這座工廠幾乎沒有工人，戰車生產極為緩慢。

original: If chariots are to be produced here, this Factory needs a supply of wood, horses or both!
text: 這座工廠缺少木材、馬匹，或兩者都不足，無法生產戰車。

original: This building has chariots, but needs horses to pull the mighty war machines.
text: 這裡已有戰車，但需要馬匹來拉動它們。

original: This building has chariots, but needs horses. Unfortunately, there are no horses nearby.
text: 這裡已有戰車，但缺少馬匹，而且附近沒有可用的馬匹。
目的地從海路无法到达
來自同盟與附庸城的支援
在英雄珀耳修斯的帮助下，你击败了美杜莎，拯救了你的人民。
可怕的蛇發女怪美杜莎正在你的土地上作怪，所有看见她的人都被变成了石头。你唯一的希望就是把英雄珀耳修斯请到你的城裡來，讓他帮助你對付她。
你的很多城民都被美杜莎变成了石头。把珀耳修斯请來是你唯一的希望！
国王欧律斯透斯满意了。赫爾克利斯终于完成了所有的使命，抵偿了他的罪过。
患了疯病的赫爾克利斯杀了自己的妻子和孩子。他必须完成国王欧律斯透斯交给的使命才能抵偿犯下的罪过。国王會要求赫爾克利斯去做什麼呢？
赫爾克利斯注定要為国王欧律斯透斯服务來弥补他的过错。
伊阿宋手拿金羊毛，凯旋回到城中。
金羊毛被放在遥远的科尔喀斯大陆，并由一条毒龙看守着。派伊阿宋和他的阿耳戈英雄去那裡把金羊毛取回來。
伊阿宋到科尔喀斯去取金羊毛，一路上遇到了很多怪兽。
忒修斯宰杀了牛头怪弥诺陶洛斯，把雅典娜的孩子都带了回來。
国王弥诺斯派人來索取九年一次的贡品，七對童男童女。這些孩子必定會死在牛头怪弥诺陶洛斯居住的迷宫中。只有忒修斯能挽救這些孩子的性命。
又到了向国王弥诺斯进贡七對童男童女的時候了。這一次，男孩中有一個名叫忒修斯。
刚刚过完庆典，大家都很开心。
几個月前有过一個庆典，准备再举行一個吧。
一段時间前有过一個庆典，大家开始抱怨。
一年前有过一個庆典，大家都不高兴。
兩年前有过一個庆典，大家都不高兴。
兩年多前有过一個庆典，大家都不高兴。
兩三年前有过一個庆典，大家都不高兴。
刚刚过完庆典--大家都很开心。
几個月前有过一個庆典，准备再举行一個吧。
一段時间前有过一個庆典，大家开始抱怨。
计划下個月举行一個普通庆典。
兩個月後举行一個小型庆典。
三個月後举行一個小型庆典。
四個月後举行一個小型庆典。
五個月後举行一個小型庆典。
六個月後举行一個小型庆典。

original: I was telling the wife just the other day how satisfying it is to sanctify buildings.
text: 那天我還對妻子說起有一幢圣所真叫人满意。

original: Have you forgotten my power, fellow Olympian? I'll remind you of it now!
text: 看到把众神之神惹恼的後果了嗎？体验一下我愤怒的滋味吧！

original: I am Zeus.  You have offended me, mortal, and you shall pay!
text: 谁敢來侵犯我的城市？我马上就讓你悔不当初！

original: See what happens when you anger the king of the gods? Feel the full force of my wrath!
text: 你把我的力量给忘了嗎？好，我現在就再讓你见识一下！

original: Urchins, fish and horses are in my domain, and multiply when I bid them to.
text: 马匹，海胆和鱼都在我的管辖范围内，我讓它們干什麼它們就會干什麼。

original: You have made me your enemy, and I shall make the sea your enemy too!
text: 给我当心点，沒用的凡人，我會把海裡的一切都毁掉！

original: With this seafood, you can feed your hungry people!
text: 有了這些海產品，你的人們就不用再忍饥挨饿了！

original: With my blessing, the metal here shall multiply, whether it be silver, bronze or coin!
text: 在我的保佑下，這裡的金属，不管是铜還是银，都會成倍增长！

original: You have raised my ire, you pernicious cur!
text: 只要我一個念头，你城裡的所有金属就都不能用了！

original: I can't have you running out of drachmas, now can I?  Please accept these with my compliments!
text: 我怎麼能讓你的城市缺钱花呢？请将這笔钱连同我的問候一起收下吧！

original: With my blessing, farms will yield a bumper crop!
text: 在我的保佑下，农田的產量将成倍提高！

original: At my bidding, fertile farmland will no longer be fertile, and all that is growing upon it will die!
text: 只要我一声令下，你所有肥沃的农田都将变成贫瘠的沙地，而所有的动植物也都将死去！

original: May your Granaries be filled with this nourishing food!
text: 希望你的粮仓能装满這种营养丰富的食物！

original: The buildings that I bless will produce an abundance of goods!
text: 在我保佑下的建筑能生產出更多的東西來！

original: Become barren at my touch, my olive trees.
text: 我的橄榄树啊，变得枯萎吧！

original: I am pleased to provide this city with my favorite fruit and this wholesome oil.
text: 我很高兴能為這個城市提供我最喜欢的果实和這种健康的油。

original: I am Athena Polias, protector of the city! Suffer the consequences of your evil intent!
text: 我是這個城市的保护者雅典娜！現在這种结果是你自找的！

original: I will endow some hunters with my steady aim, and they will bring back an excess of meat!
text: 我要把我的技藝赐予這裡的猎人，這样他們就能打到更多野猪了！
把我惹恼了可不是好玩的！

original: By my skillful hand, the prey fell, and now succulent meat will feed your citizens.
text: 我技藝超群，現在你的人民有足够的肉吃了。

original: Any animal I choose to hunt doesn't stand a chance against me!
text: 只要是我想要打的猎物沒有打不到的！

original: I love watching mortals at their games, play acting, pontificating and athleticizing!
text: 我喜欢看凡人的竞赛，看他們演戏，演讲和运动！

original: No more succor for the mind or the body shall be offered to the natives of this land!
text: 我再也不會帮這裡的人民治病疗伤了！

original: Be well, fair mortals.  You're not ready for the Underworld yet!
text: 珍惜生命吧，凡人，你們現在就寻死還不到時候呢！

original: The scientists here are very smart, but I can make them even smarter!
text: 這裡的科學家已經很聰明，但我能讓他們更聰明！

original: Come along, my fire-breathing friend.  Maybe we can find something for you to attack!
text: 來吧，我的小龙，也许我們能找到什麼東西讓你练练牙口！

original: Feel the edge of my blade, you detestable sloth!
text: 來尝尝我宝剑的滋味吧，你這头可恶的猪！

original: I am in my element! I can't wait to get on the battlefield and face off against the enemy!
text: 嘿，我精神抖擞，忍不住想要到战场上去杀几個敌人來松松筋骨！

original: With my blessing, bronze will more easily bend to the will of the workers!
text: 在我的保佑下，你的铸造工人能够事半功倍！

original: At my command, all forges in the city will cool, and bronze will be unworkable!
text: 只要我一声令下，你城裡所有的锻炉就會熄灭，青铜也就沒有用了！

original: Talos is performing well! Look how frightened the enemy is!
text: 塔洛斯干得不错！你看，敌人都已經吓破胆了！

original: I like nothing better than seeing scores of mortals worshiping me!
text: 我最喜欢的事莫过于看到无数人敬奉我！

original: Come with me, my sweets, come with me.  Help me make this city pay!
text: 來吧，我的朋友們，都跟我走吧！讓這個城市偿還我們！

original: With my blessing, let this house be filled with people!
text: 在我的保佑下，所有的房屋都将住满居民！

original: Now, now, dear heart. Leave these nice little mortals alone!
text: 走吧，亲爱的，就讓這些可爱的凡人自己去吧！

original: Time for my morning constitutional! It's the best way to keep in shape!
text: 我晨练的時候到了！這是保持体形的最佳方法！

original: This city will be hurting for money!
text: 我要讓這個城市沒有钱用！

original: Dear mortal, I will fulfill a request from another city for you! Your stocks of the item won't be touched!
text: 亲爱的人啊，我可以為你满足别的城市發來的请求，而不需要用到你自己的貨物！

original: Look at all these happy people! More wine would make them even happier!
text: 看看這些高兴的人們吧！要是再來些酒他們會更高兴的！

original: Life with me is so much fun! Leave this rotten city behind, my mortal friends, and give life with Dionysus a try!
text: 跟着我的生活真愉快！离开這個堕落的城市，跟我一起走吧！

original: This could be my best vintage yet!  Drink up!
text: 這可能是我最好的酒了！尽情喝吧！

original: City hygiene is very poor here. Ordi- nary mortals are falling ill left and right, but I'm strong enough to withstand petty illnesses.
text: 這裏的衛生狀況太糟糕了。普通的居民都已經不行了，幸好我很強壯，還能頂得住這些小毛小病。

original: Being hungry reminds me of the old days when Chiron would cook for me. He used to make the best moussaka!
text: 肚子一饿我就會想起以前迟罗恩為我烧的饭。他做的碎肉茄子蛋真是太好吃了！

original: We should load up some of these extra workers into a wooden horse and send them on their way!
text: 我們应该把那些多出來的工人送进一匹木马，然後运走！

original: I'm not used to being under the yoke of someone else! I'm far too noble to be a vassal!
text: 我可不喜欢被别人束缚的感觉！我是個伟大的人，不应该成為别人的附庸！

original: I have a nice horse I'd like to give to the rebelling city.
text: 我有一匹很漂亮的木马可以送给那個反叛的城市。

original: This city could be worse. At least it has me!
text: 要是沒了我的话，這個城市就更差了！

original: You may not be a hero like me, but you do know how to lead a city! Who needs Olympus when you can live here!
text: 也许你不是一個像我這样的英雄，但你真的是個懂得如何治理城市的贤主！有你在這儿谁還需要奥林山神！

original: Looks like you've got yourself some trouble there!
text: 看上去你好像有麻烦了！

original: Hephaestus really did do a wonderful job on this armor. With a monster on the way, it's going to see some action!
text: 赫菲斯托斯做的這件盔甲真是不错。好像有一個怪兽朝這儿來了，它马上就能见识到了！

original: I pity those sniveling, sick weaklings.  You should really do something to make them better.
text: 我很可怜那些得了病的人。你应该把這裡改善一下。

original: I could really go for the golden apples of the Hesperides right about now.  I'm so hungry!
text: 我現在就想去取赫斯珀裡得斯的金苹果了。我实在饿死了！

original: I could probably think of some adventures to send the unem- ployed on if the city isn't inter- ested in finding them some work!
text: 如果你不想给那些失業的人找些活儿干的话，我可以给他們安排一点冒险！

original: Being a vassal is worse than any of the twelve labors!  I'm so much better than this!
text: 成為别人的附庸比我經历的十二项功绩還要叫人难受！我不应该沦落至此！

original: It's foolish to rebel against a city that features me as one of its residents!
text: 有我在這裡他們還要反叛，真是愚不可教！

original: This city is no great shakes, but it's better than cleaning out the Augean Stables.
text: 住在這儿虽然不是很讓人兴奋，但总比去打扫奥吉厄斯的牛舍要好。

original: You've done something someone doesn't like very much!
text: 你做了一件讓人不太喜欢的事！

original: A few more arm curls, and I'll be ready for the monster!
text: 再做几下运动我就准备好了，可以去對付怪兽了！

original: If I come down with anything, I'm sure Medea will cure me. Too bad the rest of the citizens don't have such an able spouse!
text: 如果我病倒了，美狄亚一定能帮我治好的。可惜别的市民就沒這麼好的妻子了！

original: I'm so hungry.  I wish I had some of Chiron's moussaka right now! He made the best moussaka!
text: 我快饿死了！要是現在能有一点迟罗恩做的碎肉茄子蛋就好了！他做的最好吃了！

original: If I ever wanted to get the Argo back in the water, this city has plenty of people available to make a nice crew.
text: 如果我想重新扬起阿尔戈号的风帆，這裡倒是有不少人可以成為我的船员。

original: I haven't been under someone's thumb like this since I left Lemnos!
text: 自從我离开拉诺斯就沒有像這样被别人控制过！

original: The rebellion will show just who is powerful and who isn't!
text: 這次反叛倒可以讓他們看看谁才是真正强大的！

original: It's no Iolchus, but this city is okay.
text: 這裡虽然不是很好，但也還过得去。

original: I was telling the wife just the other day how great a city this is!
text: 我前天才對妻子說起這個城市有多伟大！

original: You're going to need some help dealing with that!
Once Medea is done with the potion I need, I'll be ready to fight the monster!
text: 等美狄亚做好了我要的药剂，我就可以去與怪兽搏斗了！

original: Look at all the sick people!  I wonder if the Lotus Eaters could prescribe something.
text: 看看那些得了病的人！我不知道医师到底能不能开出合适的药方來。

original: Maybe I should get Circe to come and change some people to swine. At least then there would be food!
text: 也许我应该把塞科叫來，讓他变几头猪出來。那样我們就有東西吃了！

original: Look at all the jobless people!
text: 看看那些沒有工作的人！

original: I am King of Ithaca, yet I'm a vassal here.  How can that be?
text: 我在伊塔克是国王，到這儿却成了别人的附庸。這到底是怎麼回事？

original: Someone should put that rebelling city in its place!
text: 应该有人去讓那個反叛的城市收敛一点！

original: This city is all right, but there's no place like Ithaca!
text: 這個城市還可以，但還不如伊塔克！

original: Penelope will have to wait a long time before she sees me again! This city is so great!
text: 珀涅罗珀要等很长時间才能再见到我了！這個城市实在太棒了！

original: I've seen worse troubles in my travels!
text: 在我的旅行中见过比這更大的麻烦！

original: Visualize defeating the monster. Okay, I'm ready to go!
text: 想看我怎麼打败敌人嗎？好的，我已經准备好了！

original: This city's hygiene is terrible! I'm glad I'm impervious to illness!
text: 這個城市的卫生状况太糟了！還好我不會受疾病影响！

original: Maybe the Graeae had it right. What's the use of having a mouthful of teeth when there's no food?
text: 也许格莱厄說得對，沒有東西吃的時候要一嘴健康的牙有什麼用？

original: If Medusa came around, there'd be a lot of statues of people sitting around doing nothing. This city needs more jobs!
text: 如果美杜莎來的话，這裡就會多出很多无事可做的人的石像！城裡需要更多的工作！

original: I answer to no man, vassal or no vassal!
text: 我不會听從任何人，不管是不是附庸！

original: A rebellion in progress! I hope you put the brats down!
text: 有人想反叛！我希望你把那小子镇住！

original: Considering it was built by ordinary mortals, I guess this city isn't too bad.
text: 想到這個城市是凡人建造起來的，那也就算不错了！

original: It is truly a pleasure to live in this city!

original: At the university, young Atlanteans pursue their dreams of becoming curators or astronomers.
text: 年輕的亞特蘭蒂斯人在大學裡求學，夢想成為館長或天文學家。

original: With a full faculty of professors, this University can instruct a full class of students.
text: 這所大學的教授人數充足，能夠教授滿班的學生。

original: This University is missing a few professors. Classes are still offered, but students aren't graduating as quickly as they could.
text: 這所大學還缺幾位教授。課程仍然開設，但學生畢業的速度變慢了。

original: The faculty here has only half the professors it needs. Matriculation has slowed.
text: 這裡只有所需教授的一半，學生的學業進度已經放慢。

original: This University has only a few professors. Students are having difficulty fulfilling the requirements for their degrees.
text: 這所大學只有幾位教授，學生很難修完取得學位所需的課程。

original: Only a professor or two teach at this University. It is taking a long time for students to gain knowledge.
text: 這所大學只有一兩位教授授課，學生要花很長時間才能學到知識。

original: This University has no professors. No one is learning anything about astronomy or museums here.
text: 這所大學沒有教授，沒有人能在這裡學習天文或博物館知識。

original: This University is on fire! If a superintendent doesn't extinguish the fire soon, all will be lost!
text: 這所大學失火了！如果管理員不趕快滅火，一切都將付之一炬！

original: A curse is placed on this University. The professors have turned into bumbling idiots, and the students cannot learn.
text: 這所大學受到了詛咒！教授變得愚笨糊塗，學生什麼也學不到。

original: This University is sanctified! Students are grasping concepts quickly and graduating early!
text: 這所大學受到了祝福！學生很快就掌握了知識，提前畢業了！

original: Here, would-be inventors apprentice themselves to experienced masters.
text: 立志成為發明家的人在這裡拜經驗豐富的大師為師。

original: With a full staff of masters, new inventors are quickly refining their techniques.
text: 這裡的大師人數充足，新進發明家的技術很快就能精進。

original: This Workshop could use a few more workers. New inventors are still being trained, but not as quickly as they could be.
text: 這間工場還缺幾名工人。仍能培養新發明家，但速度比平常慢。

original: This Workshop has half of the master inventors that it needs. It is taking longer for new inventors to learn the craft.
text: 這間工場只有所需發明大師的一半，新進發明家需要更久才能學會技藝。

original: This Workshop has only a few workers. New inventors aren't learning to create gadgets very quickly at all.
text: 這間工場只有幾名工人，新進發明家學習製作器具的速度非常慢。

original: Hardly any master inventors work here. New inventors thirst for knowledge, but sadly there are few people to provide it.
text: 這裡幾乎沒有發明大師。新進發明家渴望知識，卻很少有人能教導他們。

original: This Workshop has no master inventors. No new inventors are apprenticed here.
text: 這間工場沒有發明大師，也沒有新進發明家在此學藝。

original: The Workshop has gone up in flames! All the new contraptions here will be lost if a superintendent doesn't put out the fire!
text: 工場失火了！如果管理員不來滅火，這裡的新器具都會被燒毀！

original: This building is cursed! All of the new inventors' experiments are failing!
text: 這座建築受到了詛咒！新進發明家的實驗全都失敗了！

original: This Workshop is sanctified! Apprentice inventors are quickly becoming masters!
text: 這間工場受到了祝福！發明學徒很快就能成為大師！

original: In the quiet reading rooms of the Bibliotheke, scholars learn about the world around them.
text: 學者在圖書館安靜的閱覽室裡，學習周遭世界的知識。

original: This Bibliotheke is fully staffed. A full complement of scholars is reading up on fascinating topics.
text: 這座圖書館人手充足，所有學者都能閱讀有趣的書籍。

original: This Bibliotheke is missing a few workers. Scholars are having a little trouble finding the books they need.
text: 這座圖書館還缺幾名工人，學者尋找所需書籍時遇到了一點困難。

original: With only half the workers it needs, this Bibliotheke is having difficulty servicing local scholars.
text: 這座圖書館只有所需工人的一半，難以為本地學者提供服務。

original: Only a few workers are employed here. Only the smallest number of scholars are learning anything new.
text: 這裡只有幾名工人，只有少數學者能學到新知識。

original: Very few workers are employed at this Bibliotheke. The bookshelves are in disarray, and scholars are barely learning anything new.
text: 這座圖書館的工人極少，書架雜亂無章，學者幾乎學不到新知識。

original: No one works at this Bibliotheke. The reading room has been closed, and no scholars are learning anything.
text: 這座圖書館沒有工人。閱覽室已關閉，學者無法學習。

original: This Bibliotheke is on fire! If a superintendent doesn't come soon, all the books here will be lost.
text: 這座圖書館失火了！如果管理員不快點趕來，所有書籍都會被燒毀。

original: This Bibliotheke is cursed! The pages of the books here have been wiped clean, and scholars have no knowledge to share.
text: 這座圖書館受到了詛咒！書頁上的文字全消失了，學者沒有知識可以傳授。

original: This Bibliotheke is sanctified! Scholars are reading books quicker than ever!
text: 這座圖書館受到了祝福！學者閱讀的速度比以往更快！

original: Astronomers watch the skies here at the observatory.
text: 天文學家在這座天文臺觀察天空。

original: This Observatory has employees, but no astronomers! Make sure astronomers can make their way from a University to the Observatory.
text: 這座天文臺有工人，卻沒有天文學家！請確保天文學家能從大學走到天文臺。

original: Astronomers are observing the night skies and speculating on the nature of the universe.
text: 天文學家正在觀察夜空，思考宇宙的本質。

original: This Observatory has no employees! It needs workers to help the astronomers track the movement of heavenly bodies.
text: 這座天文臺沒有工人！它需要工人協助天文學家追蹤天體的運動。
這裡目前沒有進行觀星活動。

original: Viewing: The Dark Side of the Moon
Viewing: Comets: Bad Omens or Jolly Balls of Ice?
text: 觀測：彗星，是凶兆還是歡樂的冰球？

original: Viewing: Big Asteroids and Fiery Meteors
text: 觀測：巨大小行星與熾熱流星

original: The Observatory is on fire! Astronomers are running for their lives!
text: 天文臺失火了！天文學家正在逃命！

original: The Observatory is cursed! The Astronomers here are too busy gazing at their belly buttons to look at the sky!
text: 天文臺受到了詛咒！天文學家只顧著盯自己的肚臍，無暇仰望天空！

original: The Observatory is sanctified! Astronomers are discovering new stars and planets at a remarkable rate!
text: 天文臺受到了祝福！天文學家正以驚人的速度發現新的恆星與行星！

original: The creature comforts of the Laboratory allow inventors to devise brilliant new gadgets!
text: 實驗室舒適的環境，讓發明家能設計出精彩的新器具！

original: This Laboratory has workers, but lacks inventors! Nothing new is being produced here.
text: 這間實驗室有工人，卻缺少發明家！這裡沒有產生任何新發明。

original: The inventors here are busy working on the latest modern convenience.
text: 這裡的發明家正忙著研究最新的便利器具。

original: The Laboratory has no employees. Inventors cannot work unless there is a staff fetching them refreshments!
text: 實驗室沒有工人。沒有人為發明家送上茶點，他們就無法工作！

original: Nothing new is being invented here.

text: 課題：神奇的超級女僕五十號！
課題：製造更好的捕鼠器

original: The Laboratory is on fire! All of the new inventions will go up in smoke if a superintendent doesn't put out the fire!
text: 實驗室失火了！如果管理員不來滅火，所有新發明都會化為煙霧！

original: The Laboratory is cursed! The inventors here keep reinventing the wheel!
text: 實驗室受到了詛咒！發明家總在重複發明輪子！

original: The Laboratory is sanctified! Dozens of time-saving inventions are being produced!
text: 實驗室受到了祝福！許多節省時間的新發明接連誕生！

original: The Museum is host to fascinating artifacts from all over the world.
text: 博物館收藏了來自世界各地的迷人文物。

original: This Museum has employees, but it lacks curators to take care of the collection!
text: 這座博物館有工人，卻缺少照料藏品的館長！

original: The curators here are busy tending to the collection and spreading word of their latest finds.
text: 這裡的館長正忙著照料藏品，並向人們介紹最新發現。

original: This Museum has no employees to take care of day-to-day operations. Curators refuse to work here.
text: 這座博物館沒有工人處理日常事務，館長拒絕在這裡工作。

original: No exhibits are on display here.
Current exhibit on display for another
text: 目前正在展出的展覽為

original: Exhibit: The Evolution of Atlantean Dress
text: 展覽：亞特蘭提斯服飾演變

original: Exhibit: Early Settlements in the Mediterranean
The Museum is on fire! If a superintendent doesn't put out the fire, all the exhibits will be destroyed!
text: 博物館失火了！如果管理員不來滅火，所有展品都會被燒毀！

original: The Museum is cursed! The curators have no idea what interests the public, and are working on an exhibit of lint!
text: 博物館受到了詛咒！館長不知道公眾喜歡什麼，竟然在籌辦棉絮展！

original: The Museum is sanctified! More curators than normal are discussing the latest exhibit.
text: 博物館受到了祝福！比平常更多的館長正在介紹最新展覽。

original: People don't feel well. I hope it's not scurvy!
text: 大家都不太舒服，希望不是壞血病！

original: I'm so hungry!  There's not so much as a rind to munch on!
text: 我好餓！連一塊果皮都沒得啃！

original: Who will protect us if we're invaded? Our defenses are impaired!
text: 如果有人入侵，誰來保護我們？我們的防禦太薄弱了！

original: I hate being a vassal! It stinks!
Have you heard that a subject is rebelling against us? That's just nutty!
text: 你聽說有附庸反叛我們了嗎？真是瘋了！

original: This city isn't too bad, but it could be much sweeter.
text: 這座城市不算差，不過還可以更加美好。

original: This city is the apple of my eye!  You're a great leader!
text: 這座城市是我的心頭寶！你是個出色的執政官！

original: My what a lovely tree this is!  My pruning is giving it the most attractive shape!
text: 多漂亮的一棵樹！經過我的修剪，它的形狀越來越好看了！

original: I love the harvest! It's great to see the fruits of my labor!
text: 我喜歡收穫的季節！看到自己勞動的成果真高興！

original: People are sick here, and I don't feel so well myself.  But, I'd never miss a day of deer hunting!
text: 這裡的人都病了，我自己也不太舒服。但我一天也不想錯過獵鹿！

original: Deer are already skittish, and now I have to worry about my growling stomach scaring them off! I need food!
text: 鹿本來就膽小，現在還得擔心肚子餓得咕咕叫把牠們嚇跑！我需要食物！

original: People here are worried about attacks. I say, who cares if we have no defense? Bring it on!
text: 大家都擔心遭到攻擊。要我說，沒有防禦又怎樣？儘管來吧！

original: Forget about being a vassal! Let's revolt against our rival!
text: 別再當附庸了！起來反抗我們的敵人吧！

original: What an insult! We should pound our rebelling subject into the ground!
text: 真是恥辱！我們應該狠狠教訓那個反叛的附庸！

original: If the deer hunting wasn't so good here, I'd move.  This city isn't that great.
text: 要不是這裡這麼適合獵鹿，我早搬走了。這座城市可沒多好。

original: I'd like to give you a hearty slap on the back and a firm handshake. This city is awesome!
text: 我真想拍拍你的背，再用力握握你的手。這座城市太棒了！

original: I'm handy with a spear, but not that handy!  Aaaaaaaaaaaargh!
text: 我雖然擅長用矛，也沒厲害到這個地步！啊啊啊！

original: Get ready, deer, because here I come!
The ladies love it when I come back from the hunt with fresh meat!
text: 姑娘們最喜歡我打獵回來帶的新鮮肉食！

original: I should really be home in bed, nursing my illness like everyone else.  But cows wait for no man.
text: 我真該像其他人一樣躺在家裡養病，可是牛群不等人啊。

original: Are there Harpies around, and am I Phineus? Every scrap of food has been taken from me!  I'm starved!
text: 難道附近有鳥身女妖，而我是菲紐斯？食物全被搶走了！我快餓死了！

original: I don't like the looks of things, partner. If we're attacked, we'll surely be defeated by our foe!
text: 夥伴，情況看起來不妙。如果受到攻擊，我們一定會被敵人打敗！

original: There's nothing worse than being a vassal!  Even the cows are mad!
text: 沒有比當附庸更糟的事了！連牛都在生氣！

original: I can't believe our subject is rebelling! Someone must have steered them wrong!
text: 真不敢相信我們的附庸反叛了！一定是有人把他們帶上了歧途！

original: If I weren't so loyal to my cows, I'd move along to another city.
text: 要不是捨不得我的牛，我早就搬到別的城市去了。

original: I am happy that my home is on this range! There's not a better spot in the world!
text: 能在這片牧場安家真幸福！世界上沒有更好的地方！

original: It's time to head 'em up and move 'em out!  Run!
text: 該趕著牛群離開了！快跑！

original: I love cow-wrangling time!  It reminds me that I'm alive!
text: 我最喜歡放牧牛群的時候！這讓我感到自己充滿活力！

original: Until we meet again, little cow, have fun in the pasture!
text: 小牛，下次再見，在牧場裡好好玩吧！

original: The poor people in the city are wan and pale from illness.  A plague could break out!
text: 城裡可憐的人們病得面色蒼白，瘟疫可能就要爆發了！

original: I long for the tiniest morsel of food to touch my tongue! I've never been hungrier!
text: 我多希望舌頭能嚐到一丁點食物！我從沒這麼餓過！

original: I feel so unsafe! Our city has little hope of fending off any invaders!
text: 我一點也不覺得安全！我們的城市幾乎不可能擊退入侵者！

original: The burden of being a vassal chafes! At least I can take solace in my work.
text: 當附庸的重擔真令人難受，至少我還能從工作中得到安慰。

original: Some foolish city is rebelling against us! They do not know what they are doing!
text: 某個愚蠢的城市竟然反叛我們！他們根本不知道自己在做什麼！

original: This city is like so many other cities. Nothing makes it stand out!
text: 這座城市和其他許多城市一樣，沒什麼特別！

original: This city is the pride of the world!  I can't imagine a better place to live!
text: 這座城市是全世界的驕傲！我想不出還有更好的住所！

original: Even the powers of orichalc can't save me!  Help!
text: 連山銅的力量也救不了我！救命！

original: I pray to the great gods that the orichalc may be plentiful and easily mined!
text: 我祈求偉大的眾神，讓山銅礦藏豐富又容易開採！

original: This orichalc ore, imbued with beauty and power, is sure to serve its user well!
text: 這種山銅礦石蘊含美麗與力量，一定能為使用它的人帶來好處！

original: I'm leaving lickety-split, and you'd better, too!
text: 我要馬上離開，你最好也快走！

original: I'm as excited as Phaethon! I can't wait to take the new chariots for a test drive!  Vroom, vroom!
text: 我和法厄同一樣興奮！等不及試駕新戰車了！轟，轟！

original: There's nothing more beautiful than a well-made chariot! With the right horse, it can go from 0 to 40 in three minutes!
text: 沒有什麼比精工製作的戰車更漂亮！配上好馬，三分鐘就能從零加速到四十！

original: If, as a wise man said, 'Attention to health is life's greatest hindrance,' then people here are much hindered indeed.
text: 如果智者所說的「操心健康是人生最大的阻礙」是真的，那這裡的人阻礙可真不少。

original: A playwright says, 'Hunger knows no friend but its feeder.' Why not befriend hunger and feed your people?
text: 劇作家說：「飢餓唯一的朋友，就是餵養它的人。」何不與飢餓交朋友，餵飽你的人民？

original: It's your 'duty to select natures which are fitted for the task of guarding the city.' Yet, our defenses are weak!
text: 你有責任挑選適合保衛城市的人才，可是我們的防禦仍然薄弱！

original: How can we submit to another city? We should take the sage's advice and 'make war that we may live in peace!'
text: 我們怎能屈服於另一座城市？應該聽從智者的忠告：「為和平而戰！」

original: Our subject has 'become a rebel to law and convention instead of the conformer that he was.' Let's put a stop to that!
text: 我們的附庸已從守法之民變成反抗法律與習俗的叛徒。讓我們制止他們！

original: If 'Those who are too smart to engage in politics are punished by being governed by those who are dumber,' I've only myself to blame!
text: 如果不屑從政的聰明人，終將受到愚者統治的懲罰，那我只能怪自己了！

original: A bard says, 'We would often be sorry if our wishes were gratified.'  This city fulfills my wishes, and I am not sorry!
text: 詩人說：「願望成真往往令人後悔。」這座城市滿足了我的願望，而我並不後悔！

original: It's said that 'those whom the gods love die young.' I must be well-loved, because I think I'll soon be dead!  Aaaargh!
text: 據說眾神所愛的人都英年早逝。我一定深受眾神喜愛，因為我快死了！啊啊啊！

original: Atlas' beautiful daughters, the Pleiades, are crying in the heavens! They're distraught that so many are ill!
text: 阿特拉斯美麗的女兒們，昴星七姊妹，正在天上哭泣！這麼多人生病讓她們傷心！

original: Why won't some god turn me into a constellation so I won't be hungry any more?
text: 為什麼沒有神把我變成星座，讓我不用再挨餓？

original: Our defenses are weak!  Are you expecting Orion to shoot arrows from the sky to protect us?
text: 我們的防禦太弱了！你指望獵戶座從天上射箭保護我們嗎？

original: By Selene, how could you let another city eclipse our strength! We should rebel against our rival!
text: 月亮女神在上，你怎能讓另一座城市遮住我們的光芒！我們應該反抗敵人！

original: A subject is rebelling?  That defies the rules of the cosmos!
text: 附庸反叛了？這簡直違反宇宙的法則！

original: I've heard that the stars shine brighter at other cities, but I suppose this city is okay.
text: 聽說其他城市的星星更明亮，不過我想這座城市也還過得去。

original: I've thanked the gods billions and billions of times for this city and its fine ruler!
text: 為了這座城市和優秀的執政官，我已向眾神道謝千千萬萬次！

original: What is that that I see just over the horizon? Oh, no!
text: 我在地平線那邊看見的是什麼？哦，不！

original: So many people are sick!  I hope I don't fall ill -- the science world would be lost without me!
text: 這麼多人病了！希望我不會倒下，科學界不能沒有我！

original: Hunger... is... making... me... weak... so... very... weak!
text: 飢餓……讓我……虛弱……非常……虛弱！

original: I don't think the city's defenses are calibrated correctly. An enemy would easily defeat us if we were attacked!
text: 我看城市的防禦配置不太對。如果受到攻擊，敵人很容易就能擊敗我們！

original: I would rather never invent another thing than be a vassal!
text: 我寧可永遠不再發明，也不願當附庸！

original: One of our subjects thinks it is better off without us. It's an interesting hypothesis, but it's false!
text: 我們的一個附庸認為離開我們會更好。這假說很有趣，可惜是錯的！

original: Until my latest invention, InstaKing500, is finished, I guess I'll put up with you.  You could make this city so much better!
text: 在我的新發明「即時國王五百號」完成以前，我就先忍耐你吧。你本可以把城市管得更好！

original: This city is great! What's your formula for success?
text: 這座城市太棒了！你成功的公式是什麼？

original: I must run and save my precious inventions!  Aaaaaargh!
text: 我得快跑，保住珍貴的發明！啊啊啊！

original: If I were creating a 'Sick People' exhibit, I'd have plenty of specimens to choose from! People are quite ill!
text: 如果我要辦「病人展」，可供挑選的樣本多得是！大家病得真重！

original: I can't think about museum work at a time like this!  I'm starved!
text: 這種時候我哪還有心思管博物館！我快餓死了！

original: Our weak defenses are very inviting to our enemies! I hope no one accepts the invitation!
text: 薄弱的防禦簡直在邀請敵人進攻！希望沒有人接受邀請！

original: Our forefathers would be ashamed! How can we be some other city's vassal?
text: 祖先都會感到羞恥！我們怎能成為別人的附庸？

original: Our rebellious subject can't reasonably expect to break free from us. It defies logic!
text: 那個反叛的附庸竟然妄想脫離我們，真是不合邏輯！

original: I would place this city is the mediocre category.
text: 我會把這座城市歸類為平庸之作。

original: This city is in a class all by itself.  It is the finest ever!
text: 這座城市獨樹一格，是有史以來最出色的！

original: My collection is big enough, thank you.  Aaaaaaaargh!
text: 我的收藏已經夠多了，謝謝！啊啊啊！

original: My true aim will make no difference against an immortal! Run!
text: 面對不死的神，射得再準也沒用！快跑！

original: If we aren't going to be attacked, I'd much rather be home!
text: 如果沒有人來進攻，我寧可待在家裡！

original: Ooooh!  The enemy will be here soon!  I can't wait!
text: 哦！敵人快到了！我等不及了！

original: Foolish enemy!  Did you think that women cannot show courage?
text: 愚蠢的敵人！你以為女人就沒有勇氣嗎？

original: May the gods guide my arrows! Our enemy is strong, and I need all the help I can get!
text: 願眾神指引我的箭！敵人很強，我需要一切能得到的幫助！

original: Good god!  No wait, bad god!  Help!
text: 好神啊！不，等等，是惡神！救命！

original: My spear is at the ready, but there is no enemy!  Maybe there's some other spear carrier who could use this spear.
text: 我的矛已準備好了，卻沒有敵人！也許有別的長矛兵用得上它。

original: The moment I've been waiting for will be here soon!  I cannot wait to try out this spear in the heat of battle!
text: 期待的時刻快到了！我等不及在激戰中試試這支矛！

original: I could fight this enemy with one hand tied behind my back!
text: 就算一隻手綁在背後，我也能打敗這種敵人！

original: Now I remember why Atlanteans are peaceful people!  This enemy is too tough!
text: 我現在明白亞特蘭蒂斯人為什麼愛好和平了！這敵人太難對付！

original: While I'm sure that I cut a striking figure out here in my chariot, you ought to send me home if there's no fighting.
text: 雖然我駕著戰車英姿出眾，但如果沒仗可打，你還是讓我回家吧。

original: I wish that the enemy would get here already! I'm tired of waiting!
text: 真希望敵人快點來！我已經等膩了！

original: Look how hard our puny enemy is trying to defeat us.  How cute!
text: 看看弱小的敵人多努力想打敗我們，真可愛！

original: If I don't make it back alive, tell my mother she can have my best amphora.
text: 如果我不能活著回去，告訴母親，我最好的雙耳瓶就送給她了。

original: Yikes!  I have a feeling this tower isn't going to be enough to protect me!
text: 糟了！我覺得這座塔樓保護不了我！

original: I've scanned the horizon in all directions, and there are no enemies in site!
text: 我已仔細察看四方地平線，沒有發現敵人！

original: Enemies are on their way! I'll have a warm welcome - a downright hot welcome - ready for them!
text: 敵人正在趕來！我會準備一場熱烈，不，是火熱的歡迎！

original: This is like spearing fish in a barrel!  This enemy presents no challenge at all!
text: 這就像在桶裡叉魚！這種敵人毫無挑戰！

original: It will take all of our strength to turn back this formidable foe!
text: 要擊退如此強大的敵人，我們必須竭盡全力！

original: Become more plentiful under my guiding hand!
text: 在我的引導下，變得更加豐盛吧！

original: What have you done to deserve this? If you don't know, I'm not going to tell you!
text: 你做了什麼才遭此報應？如果你不知道，我也不會告訴你！

original: At my command, the goods in the Agoras will multiply!
text: 聽我號令，讓市場裡的貨物成倍增加！

original: Out of this city, Zeus! And don't come back, if you know what's good for you!
text: 滾出這座城市，宙斯！識相的話就別再回來！

original: Nothing is more beautiful to me than a large pile of construction materials!
text: 在我眼裡，沒有比一大堆建築材料更美的東西！

original: Don't bother begging for mercy, mortal! Feel the chill of my cold heart!
text: 凡人，別浪費力氣求饒！感受我冷酷之心的寒意吧！

original: May the materials here last longer than expected, and may this building stretch toward the sky!
text: 願這些材料比預期更耐用，願這座建築直達天際！

original: Mummy Echidna and Daddy Typhon will be proud of their little girl when I destroy this city!
text: 當我毀掉這座城市，厄喀德娜媽媽和提豐爸爸一定會為他們的小女兒驕傲！

original: I am the mother of all monsters! You've met your match.
text: 我是萬怪之母！你碰上對手了。

original: I'll snatch you up and eat you, I will!
text: 我要把你抓起來吃掉，一定會！

original: What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, three legs at dusk and screams in abject terror now?
text: 什麼東西早晨四條腿，中午兩條腿，黃昏三條腿，現在卻嚇得尖聲慘叫？

original: Too bad your people don't have a hero's strength.  They'd be a lot less sickly.
text: 可惜你的人民沒有英雄般的體魄，不然就不會這麼容易生病了。

original: People complain that they're hungry.  As for me, I laugh in the face of hunger.  Ha ha!
text: 人們抱怨挨餓。至於我，面對飢餓只會大笑。哈哈！

original: I'm glad to see you've placed so much faith in me, but I'm going to need help fending off enemies if anyone attacks.
text: 很高興你如此信任我，不過真有人進攻，我還是需要幫手來抵擋敵人。

original: Living in a city that is subject to another is an affront to my honor.  You should rebel.
text: 住在別人的附庸城市，有損我的榮譽。你應該反抗。

original: You need to reign in that rebelling subject of yours.
text: 你該管管那個反叛的附庸了。

original: If I had my druthers, I wouldn't live here.  But, duty calls.
text: 如果能自己選擇，我才不住這裡。不過，職責所在。

original: You have worked wonders with this city!  You are the Bellerophon of leaders!
text: 你把這座城市治理得宛如奇蹟！你就是執政官中的貝勒羅豐！

original: I'll fight anything, whether it be mortal, monster or god!
text: 不管是凡人、怪獸還是神，我都要與之一戰！

original: Monster-fighting is my favorite pastime!  I can't wait for the creature to get here!
text: 和怪獸作戰是我最愛的消遣！我等不及牠來了！

original: What's wrong with people here? They miss a few meals or some visits from a healer, and they fall ill, just like that!
text: 這裡的人怎麼了？少吃幾餐，或少看幾次醫生，就這樣病倒了！

original: I can't even see people's ribs!  How can they complain about being hungry?
text: 我連他們的肋骨都看不見，他們怎麼好意思抱怨挨餓？

original: I like your moxie.  Facing the world with weak defenses, just inviting an enemy to attack!
text: 我佩服你的膽量。防禦這麼薄弱還敢面對世界，簡直在邀請敵人進攻！

original: How could you let a rival outmatch you? You're not as capable as I thought!
text: 你怎會讓敵人勝過自己？你沒有我想的那麼能幹！

original: Are you just going to sit there while one of your subjects rebels against you?  Where's your pride?
text: 你的附庸正在反叛，你卻只會坐著看？你的尊嚴呢？

original: I'd rather be sailing the seas on the Argo than living in this city!
text: 我寧可乘阿爾戈號出海，也不想住在這座城市！

original: This city is as wonderful as a golden apple!
text: 這座城市和金蘋果一樣美妙！

original: I bet I've fought monsters bigger and fiercer than the one on the way.
text: 我敢打賭，我打過的怪獸比正在趕來的這隻更大、更兇猛。
